text.en: And when they had made an end of offering, the king and all that were present with him bowed themselves, and worshipped.

text.am: ንጉሡም ሕዝቅያስና አለቆቹ ሌዋውያንን በዳዊትና በባለ ራእዩ በአሳፍ ቃል እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑ ዘንድ አዘዙ። በደስታም አመሰገኑ፥ አጐነበሱም ሰገዱም።
text.en: Moreover Hezekiah the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praise unto the LORD with the words of David, and of Asaph the seer. And they sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshipped.

text.am: ሕዝቅያስም። አሁን ለእግዚአብሔር ተቀድሳችኋል፤ ቅረቡ፥ መሥዋዕቱንና የምስጋናውን መሥዋዕት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት አምጡ ብሎ ተናገረ። ጉባኤውም መሥዋዕቱንና የምስጋናውን መስዋዕት አመጡ፤ ልባቸውም የፈቀደ ሁሉ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት አመጡ።
text.en: Then Hezekiah answered and said, Now ye have consecrated yourselves unto the LORD, come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of the LORD. And the congregation brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a free heart burnt offerings.

text.am: ጉባኤውም ያመጡት የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ቍጥር ሰባ ወይፈን፥ መቶም አውራ በጎች፥ ሁለት መቶም የበግ ጠቦቶች ነበረ፤ ይህ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነበረ።
text.en: And the number of the burnt offerings, which the congregation brought, was threescore and ten bullocks, an hundred rams, and two hundred lambs: all these were for a burnt offering to the LORD.

text.am: የተቀደሱትም ቍጥር ስድስት መቶ በሬዎች ሦስት ሺህም በጎች ነበረ።
text.en: And the consecrated things were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.

text.am: ነገር ግን ካህናቱ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ለመግፈፍ ጥቂቶች ነበሩ፤ ስለዚህም ሌዋውያን በቅን ልብ ከካህናት ይልቅ ይቀደሱ ነበርና ሥራው እስኪፈጸም ድረስ፥ ካህናቱም እስኪቀደሱ ድረስ ወንድሞቻቸው ሌዋውያን ያግዙአቸው ነበር።
text.en: But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: wherefore their brethren the Levites did help them, till the work was ended, and until the other priests had sanctified themselves: for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.

text.am: የሚቃጠለውም መሥዋዕት የደኅንነቱም መሥዋዕት ስብ፥ ከሚቃጠለውም መሥዋዕት ሁሉ ጋር የሚቀርበው የመጠጥ ቍርባን፥ ብዙ ነበረ። እንዲሁም የእግዚአብሔር ቤት አገልግሎት ተዘጋጀ።
text.en: And also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of the house of the LORD was set in order.

text.am: ሕዝቅያስና ሕዝቡም ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ ስላዘጋጀው ነገር ደስ አላቸው። ይህም ነገር በድንገት ተደረገ።
text.en: And Hezekiah rejoiced, and all the people, that God had prepared the people: for the thing was done suddenly.

text.am: ለእስራኤልም አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ፋሲካ ያደርጉ ዘንድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንዲመጡ ሕዝቅያስ ወደ እስራኤልና ወደ ይሁዳ ሁሉ ላከ፥ ደግሞም ወደ ኤፍሬምና ወደ ምናሴ ደብዳቤ ጻፈ።
text.en: And Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah, and wrote letters also to Ephraim and Manasseh, that they should come to the house of the LORD at Jerusalem, to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel.

text.am: ካህናቱም በሚበቃ ቍጥር ስላልተቀደሱ፥ ሕዝቡም ገና በኢየሩሳሌም ስላልተሰበሰቡ በጊዜው ያደርጉት ዘንድ አልቻሉምና ንጉሡና አለቆቹ የኢየሩሳሌምም ጉባኤ ሁሉ በሁለተኛው ወር ፋሲካውን ያደርጉ ዘንድ ተመካክረው ነበር።
text.en: For the king had taken counsel, and his princes, and all the congregation in Jerusalem, to keep the passover in the second month.

text.am: ካህናቱም በሚበቃ ቍጥር ስላልተቀደሱ፥ ሕዝቡም ገና በኢየሩሳሌም ስላልተሰበሰቡ በጊዜው ያደርጉት ዘንድ አልቻሉምና ንጉሡና አለቆቹ የኢየሩሳሌምም ጉባኤ ሁሉ በሁለተኛው ወር ፋሲካውን ያደርጉ ዘንድ ተመካክረው ነበር።
text.en: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves sufficiently, neither had the people gathered themselves together to Jerusalem.

text.am: ነገሩም ለንጉሡና ለጉባኤው ሁሉ ዓይን መልካም ነበረ።
text.en: And the thing pleased the king and all the congregation.

text.am: እንደ ተጻፈም በብዙ ቍጥር አላደረጉም ነበርና የእስራኤልን አምላክ የእግዚአብሔርን ፋሲካ በኢየሩሳሌም ያደርጉ ዘንድ እንዲመጡ ከቤርሳቤህ ጀምሮ እስከ ዳን ድረስ ለእስራኤል ሁሉ አዋጅ እንዲነገር ወሰኑ።
text.en: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Beersheba even to Dan, that they should come to keep the passover unto the LORD God of Israel at Jerusalem: for they had not done it of a long time in such sort as it was written.

text.am: እንደ ንጉሡም ትእዛዝ መልክተኞቹ እንዲህ የሚለውን የንጉሡንና የአለቆቹን ደብዳቤ ይዘው ወደ እስራኤልና ወደ ይሁዳ ሁሉ ሄዱ። የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከአሦር ነገሥታት እጅ ወዳመለጠ ቅሬታችሁ እንዲመለስ ወደ አብርሃምና ወደ ይስሐቅ ወደ እስራኤልም አምላክ ተመለሱ።
text.en: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Judah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, Ye children of Israel, turn again unto the LORD God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, and he will return to the remnant of you, that are escaped out of the hand of the kings of Assyria.

text.am: እናንተም እንደምታዩ የተፈቱ እስኪያደርጋቸው ድረስ የአባቶቻቸውን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን እንደ በደሉ እንደ አባቶቻችሁና እንደ ወንድሞቻችሁ አትሁኑ።
text.en: And be not ye like your fathers, and like your brethren, which trespassed against the LORD God of their fathers, who therefore gave them up to desolation, as ye see.

text.am: አባቶቻችሁም እንደ ነበሩ አንገተ ደንዳና አትሁኑ፤ እጃችሁንም ለእግዚአብሔር ስጡ፥ ለዘላለም ወደ ተቀደሰው ወደ መቅደሱም ግቡ፥ ጽኑ ቍጣውም ከእናንተ እንዲመለስ አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን አምልኩ።
text.en: Now be ye not stiffnecked, as your fathers were, but yield yourselves unto the LORD, and enter into his sanctuary, which he hath sanctified for ever: and serve the LORD your God, that the fierceness of his wrath may turn away from you.

text.am: አምላካችሁም እግዚአብሔር ቸርና መሐሪ ነውና፥ ወደ እርሱም ብትመለሱ ፊቱን ከእናንተ አያዞርምና ወደ እግዚአብሔር ብትመለሱ ወንድሞቻችሁና ልጆቻችሁ በማረኩአቸው ፊት ምሕረትን ያገኛሉ፥ ደግሞም ወደዚህች ምድር ይመለሳሉ።
text.en: For if ye turn again unto the LORD, your brethren and your children shall find compassion before them that lead them captive, so that they shall come again into this land: for the LORD your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away his face from you, if ye return unto him.

text.am: መልእክተኞቹም ከከተማ ወደ ከተማ በኤፍሬምና በምናሴ አገር እስከ ዛብሎን ሄዱ፤ እነዚያ ግን በንቀት ሳቁባቸው፥ አፌዙባቸውም።
text.en: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Ephraim and Manasseh even unto Zebulun: but they laughed them to scorn, and mocked them.

text.am: ነገር ግን ከአሴርና ከምናሴ ከዛብሎንም አያሌ ሰዎች ሰውነታቸውን አዋረዱ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም መጡ።
text.en: Nevertheless divers of Asher and Manasseh and of Zebulun humbled themselves, and came to Jerusalem.

text.am: ደግሞም አንድ ልብ ይሰጣቸው ዘንድ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቃል የሆነውን የንጉሡንና የአለቆቹን ትእዛዝ ያደርጉ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር እጅ በይሁዳ ላይ ሆነ።
text.en: Also in Judah the hand of God was to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes, by the word of the LORD.

text.am: በሁለተኛውም ወር የቂጣውን በዓል ያደርግ ዘንድ እጅግ ታላቅ ጉባኤ የሆነ ሕዝብ በኢየሩሳሌም ተከማቸ።
text.en: And there assembled at Jerusalem much people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great congregation.

text.am: ተነሥተውም በኢየሩሳሌም የነበሩትን መሠዊያዎችና ለጣዖታት የሚያጥኑበትን ዕቃ ሁሉ አስወገዱ፥ በቄድሮንም ወንዝ ጣሉት።
text.en: And they arose and took away the altars that were in Jerusalem, and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast them into the brook Kidron.

text.am: በሁለተኛውም ወር በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን ፋሲካውን አረዱ፤ ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑም አፈሩ፥ ተቀደሱም፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት አመጡ።
text.en: Then they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the second month: and the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought in the burnt offerings into the house of the LORD.

text.am: እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ሰው እንደ ሙሴ ሕግ በሥርዓታቸው ቆሙ፤ ካህናቱም ከሌዋውያን እጅ የተቀበሉትን ደም ይረጩ ነበር።
text.en: And they stood in their place after their manner, according to the law of Moses the man of God: the priests sprinkled the blood, which they received of the hand of the Levites.

text.am: በጉባኤውም ያልተቀደሱ እጅግ ሰዎች ነበሩ፤ ስለዚህም ሌዋውያን ለእግዚአብሔር ይቀድሱአቸው ዘንድ ንጹሐን ላልሆኑት ሁሉ ፋሲካውን ያርዱላቸው ነበር።
text.en: For there were many in the congregation that were not sanctified: therefore the Levites had the charge of the killing of the passovers for every one that was not clean, to sanctify them unto the LORD.

text.am: እንደ ትእዛዙም ሳይሆን ከኤፍሬምና ከምናሴ ከይሳኮርና ከዛብሎንም ወገን እጅግ ሰዎች ሳይነጹ ፋሲካውን በሉ።
text.en: For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, and Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet did they eat the passover otherwise than it was written. But Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, The good LORD pardon every one

text.am: ሕዝቅያስም። ምንም እንደ መቅደሱ ማንጻት ባይነጻ የአባቶቹን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ለመፈለግ ልቡን የሚያቀናውን ሁሉ ቸሩ እግዚአብሔር ይቅር ይበለው ብሎ ስለ እነርሱ ጸለየ።
text.en: That prepareth his heart to seek God, the LORD God of his fathers, though he be not cleansed according to the purification of the sanctuary.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሕዝቅያስን ሰማው፥ ሕዝቡንም ፈወሰ።
text.en: And the LORD hearkened to Hezekiah, and healed the people.

text.am: በኢየሩሳሌምም ተገኝተው የነበሩ የእስራኤል ልጆች የቂጣውን በዓል በታላቅ ደስታ ሰባት ቀን አደረጉ፤ ሌዋውያኑና ካህናቱም በዜማ ዕቃ ለእግዚአብሔር እየዘመሩ ዕለት ዕለት እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑ ነበር።
text.en: And the children of Israel that were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness: and the Levites and the priests praised the LORD day by day, singing with loud instruments unto the LORD.

text.am: ሕዝቅያስም በእግዚአብሔር አገልግሎት አስተዋዮች የነበሩትን ሌዋውያንን ሁሉ ያጽናና ነበር። የደኅንነትንም መሥዋዕት እያቀረቡ፥ የአባቶቻቸውንም አምላክ እያመሰገኑ ሰባት ቀን በዓል አደረጉ።
text.en: And Hezekiah spake comfortably unto all the Levites that taught the good knowledge of the LORD: and they did eat throughout the feast seven days, offering peace offerings, and making confession to the LORD God of their fathers.

text.am: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ ስለ ቍርባን ሺህ ወይፈኖችና ሰባት ሺህ በጎች ለጉባኤው ሰጥቶ ነበርና፥ አለቆቹም ሺህ ወይፈኖችና አሥር ሺህ በጎች ለጉባኤው ሰጥተው ነበርና፥ ከካህናቱም እጅግ ብዙ ተቀድሰው ነበርና ጉባኤው ሁሉ እንደ ገና ሰባት ቀን በዓል ያደርጉ ዘንድ ተማከሩ፤ በደስታም እንደ ገና ሰባት ቀን በዓል አደረጉ።
text.en: And the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days: and they kept other seven days with gladness.

text.am: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ ሕዝቅያስ ስለ ቍርባን ሺህ ወይፈኖችና ሰባት ሺህ በጎች ለጉባኤው ሰጥቶ ነበርና፥ አለቆቹም ሺህ ወይፈኖችና አሥር ሺህ በጎች ለጉባኤው ሰጥተው ነበርና፥ ከካህናቱም እጅግ ብዙ ተቀድሰው ነበርና ጉባኤው ሁሉ እንደ ገና ሰባት ቀን በዓል ያደርጉ ዘንድ ተማከሩ፤ በደስታም እንደ ገና ሰባት ቀን በዓል አደረጉ።
text.en: For Hezekiah king of Judah did give to the congregation a thousand bullocks and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the congregation a thousand bullocks and ten thousand sheep: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.

text.am: የይሁዳም ጉባኤ ሁሉ፥ ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑ፥ ከእስራኤልም የመጡ ጉባኤ ሁሉ፥ ከእስራኤልም አገር የመጡትና በይሁዳ የኖሩት እንግዶች ደስ አላቸው።
text.en: And all the congregation of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the congregation that came out of Israel, and the strangers that came out of the land of Israel, and that dwelt in Judah, rejoiced.

text.am: በኢየሩሳሌምም ታላቅ ደስታ ሆነ፤ ከእስራኤል ንጉሥ ከዳዊት ልጅ ከሰሎሞን ዘመን ጀምሮ እንደዚህ ያለ በዓል በኢየሩሳሌም አልተደረገም ነበር።
text.en: So there was great joy in Jerusalem: for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel there was not the like in Jerusalem.

text.am: ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑም ተነሥተው ሕዝቡን ባረኩ፤ ድምፃቸውም ተሰማ፥ ጸሎታቸውም ወደ ቅዱስ መኖሪያው ወደ ሰማይ ዐረገ።
text.en: Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy dwelling place, even unto heaven.

text.am: ይህም ሁሉ በተፈጸመ ጊዜ በዚያ የተገኙ እስራኤል ሁሉ ወደ ይሁዳ ከተሞች ወጥተው ሁሉን ፈጽመው እስካጠፉአቸው ድረስ ሐውልቶቹን ሰባበሩ፥ የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶቹንም ቈረጡ፥ በይሁዳና በብንያምም ሁሉ ደግሞም በኤፍሬምና በምናሴ የነበሩትን የኮረብታው መስገጃዎችና መሠዊያዎች አፈረሱ። የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ ወደ ርስታቸውና ወደ ከተሞቻቸው ተመለሱ።
text.en: Now when all this was finished, all Israel that were present went out to the cities of Judah, and brake the images in pieces, and cut down the groves, and threw down the high places and the altars out of all Judah and Benjamin, in Ephraim also and Manasseh, until they had utterly destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, every man to his possession, into their own cities.

text.am: ሕዝቅያስም የካህናትንና የሌዋውያንን ሰሞን በየክፍላቸውና በየአገልግሎታቸው አቆመ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ በሮች የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕት ያቀርቡ ዘንድ፥ ያገለግሉም ዘንድ፥ ያመሰግኑም ያከብሩም ዘንድ ካህናቱንና ሌዋውያኑን አቆመ።
text.en: And Hezekiah appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites after their courses, every man according to his service, the priests and Levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the tents of the LORD.

text.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ሕግ እንደ ተጻፈ በጥዋትና በማታ፥ በሰንበታቱም፥ በመባቻዎቹም፥ በበዓላትም ለሚቀርበው ለሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ንጉሡ ከገንዘቡ የሚከፍለውን ወሰነ።
text.en: He appointed also the king's portion of his substance for the burnt offerings, to wit, for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in the law of the LORD.

text.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ለአገልግሎት እንዲጸኑ ለካህናቱና ለሌዋውያን ክፍላቸውን ይሰጡ ዘንድ በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩትን ሕዝብ አዘዘ።
text.en: Moreover he commanded the people that dwelt in Jerusalem to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might be encouraged in the law of the LORD.

text.am: ይህንም ነገር እንዳዘዘ የእስራኤል ልጆች የእህሉንና የወይኑን ጠጅ የዘይቱንና የማሩንም፥ የእርሻውንም ፍሬ ሁሉ በኵራት ሰጡ፤ የሁሉንም አሥራት አብዝተው አቀረቡ።
text.en: And as soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel brought in abundance the firstfruits of corn, wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly.

text.am: በይሁዳም ከተሞች የሚኖሩ የእስራኤልና የይሁዳ ልጆች የበሬውንና የበጉን አሥራት፥ ለአምላካቸውም ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰውን አሥራት አመጡ፥ ከምረውም አኖሩት።
text.en: And concerning the children of Israel and Judah, that dwelt in the cities of Judah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of holy things which were consecrated unto the LORD their God, and laid them by heaps.

text.am: በሦስተኛው ወር መከመር ጀመሩ፤ በሰባተኛውም ወር ጨረሱ።
text.en: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.

text.am: ሕዝቅያስና አለቆቹም መጥተው ክምሩን ባዩ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርና ሕዝቡን እስራኤልን ባረኩ።
text.en: And when Hezekiah and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed the LORD, and his people Israel.

text.am: ሕዝቅያስም ካህናቱንና ሌዋውያኑን ስለ ክምሩ ጠየቀ።
text.en: Then Hezekiah questioned with the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.

text.am: ከሳዶቅም ወገን የሆነ ዋነኛው ካህን ዓዛሪያስ። ሕዝቡ ቍርባኑን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ማቅረብ ከጀመረ ወዲህ በልተናል፥ ጠግበናልም፥ እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቡን ባርኮአልና ብዙ ተርፎአል፤ የተረፈውም ይህ ክምር ትልቅ ነው ብሎ ተናገረ።
text.en: And Azariah the chief priest of the house of Zadok answered him, and said, Since the people began to bring the offerings into the house of the LORD, we have had enough to eat, and have left plenty: for the LORD hath blessed his people; and that which is left is this great store.

text.am: ሕዝቅያስም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ጐተራ ያዘጋጁ ዘንድ አዘዘ፤ እነርሱም አዘጋጁ።
text.en: Then Hezekiah commanded to prepare chambers in the house of the LORD; and they prepared them,

text.am: ቍርባኑና አሥራቱን የተቀደሱትንም በእምነት ወደዚያ አገቡት። ሌዋዊውም ኮናንያ ተሾመባቸው፥ ወንድሙም ሰሜኢ በማዕርግ ሁለተኛ ነበረ፤
text.en: And brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully: over which Cononiah the Levite was ruler, and Shimei his brother was the next.

text.am: በንጉሡም በሕዝቅያስና በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አለቃ በዓዛርያስ ትእዛዝ ይሒዒል፥ ዓዛዝያ፥ ናሖት፥ አሣሄል፥ ይሬሞት፥ ዮዛባት፥ ኤሊኤል፥ ሰማኪያ፥ መሐት፥ በናያስ፥ ከኮናንያና ከወንድሙ ከሰሜኢ እጅ በታች ተቈጣጣሪዎች ነበሩ።
text.en: And Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benaiah, were overseers under the hand of Cononiah and Shimei his brother, at the commandment of Hezekiah the king, and Azariah the ruler of the house of God.

text.am: የሌዋዊውም የይምና ልጅ የምሥራቁ ደጅ በረኛ ቆሬ የእግዚአብሔርን መባና የተቀደሱትን ነገሮች እንዲያካፍል ሕዝቡ ለእግዚአብሔር በፈቃድ ባቀረቡት ላይ ተሾመ።
text.en: And Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter toward the east, was over the freewill offerings of God, to distribute the oblations of the LORD, and the most holy things.

text.am: በካህናቱም ከተሞች ለታላላቆችና ለታናናሾች ወንድሞቻቸው በየሰሞናቸው ክፍላቸውን በእምነት ይሰጡ ዘንድ ዔድን፥ ሚንያሚን፥ ኢያሱ፥ ሸማያ፥ አማርያ፥ ሴኬንያ ከእጁ በታች ነበሩ።
text.en: And next him were Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their set office, to give to their brethren by courses, as well to the great as to the small:

text.am: ከሦስትም ዓመት ወደ ላይ ላሉ በየሰሞናቸው ለሥራቸውና ለአገልግሎታቸው ዕለት ዕለት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ለሚገቡ ወንዶች ሁሉ፤
text.en: Beside their genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even unto every one that entereth into the house of the LORD, his daily portion for their service in their charges according to their courses;

text.am: በየአባቶቻቸውም ቤት ለተቈጠሩ ካህናት፥ ከሀያ ዓመትም ወደ ላይ ላሉ በየሥርዓታቸውና በየሰሞናቸው ለተቈጠሩ ሌዋውያን፥
text.en: Both to the genealogy of the priests by the house of their fathers, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their charges by their courses;

text.am: በማኅበሩም ሁሉ በየትውልዳቸው ለተቈጠሩ ለሕፃናቶቻቸውና ለሚስቶቻቸው ለወንዶችና ለሴቶች ልጆቻቸውም ይሰጡ ነበር፤ በእምነት ተቀድሰዋልና።
text.en: And to the genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation: for in their set office they sanctified themselves in holiness:

text.am: በየከተማይቱም ሁሉ በከተማቸው መሰምርያዎቹ ላሉ ለአሮን ልጆች ለካህናቱ፥ ከካህናቱም ወገን ላሉ ወንዶች ሁሉ፥ በትውልዳቸውም ለተቈጠሩ ሌዋውያን ሁሉ ክፍላቸውን ይሰጡ ዘንድ በስማቸው የተጻፉ ሰዎች ነበሩ።
text.en: Also of the sons of Aaron the priests, which were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities, in every several city, the men that were expressed by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all that were reckoned by genealogies among the Levites.

text.am: ሕዝቅያስም በይሁዳ ሁሉ እንዲህ አደረገ፤ በአምላኩም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መልካምንና ቅንን ነገር እውነትንም አደረገ።
text.en: And thus did Hezekiah throughout all Judah, and wrought that which was good and right and truth before the LORD his God.

text.am: ስለ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት አገልግሎት በጀመረው ሥራ ሁሉ፥ በሕጉና በትእዛዙም፥ አምላኩን ለመፈለግ በፍጹም ልቡ አደረገው፥ ተከናወነለትም።
text.en: And in every work that he began in the service of the house of God, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart, and prospered.

text.am: ከዚህም ነገርና ከዚህ እምነት በኋላ የአሦር ንጉሥ ሰናክሬም መጥቶ ወደ ይሁዳ ገባ፥ በተመሸጉትም ከተሞች ፊት ሰፈረ፥ ሊወስዳቸውም አሰበ።
text.en: After these things, and the establishment thereof, Sennacherib king of Assyria came, and entered into Judah, and encamped against the fenced cities, and thought to win them for himself.

text.am: ሕዝቅያስም ሰናክሬም እንደ መጣ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምንም ሊወጋ ፊቱን አንዳቀና ባየ ጊዜ፥
text.en: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib was come, and that he was purposed to fight against Jerusalem,

text.am: ከከተማይቱ በስተ ውጭ ያለውን የውኃውን ምንጭ ይደፍኑ ዘንድ ከአለቆቹና ከኃያላኑ ጋር ተማከረ፤ እነርሱም ረዱት።
text.en: He took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the fountains which were without the city: and they did help him.

text.am: እጅግም ሰዎች ተሰብስበው። የአሦር ነገሥታት መጥተው ብዙ ውኃ ስለ ምን ያገኛሉ? ብለው ምንጩን ሁሉ፥ በምድርም መካከል ይንዶለዶል የነበረውን ወንዝ ደፈኑ።
text.en: So there was gathered much people together, who stopped all the fountains, and the brook that ran through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Assyria come, and find much water?

text.am: ሰውነቱንም አጸናና፥ የፈረሰውንም ቅጥር ሁሉ ጠገነ፥ በላዩም ግንብ ሠራበት፥ ከእርሱም በስተ ውጭ ሌላ ቅጥር ሠራ፤ በዳዊትም ከተማ ያለችውን ሚሎን አጠነከረ፤ ብዙም መሣሪያና ጋሻ ሠራ።
text.en: Also he strengthened himself, and built up all the wall that was broken, and raised it up to the towers, and another wall without, and repaired Millo in the city of David, and made darts and shields in abundance.

text.am: የጦር አለቆቹንም በሕዝቡ ላይ ሾሞ፥ ሁሉንም በከተማይቱ በር ወዳለው አደባባይ ሰብስቦ።
text.en: And he set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the street of the gate of the city, and spake comfortably to them, saying,

text.am: ጽኑ፥ አይዞአችሁ፤ ከእኛም ጋር ያለው ከእርሱ ጋር ካለው ይበልጣልና ከአሦር ንጉሥና ከእርሱ ጋር ካለው ጭፍራ ሁሉ አትፍሩ፥ አትደንግጡም።
text.en: Be strong and courageous, be not afraid nor dismayed for the king of Assyria, nor for all the multitude that is with him: for there be more with us than with him:

text.am: ከእርሱ ጋር የሥጋ ክንድ ነው፤ ከእኛ ጋር ያለው ግን የሚረዳንና የሚዋጋልን አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ነው ብሎ አጸናናቸው። ሕዝቡም በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሕዝቅያስ ቃል ተጽናና።
text.en: With him is an arm of flesh; but with us is the LORD our God to help us, and to fight our battles. And the people rested themselves upon the words of Hezekiah king of Judah.

text.am: ከዚህም በኋላ የአሦር ንጉሥ ሰናክሬም ከሠራዊቱ ሁሉ ጋር በለኪሶ ፊት ሳለ ባሪያዎቹን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ወደ ሕዝቅያስና በኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ነበሩ ወደ ይሁዳ ሁሉ እንዲህ ሲል ላከ።
text.en: After this did Sennacherib king of Assyria send his servants to Jerusalem, (but he himself laid siege against Lachish, and all his power with him,) unto Hezekiah king of Judah, and unto all Judah that were at Jerusalem, saying,

text.am: የአሦር ንጉሥ ሰናክሬም እንዲህ ይላል። እናንተ በማን ተማምናችሁ በኢየሩሳሌም ምሽግ ትቀመጣላችሁ?
text.en: Thus saith Sennacherib king of Assyria, Whereon do ye trust, that ye abide in the siege in Jerusalem?

text.am: አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ከአሦር ንጉሥ እጅ ያድነናል እያለ በራብና በጥም እንድትሞቱ አሳልፎ ይሰጣችሁ ዘንድ የሚያባብላችሁ ሕዝቅያስ አይደለምን?
text.en: Doth not Hezekiah persuade you to give over yourselves to die by famine and by thirst, saying, The LORD our God shall deliver us out of the hand of the king of Assyria?

text.am: በአንድ መሠዊያ ፊት ስገዱ፥ በእርሱም ላይ ዕጠኑ እያለ ይሁዳንና ኢየሩሳሌምን አዝዞ፥ የኮረብታው መስገጃዎቹና መሠዊያዎቹን ያፈረሰ ይህ ሕዝቅያስ አይደለምን?
text.en: Hath not the same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Judah and Jerusalem, saying, Ye shall worship before one altar, and burn incense upon it?

text.am: እኔና አባቶቼ በምድር አሕዛብ ሁሉ ያደረግነውን አላወቃችሁምን? የምድርስ ሁሉ አሕዛብ አማልክት አገራቸውን ከእጄ ያድኑ ዘንድ በውኑ ተቻላቸውን?
text.en: Know ye not what I and my fathers have done unto all the people of other lands? were the gods of the nations of those lands any ways able to deliver their lands out of mine hand?

text.am: አምላካችሁስ ከእጄ እናንተን ለማዳን ይችል ዘንድ አባቶቼ ካጠፉአቸው ከአሕዛብ አማልክት ሁሉ ሕዝቡን ከእጄ ያድን ዘንድ የቻለ ማን ነው?
text.en: Who was there among all the gods of those nations that my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out of mine hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of mine hand?

text.am: አሁንም ሕዝቅያስ አያስታችሁ፥ እንዲህም አያባብላችሁ፥ አትመኑትም፤ ከአሕዛብና ከመንግሥታት አማልክት ሁሉ ሕዝቡን ከእጄና ከአባቶቼ እጅ ያድን ዘንድ ዘንድ ማንም አልቻለም፤ ይልቁንስ አምላካችሁ ከእጄ ያድናችሁ ዘንድ እንዴት ይችላል?
text.en: Now therefore let not Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you on this manner, neither yet believe him: for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of mine hand, and out of the hand of my fathers: how much less shall your God deliver you out of mine hand?

text.am: ባሪያዎቹም ደግሞ በአምላክ በእግዚአብሔርና በባሪያው በሕዝቅያስ ላይ ሌላ ብዙ ነገር ተናገሩ።
text.en: And his servants spake yet more against the LORD God, and against his servant Hezekiah.

text.am: ደግሞም የእስራኤልን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ለመስደብ፥ በእርሱም ላይ ለመናገር። የምድር አሕዛብ አማልክት ሕዝባቸውን ከእጄ ያድኑ ዘንድ እንዳልቻሉ፥ እንዲሁ የሕዝቅያስ አምላክ ሕዝቡን ከእጄ ያድን ዘንድ አይችልም የሚል ደብዳቤ ጻፈ።
text.en: He wrote also letters to rail on the LORD God of Israel, and to speak against him, saying, As the gods of the nations of other lands have not delivered their people out of mine hand, so shall not the God of Hezekiah deliver his people out of mine hand.

text.am: ከተማይቱንም እንዲወስዱ፥ በቅጥር ላይ የተቀመጡትን የኢየሩሳሌም ሕዝብ ያስፈሩና ያስደነግጡ ዘንድ፥ በታላቅ ድምፅ በዕብራይስጥ ቋንቋ ይጮኹባቸው ነበር።
text.en: Then they cried with a loud voice in the Jews' speech unto the people of Jerusalem that were on the wall, to affright them, and to trouble them; that they might take the city.

text.am: በሰውም እጅ በተሠሩ በምድር አሕዛብ አማልክት ላይ አንደሚናገሩ መጠን በኢየሩሳሌም አምላክ ላይ ተናገሩ።
text.en: And they spake against the God of Jerusalem, as against the gods of the people of the earth, which were the work of the hands of man.

text.am: ንጉሡም ሕዝቅያስና የአሞጽ ልጅ ነቢዩ ኢሳይያስ ስለዚህ ጸለዩ፥ ወደ ሰማይም ጮኹ።
text.en: And for this cause Hezekiah the king, and the prophet Isaiah the son of Amoz, prayed and cried to heaven.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም ጽኑዓን ኃያላኑንና መሳፍንቱን አለቆቹንም ከአሦር ንጉሥ ሰፈር እንዲያጠፋ መልአኩን ሰደደ። የአሦርም ንጉሥ አፍሮ ወደ አገሩ ተመለሰ። ወደ አምላኩም ቤት በገባ ጊዜ ከወገቡ የወጡት ልጆቹ በዚያ በሰይፍ ገደሉት።
text.en: And the LORD sent an angel, which cut off all the mighty men of valour, and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of Assyria. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. And when he was come into the house of his god, they that came forth of his own bowels slew him there with the sword.

text.am: እንዲሁም እግዚአብሔር ሕዝቅያስንና በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩትን ከአሦር ንጉሥ ከሰናክሬም እጅ ከሁሉም እጅ አዳናቸው፤ በዙሪያቸውም ካለው ሁሉ አሳረፋቸው።
text.en: Thus the LORD saved Hezekiah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Assyria, and from the hand of all other, and guided them on every side.

text.am: ብዙዎቹም ለእግዚአብሔር መባ ይዘው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይመጡ ነበር፥ ለይሁዳም ንጉሥ ለሕዝቅያስ እጅ መንሻ ይሰጡ ነበር፤ እርሱም ከዚህ ነገር በኋላ በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ፊት ከፍ ከፍ አለ።
text.en: And many brought gifts unto the LORD to Jerusalem, and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah: so that he was magnified in the sight of all nations from thenceforth.

text.am: በዚያም ወራት ሕዝቅያስ እስኪሞት ድረስ ታመመ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ጸለየ፤ እርሱም ተናገረው፥ ምልክትም ሰጠው።
text.en: In those days Hezekiah was sick to the death, and prayed unto the LORD: and he spake unto him, and he gave him a sign.

text.am: ሕዝቅያስ ግን እንደ ተቀበለው ቸርነት መጠን አላደረገም፥ ልቡም ኰራ፤ ስለዚህም በእርሱና በይሁዳ በኢየሩሳሌምም ላይ ቍጣ ሆነ።
text.en: But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit done unto him; for his heart was lifted up: therefore there was wrath upon him, and upon Judah and Jerusalem.

text.am: ሕዝቅያስም ከኢየሩሳሌም ሰዎች ጋር ስለ ልቡ ኵራት ሰውነቱን አዋረደ፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በሕዝቅያስ ዘመን አልመጣባቸውም።
text.en: Notwithstanding Hezekiah humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, so that the wrath of the LORD came not upon them in the days of Hezekiah.

text.am: ለሕዝቅያስም እጅግ ብዙ ሀብትና ክብር ነበረው፤ ለብርና ለወርቅም፥ ለከበረው ዕንቍና ለሽቱው፥ ለጋሻውና ለከበረው ዕቃ ሁሉ ግምጃ ቤቶች ሠራ።
text.en: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour: and he made himself treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of pleasant jewels;

text.am: ለእህልና ለወይን ጠጅም ለዘይትም ዕቃ ቤቶች፥ ለልዩ ልዩም እንስሳ ጋጥ፥ ለመንጎችም በረት ሠራ።
text.en: Storehouses also for the increase of corn, and wine, and oil; and stalls for all manner of beasts, and cotes for flocks.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም እጅግ ብዙ ጥሪት ሰጥቶት ነበርና ከተሞችን ሠራ፥ ብዙም የበግና የላም መንጋ ሰበሰበ።
text.en: Moreover he provided him cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance: for God had given him substance very much.

text.am: ይህም ሕዝቅያስ የላይኛውን የግዮንን ውኃ ምንጭ ደፈነ፥ በዳዊትም ከተማ በምዕራብ በኩል አቅንቶ አወረደው። የሕዝቅያስም ሥራ ሁሉ ተከናወነ።
text.en: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon, and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David. And Hezekiah prospered in all his works.

text.am: ነገር ግን የባቢሎን መሳፍንት መልእክተኞች በአገሩ ላይ ስለ ተደረገው ተአምራት ይጠይቁት ዘንድ ወደ እርሱ በተላኩ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔር ይፈትነውና በልቡ ያለውን ሁሉ ያውቅ ዘንድ ተወው።
text.en: Howbeit in the business of the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon, who sent unto him to enquire of the wonder that was done in the land, God left him, to try him, that he might know all that was in his heart.

text.am: የሕዝቅያስም የቀረው ነገር፥ ቸርነቱም፥ እነሆ፥ በአሞጽ ልጅ በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ ራእይ በይሁዳና በእስራኤልም ነገሥታት መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል።
text.en: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his goodness, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.

text.am: ሕዝቅያስም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በዳዊትም ልጆች መቃብር በላይኛው ክፍል ቀበሩት፤ በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌምም የሚኖሩ ሁሉ በሞቱ አከበሩት። ልጁም ምናሴ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።
text.en: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of David: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death. And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead.

text.am: ምናሴም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የአሥራ ሁለት ዓመት ልጅ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አምሳ አምስት ዓመት ነገሠ።
text.en: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign, and he reigned fifty and five years in Jerusalem:

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት እንዳወጣቸው እንደ አሕዛብ ያለ ርኵሰት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ነገር አደረገ።
text.en: But did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, like unto the abominations of the heathen, whom the LORD had cast out before the children of Israel.

text.am: አባቱም ሕዝቅያስ ያፈረሳቸውን የኮረብታውን መስገጃዎች መልሶ ሠራ፤ ለበኣሊምም መሠዊያ ሠራ፥ የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶችንም ተከለ፥ ለሰማይም ሠራዊት ሁሉ ሰገደ፥ አመለካቸውም።
text.en: For he built again the high places which Hezekiah his father had broken down, and he reared up altars for Baalim, and made groves, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served them.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ስሜ በኢየሩሳሌም ለዘላለም ይኖራል ባለው በእግዚአብሔር ቤት መሠዊያዎችን ሠራ።
text.en: Also he built altars in the house of the LORD, whereof the LORD had said, In Jerusalem shall my name be for ever.

text.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት በሁለቱ አደባባዮች ላይ ለሰማይ ሠራዊት ሁሉ መሠዊያዎችን ሠራ።
text.en: And he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD.

text.am: በሄኖምም ልጅ ሸለቆ ውስጥ ልጆቹን በእሳት አሳለፈ፤ ሞራ ገላጭም ሆነ፥ አስማትም አደረገ፥ መተተኛም ነበረ፥ መናፍስት ጠሪዎችንና ጠንቋዮችንም ሰበሰበ፤ ያስቈጣውም ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እጅግ ክፉ ነገር አደረገ።
text.en: And he caused his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom: also he observed times, and used enchantments, and used witchcraft, and dealt with a familiar spirit, and with wizards: he wrought much evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለዳዊትና ለልጁ ለሰሎሞን። በዚህ ቤት ከእስራኤልም ነገድ ሁሉ በመረጥኋት በኢየሩሳሌም ስሜን ለዘላለም አኖራለሁ፤ ያዘዝኋቸውንም ሁሉ፥ በሙሴ የተሰጠውን ሕግና ሥርዓት ፍርድንም ሁሉ ቢያደርጉ ቢጠብቁም፥ ለአባቶቻችሁ ከሰጠኋት ምድር የእስራኤልን እግር እንደ ገና አላርቅም ባለበት በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ የሠራውን የጣዖት የተቀረጸውን ምስል አቆመ።
text.en: And he set a carved image, the idol which he had made, in the house of God, of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen before all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለዳዊትና ለልጁ ለሰሎሞን። በዚህ ቤት ከእስራኤልም ነገድ ሁሉ በመረጥኋት በኢየሩሳሌም ስሜን ለዘላለም አኖራለሁ፤ ያዘዝኋቸውንም ሁሉ፥ በሙሴ የተሰጠውን ሕግና ሥርዓት ፍርድንም ሁሉ ቢያደርጉ ቢጠብቁም፥ ለአባቶቻችሁ ከሰጠኋት ምድር የእስራኤልን እግር እንደ ገና አላርቅም ባለበት በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ የሠራውን የጣዖት የተቀረጸውን ምስል አቆመ።
text.en: Neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from out of the land which I have appointed for your fathers; so that they will take heed to do all that I have commanded them, according to the whole law and the statutes and the ordinances by the hand of Moses.

text.am: ምናሴም እግዚአብሔር ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ካጠፋቸው ከአሕዛብ ይልቅ ክፉ ይሠሩ ዘንድ በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩትን አሳተ።
text.en: So Manasseh made Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem to err, and to do worse than the heathen, whom the LORD had destroyed before the children of Israel.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም ምናሴንና ሕዝቡን ተናገራቸው፤ ግን አልሰሙትም።
text.en: And the LORD spake to Manasseh, and to his people: but they would not hearken.

text.am: ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር የአሦርን ንጉሥ ሠራዊት አለቆች አመጣባቸው፤ ምናሴንም በዛንጅር ያዙት፥ በሰንሰለትም አስረው ወደ ባቢሎን ወሰዱት።
text.en: Wherefore the LORD brought upon them the captains of the host of the king of Assyria, which took Manasseh among the thorns, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

text.am: በተጨነቀም ጊዜ አምላኩን እግዚአብሔርን ፈለገ፥ በአባቶቹም አምላክ ፊት ሰውነቱን እጅግ አዋረደ፥
text.en: And when he was in affliction, he besought the LORD his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers,

text.am: ወደ እርሱም ጸለየ፤ እርሱም ተለመነው፥ ጸሎቱንም ሰማው፥ ወደ መንግሥቱም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መለሰው፤ ምናሴም እግዚአብሔር እርሱ አምላክ እንደ ሆነ አወቀ።
text.en: And prayed unto him: and he was intreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD he was God.

text.am: ከዚህ በኋላ በዳዊት ከተማ በስተ ውጭው ከግዮን ምዕራብ በሸለቆው ውስጥ እስከ ዓሳ በር መግቢያ ድረስ ቅጥር ሠራ። በዖፌልም አዞረበት፥ እጅግም ከፍ አደረገው፤ በተመሸጉትም በይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ የጭፍራ አለቆችን አኖረ።
text.en: Now after this he built a wall without the city of David, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entering in at the fish gate, and compassed about Ophel, and raised it up a very great height, and put captains of war in all the fenced cities of Judah.

text.am: እንግዶችንም አማልክትና ጣዖቱንም ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት አራቀ፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ባለበት ተራራ ላይና በኢየሩሳሌም የሠራቸውን መሠዊያዎች ሁሉ ወስዶ ከከተማይቱ በስተ ውጭ ጣላቸው።
text.en: And he took away the strange gods, and the idol out of the house of the LORD, and all the altars that he had built in the mount of the house of the LORD, and in Jerusalem, and cast them out of the city.

text.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም መሠዊያ ደግሞ አደሰ፥ የደኅንነትና የምስጋናም መሥዋዕት ሠዋበት፤ ይሁዳም የእስራኤልን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን እንዲያመልኩ አዘዘ።
text.en: And he repaired the altar of the LORD, and sacrificed thereon peace offerings and thank offerings, and commanded Judah to serve the LORD God of Israel.

text.am: ሕዝቡ ግን ገና በኮረብታው መስገጃዎች ይሠዋ ነበር፤ ቢሆንም ለአምላኩ ለእግዚአብሔር ብቻ ነበር።
text.en: Nevertheless the people did sacrifice still in the high places, yet unto the LORD their God only.

text.am: የምናሴም የቀረው ነገር፥ ወደ አምላኩም የጸለየው ጸሎት፥ በእስራኤልም አምላክ በእግዚአብሔር ስም የነገሩት የነቢያት ቃል፥ እነሆ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል።
text.en: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer unto his God, and the words of the seers that spake to him in the name of the LORD God of Israel, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel.

text.am: ደግሞም ጸሎቱ፥ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተለመነው፥ ኃጢያቱና መተላለፉ ሁሉ፥ ራሱንም ሳያዋርድ የኮረብታው መስገጃዎችን የሠራበት የማምለኪያ ዐፀዱንና የተቀረጹትንም ምስሎች የተከለበት ስፍራ፥ እነሆ፥ በባለ ራእዩ ታሪክ መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል።
text.en: His prayer also, and how God was intreated of him, and all his sin, and his trespass, and the places wherein he built high places, and set up groves and graven images, before he was humbled: behold, they are written among the sayings of the seers.

text.am: ምናሴም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፥ በቤቱም ቀበሩት፤ ልጁም አሞጽ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።
text.en: So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house: and Amon his son reigned in his stead.

text.am: አሞጽ መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ ሁለት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሁለት ዓመት ነገሠ።
text.en: Amon was two and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned two years in Jerusalem.

text.am: አባቱም ምናሴ እንዳደረገ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ፤ አሞጽም አባቱ ምናሴ ለሠራቸው ለተቀረጹት ምስሎች ሁሉ ሠዋ፥ አመለካቸውም።
text.en: But he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, as did Manasseh his father: for Amon sacrificed unto all the carved images which Manasseh his father had made, and served them;

text.am: አባቱም ምናሴ ሰውነቱን እንዳዋረደ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አንዳላዋረደ በእግዚአብሔርም ሰውነቱን አላዋረደም፤ ነገር ግን አሞጽ መተላለፉን እጅግ አበዛ።
text.en: And humbled not himself before the LORD, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself; but Amon trespassed more and more.

text.am: ባሪያዎቹም ተማምለው በቤቱ ገደሉት።
text.en: And his servants conspired against him, and slew him in his own house.

text.am: የአገሩ ሕዝብ ግን በንጉሡ በአሞጽ ላይ የተማማሉትን ሁሉ ገደሉ፤ የአገሩም ሕዝብ ልጁን ኢዮስያስን በእርሱ ፋንታ አነገሡ።
text.en: But the people of the land slew all them that had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his stead.

text.am: ኢዮስያስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የስምንት ዓመት ልጅ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሠላሳ አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ።
text.en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem one and thirty years.

text.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ፥ በአባቱም በዳዊት መንገድ ሄደ፤ ወደ ቀኝም ወደ ግራም አላለም።
text.en: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined neither to the right hand, nor to the left.

text.am: በነገሠም በስምንተኛው ዓመት ገና ብላቴና ሳለ የአባቱን የዳዊትን አምላክ ይፈልግ ጀመር፤ በአሥራ ሁለተኛውም ዓመት ይሁዳንና ኢየሩሳሌምን ከኮረብታው መስገጃዎችና ከማምለኪያ ዐፀዶቹ፥ ከተቀረጹትና ቀልጠው ከተሠሩት ምስሎች ያነጻ ጀመር።
text.en: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of David his father: and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem from the high places, and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images.

text.am: የበኣሊምንም መሠዊያዎች በፊቱ አፈረሱ፤ በላዩም የነበሩትን የፀሐዩን ምስሎች የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶቹንም ቈረጠ፤ የተቀረጹትንና ቀልጠው የተሠሩትን ምስሎች ሰባበረ፥ አደቀቃቸውም፥ ይሠዉላቸው በነበሩት ሰዎች መቃብርም ላይ በተናቸው።
text.en: And they brake down the altars of Baalim in his presence; and the images, that were on high above them, he cut down; and the groves, and the carved images, and the molten images, he brake in pieces, and made dust of them, and strowed it upon the graves of them that had sacrificed unto them.

text.am: የካህናቶቻቸውንም አጥንት በመሠዊያቸው ላይ አቃጠለ፤ ይሁዳንና ኢየሩሳሌምን አንጻ።
text.en: And he burnt the bones of the priests upon their altars, and cleansed Judah and Jerusalem.

text.am: የምናሴንና የኤፍሬምንም የስምዖንና የንፍታሌምንም ከተሞች፥ በዙሪያቸውም ያለውን ቦታ እንዲሁ አነጻ።
text.en: And so did he in the cities of Manasseh, and Ephraim, and Simeon, even unto Naphtali, with their mattocks round about.

text.am: መሠዊያዎቹንም አፈረሰ፥ የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶቹንና የተቀረጹትን ምስሎች አደቀቀ፥ በእስራኤልም አገር ሁሉ የፀሐይን ምስሎች ሁሉ ቈራረጠ፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ተመለሰ።
text.en: And when he had broken down the altars and the groves, and had beaten the graven images into powder, and cut down all the idols throughout all the land of Israel, he returned to Jerusalem.

text.am: በነገሠም በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት ምድሪቱንና የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ካነጻ በኋላ፥ የኤዜልያስ ልጅ ሳፋን፥ የከተማይቱም አለቃ መዕሤያ፥ ታሪክ ጸሐፊም የኢዮአካዝ ልጅ ኢዮአክ የእግዚአብሔርን የአምላኩን ቤት ይጠግኑ ዘንድ ሰደዳቸው።
text.en: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land, and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of the LORD his God.

text.am: ወደ ታላቁም ካህን ወደ ኬልቅያስ መጡ፤ ሌዋውያኑም በረኞች ከምናሴና ከኤፍሬም ከቀረውም ከእስራኤል ሁሉ፥ ከይሁዳና ከብንያም ሁሉ በኢየሩሳሌምም ከሚኖሩት የሰበሰቡትን፥ ወደ እግዚእብሔር ቤት የቀረበውን ገንዘብ ሰጡት።
text.en: And when they came to Hilkiah the high priest, they delivered the money that was brought into the house of God, which the Levites that kept the doors had gathered of the hand of Manasseh and Ephraim, and of all the remnant of Israel, and of all Judah and Benjamin; and they returned to Jerusalem.

text.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት በሚሠሩት ላይ ለተሾሙት ሰጡ፤ እነርሱም ይጠግኑና ያድሱ ዘንድ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ለሚሠሩ ሠራተኞች ሰጡ።
text.en: And they put it in the hand of the workmen that had the oversight of the house of the LORD, and they gave it to the workmen that wrought in the house of the LORD, to repair and amend the house:

text.am: የይሁዳ ነገሥታት ላፈረሱት ቤት ሰረገሎች ያደርጉ ዘንድ፥ ለማጋጠሚያም እንጨት የተጠረበውንም ድንጋይ ይገዙ ዘንድ ለአናጢዎችና ለጠራቢዎች ሰጡ።
text.en: Even to the artificers and builders gave they it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to floor the houses which the kings of Judah had destroyed.

text.am: ሰዎቹም ሥራውን በመታመን አደረጉ፤ በእነርሱም ላይ የተሾሙት፥ ሥራውንም የሚያሠሩት ሌዋውያን ከሜራሪ ልጆች ኢኤትና አብድዩ፥ ከቀዓትም ልጆች ዘካርያስና ሜሱላም ነበሩ። ከሌዋውያንም ወገን በዜማ ዕቃ አዋቂዎች የነበሩ ሁሉ
text.en: And the men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set it forward; and other of the Levites, all that could skill of instruments of musick.

text.am: በተሸካሚዎችና ልዩ ልዩ ሥራ በሚሠሩ ላይ ተሾመው ነበር፤ ጸሐፊዎቹና አለቆቹም በረኞቹም ከሌዋውያን ወገን ነበሩ።
text.en: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and were overseers of all that wrought the work in any manner of service: and of the Levites there were scribes, and officers, and porters.

text.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት የቀረበውን ገንዘብ ባመጡ ጊዜ ካህኑ ኬልቅያስም በሙሴ እጅ የተሰጠውን የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ መጽሐፍ አገኘ።
text.en: And when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of the LORD, Hilkiah the priest found a book of the law of the LORD given by Moses.

text.am: ኬልቅያስም ጸሐፊውን ሳፋንን። የሕጉን መጽሐፍ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አግኝቼአለሁ ብሎ ተናገረው። ኬልቅያስም መጽሐፉን ለሳፋን ሰጠው።
text.en: And Hilkiah answered and said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of the LORD. And Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.

text.am: ሳፋንም መጽሐፉን ወደ ንጉሡ አመጣ፤ ለንጉሡም። ባሪያዎችህ የተሰጣቸውን ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ያደርጋሉ፤
text.en: And Shaphan carried the book to the king, and brought the king word back again, saying, All that was committed to thy servants, they do it.

text.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የተገኘውን ገንዘብ አፈሰሱ፥ በሥራውም ላይ ለተሾሙትና ለሠራተኞቹ ሰጡ ብሎ አወራለት።
text.en: And they have gathered together the money that was found in the house of the LORD, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and to the hand of the workmen.

text.am: ጸሐፊውም ሳፋን ለንጉሡ። ካህኑ ኬልቅያስ መጽሐፍ ሰጠኝ ብሎ ነገረው። ሳፋንም በንጉሡ ፊት አነበበው።
text.en: Then Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest hath given me a book. And Shaphan read it before the king.

text.am: ንጉሡም የሕጉን ቃል በሰማ ጊዜ ልብሱን ቀደደ።
text.en: And it came to pass, when the king had heard the words of the law, that he rent his clothes.

text.am: ንጉሡም ኬልቅያስን፥ የሳፋንንም ልጅ አኪቃምን፥ የሚክያስንም ልጅ ዓብዶንን፥ ጸሐፊውንም ሳፋንን፥ የንጉሡንም ብላቴና ዓሳያን።
text.en: And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king's, saying,

text.am: በዚህ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈውን ሁሉ ያደርጉ ዘንድ አባቶቻችን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስላልጠበቁ፥ በላያችን የነደደ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ እጅግ ነውና ሄዳችሁ ስለ ተገኘው የመጽሐፍ ቃል ለእኔ በእስራኤልና በይሁዳም ለቀሩት እግዚአብሔርን ጠይቁ ብሎ አዘዛቸው።
text.en: Go, enquire of the LORD for me, and for them that are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that is found: for great is the wrath of the LORD that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the LORD, to do after all that is written in this book.

text.am: ኬልቅያስና እነዚያ ንጉሥ ያዘዛቸው ወደ ልብስ ጠባቂው ወደ ሐስራ ልጅ ወደ ቲቁዋ ልጅ ወደ ሴሌም ሚስት ወደ ነቢይቱ ወደ ሕልዳና ሄዱ፤ እርስዋም በኢየሩሳሌም በከተማይቱ በሁለተኛው ክፍል ተቀምጣ ነበር፤ ይህንም ነገር ነገሩአት።
text.en: And Hilkiah, and they that the king had appointed, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the college:) and they spake to her to that effect.

text.am: እርስዋም አለቻቸው። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ወደ እኔ ለላካችሁ ሰው እንዲህ ብላችሁ ንገሩት።
text.en: And she answered them, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Tell ye the man that sent you to me,

text.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። እነሆ፥ በይሁዳ ንጉሥ ፊት በተነበበው መጽሐፍ የተጻፉትን ቃላት ሁሉ፥ ማለት ክፉ ነገርን፥ በዚህ ስፍራና በሚኖሩበት ላይ አመጣለሁ።
text.en: Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Judah:

text.am: በእጃቸው ሥራ ሁሉ ሊያስቈጡኝ ትተውኛልና፥ ለሌሎችም አማልክት ዐጥነዋልና ቍጣዬ በዚህ ስፍራ ይነድዳል፥ አይጠፋምም።
text.en: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense unto other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore my wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and shall not be quenched.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርን ለመጠየቅ ለላካችሁ ለይሁዳ ንጉሥ እንዲህ በሉት። የእስራኤል አምላክ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል። ስለ ሰማኸው ቃል ልብህ ገር ሆኖአልና፥
text.en: And as for the king of Judah, who sent you to enquire of the LORD, so shall ye say unto him, Thus saith the LORD God of Israel concerning the words which thou hast heard;

text.am: በፊቴም ራስህን አዋርደሃልና፥ በዚህም ስፍራና በሚኖሩበት ላይ ቃሌን በሰማህ ጊዜ ራስህን አዋርደሃልና፥ ልብስህንም ቀድደህ በፊቴ አለቅሰሃልና እኔ ደግሞ ሰምቼአለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።
text.en: Because thine heart was tender, and thou didst humble thyself before God, when thou heardest his words against this place, and against the inhabitants thereof, and humbledst thyself before me, and didst rend thy clothes, and weep before me; I have even heard thee also, saith the LORD.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ወደ አባቶችህ እሰበስብሃለሁ፥ በሰላምም ወደ መቃብርህ ትሰበሰባለህ፤ በዚህም ስፍራና በሚኖሩበት ላይ የማመጣውን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ ዓይኖችህ አያዩም። ይህንም ለንጉሥ አወሩለት።
text.en: Behold, I will gather thee to thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace, neither shall thine eyes see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants of the same. So they brought the king word again.

text.am: ንጉሡም ላከ፥ የይሁዳንና የኢየሩሳሌምንም ሽማግሌዎች ሁሉ ሰበሰበ።
text.en: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.

text.am: ንጉሡም የይሁዳም ሰዎች ሁሉ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም የሚኖሩና ካህናቱ፥ ሌዋውያኑም፥ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ከታናሹ ጀምሮ እስከ ታላቁ ድረስ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ወጡ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት የተገኘውን የቃል ኪዳኑን መጽሐፍ ቃል ሁሉ በጆሮአቸው አነበበ።
text.en: And the king went up into the house of the LORD, and all the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of the LORD.

text.am: ንጉሡም በስፍራው ቆሞ እግዚአብሔርን ተከትሎ እንዲሄድ፥ ትእዛዙንና ምስክሩን ሥርዓቱንም በፍጹም ልቡና በፍጹም ነፍሱ እንዲጠብቅ፥ በዚህም መጽሐፍ የተጻፈውን የቃል ኪዳን ቃል እንዲያደርግ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ።
text.en: And the king stood in his place, and made a covenant before the LORD, to walk after the LORD, and to keep his commandments, and his testimonies, and his statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant which are written in this book.

text.am: በኢየሩሳሌምና በብንያምም የተገኙትን ሁሉ በዚህ ነገር አማለ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም የሚኖሩት የአባቶቻቸው አምላክ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን እንዳዘዘ አደረጉ።
text.en: And he caused all that were present in Jerusalem and Benjamin to stand to it. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem did according to the covenant of God, the God of their fathers.

text.am: ኢዮስያስም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ምድር ሁሉ ርኩሱን ሁሉ አስወገደ፥ በእስራኤልም የተገኙትን ሁሉ አምላካቸውን እግዚአብሔርን እንዲያመልኩ አደረገ። በዘመኑ ሁሉ የአባቶቻቸውን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ከመከተል አልራቁም።
text.en: And Josiah took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Israel, and made all that were present in Israel to serve, even to serve the LORD their God. And all his days they departed not from following the LORD, the God of their fathers.

text.am: ኢዮስያስም ለእግዚአብሔር በኢየሩሳሌም ፋሲካ አደረገ፤ በመጀመሪያውም ወር በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን ፋሲካውን አረዱ።
text.en: Moreover Josiah kept a passover unto the LORD in Jerusalem: and they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.

text.am: ካህናቱንም በየሥርዓታቸውም አቆመ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ያገለግሉ ዘንድ አጸናቸው።
text.en: And he set the priests in their charges, and encouraged them to the service of the house of the LORD,

text.am: እስራኤልንም ሁሉ ያስተምሩ ለነበሩት፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ለተቀደሱት ሌዋውያን እንዲህ አለ። ቅዱሱን ታቦት የእስራኤል ንጉሥ የዳዊት ልጅ ሰሎሞን በሠራው ቤት ውስጥ አኑሩት፤ ከዚህም በኋላ በትከሻችሁ ላይ ሸክም አይሆንባችሁም፤ አሁንም አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርንና ሕዝቡን እስራኤልን አገልግሉ፤
text.en: And said unto the Levites that taught all Israel, which were holy unto the LORD, Put the holy ark in the house which Solomon the son of David king of Israel did build; it shall not be a burden upon your shoulders: serve now the LORD your God, and his people Israel,

text.am: የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ዳዊት እንደ ጻፈው ልጁም ሰሎሞን እንደ ጻፈው በየሰሞናችሁና በየአባቶቻችሁ ቤቶች ተዘጋጁ፤
text.en: And prepare yourselves by the houses of your fathers, after your courses, according to the writing of David king of Israel, and according to the writing of Solomon his son.

text.am: እንደ ሕዝቡም ልጆች እንደ ወንድሞቻችሁ በየአባቶች ቤቶች ሆናችሁ በመቅደሱ ቁሙ፤ የሌዋውያንም ነገድ በየወገናቸው እንደ ተከፈሉ እናንተ ተከፈሉ፤ ፋሲካውንም እረዱ፥
text.en: And stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the families of the fathers of your brethren the people, and after the division of the families of the Levites.

text.am: እናንተም ተቀደሱ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በሙሴ እጅ የተናገረውን ቃል ያደርጉ ዘንድ ለወንድሞቻችሁ አዘጋጁ።
text.en: So kill the passover, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare your brethren, that they may do according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

text.am: ኢዮስያስም ለፋሲካው መሥዋዕት እንዲሆን በዚያ ለነበሩት ለሕዝቡ ልጆች ከመንጋው ሠላሳ ሺህ የበግና የፍየል ጠቦቶች፥ ሦስት ሺህም ወይፈኖች ሰጣቸው፤ እነዚህም ከንጉሡ ሀብት ነበሩ።
text.en: And Josiah gave to the people, of the flock, lambs and kids, all for the passover offerings, for all that were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bullocks: these were of the king's substance.

text.am: መሳፍንቱም ለሕዝቡና ለካህናቱ ለሌዋውያኑም በፈቃዳቸው ሰጡ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቤት አለቆች፥ ኬልቂያስ፥ ዘካሪያስ፥ ይሒኤል፥ ለፋሲካው መሥዋዕት እንዲሆን ሁለት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ በጎችና ፍየሎች፥ ሦስት መቶም በሬዎች ለካህናቱ ሰጡ።
text.en: And his princes gave willingly unto the people, to the priests, and to the Levites: Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave unto the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred small cattle, and three hundred oxen.

text.am: የሌዋውያኑም አለቆች ኮናንያ፥ ወንድሞቹም ሸማያና ናትናኤል፥ ሐሸቢያ፥ ይዒኤል፥ ዮዛባት ለፋሲካው መሥዋዕት እንዲሆን አምስት ሺህ በጎችና ፍየሎች፥ አምስት መቶም በሬዎች ለሌዋውያን ሰጡ።
text.en: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethaneel, his brethren, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, chief of the Levites, gave unto the Levites for passover offerings five thousand small cattle, and five hundred oxen.

text.am: አገልግሎቱም ተዘጋጀ፥ ካህናቱም በስፍራቸው፥ ሌዋውያኑም በየክፍላቸው እንደ ንጉሥ ትእዛዝ ቆሙ።
text.en: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their courses, according to the king's commandment.

text.am: ፋሲካውንም አረዱ፥ ሌዋውያኑም ቁርበቱን ገፈፉ፥ ካህናቱም ከእጃቸው የተቀበሉትን ደም ረጩ።
text.en: And they killed the passover, and the priests sprinkled the blood from their hands, and the Levites flayed them.

text.am: በሙሴም መጽሐፍ እንደ ተጻፈ ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀርቡ ዘንድ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች ለሕዝቡ ልጆች እንዲሰጡ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ለዩ። እንዲሁም በበሬዎቹ አደረጉ።
text.en: And they removed the burnt offerings, that they might give according to the divisions of the families of the people, to offer unto the LORD, as it is written in the book of Moses. And so did they with the oxen.

text.am: ፋሲካውንም እንደ ሥርዓቱ በእሳት ጠበሱ፤ የተቀደሰውንም ቍርባን በምንቸትና በሰታቴ በድስትም ቀቀሉ፥ ለሕዝቡም ልጆች ሁሉ በፍጥነት አደረሱ።
text.en: And they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance: but the other holy offerings sod they in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and divided them speedily among all the people.

text.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ለራሳቸውና ለካህናቱ አዘጋጁ፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ካህናቱ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና ስቡን ለማቅረብ እስከ ሌሊት ድረስ ይሠሩ ነበርና ስለዚህ ሌዋውያን ለራሳቸውና ለአሮን ልጆች ለካህናቱ አዘጋጁ።
text.en: And afterward they made ready for themselves, and for the priests: because the priests the sons of Aaron were busied in offering of burnt offerings and the fat until night; therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aaron.

text.am: የአሳፍም ልጆች መዘምራን እንደ ዳዊት፥ እንደ አሣፍም እንደ ኤማንም የንጉሡም ባለ ራእይ እንደ ነበረው እንደ ኤዶታም ትእዛዝ በየስፍራቸው ነበሩ፤ በረኞቹም በሮቹን ሁሉ ይጠብቁ ነበር፤ ወንድሞቻቸውም ሌዋውያን ያዘጋጁላቸው ነበርና ከአገልግሎታቸው ይርቁ ዘንድ አያስፈልጋቸውም ነበር።
text.en: And the singers the sons of Asaph were in their place, according to the commandment of David, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king's seer; and the porters waited at every gate; they might not depart from their service; for their brethren the Levites prepared for them.

text.am: እንደ ንጉሡም እንደ ኢዮስያስ ትእዛዝ በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ላይ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ያቀርቡ ዘንድ፥ ፋሲካውንም ያደርጉ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር አገልግሎት ሁሉ በዚያ ቀን ተዘጋጀ።
text.en: So all the service of the LORD was prepared the same day, to keep the passover, and to offer burnt offerings upon the altar of the LORD, according to the commandment of king Josiah.

text.am: የተገኙትም የእስራኤል ልጆች በዚያ ቀን ፋሲካውን፥ ሰባት ቀንም የቂጣ በዓልን አደረጉ።
text.en: And the children of Israel that were present kept the passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.

text.am: ከነቢዩ ከሳሙኤል ዘመን ጀምሮ እንደዚህ ያለ ፋሲካ በእስራኤል ዘንድ ከቶ አልተደረገም፤ ከእስራኤልም ነገሥታት ሁሉ ኢዮስያስና ካህናቱ፥ ሌዋውያኑም፥ በዚያም የተገኙ የይሁዳና የእስራኤል ሰዎች ሁሉ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም የሚኖሩት እንዳደረጉት ያለ ፋሲካ ያደረገ የለም።
text.en: And there was no passover like to that kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet; neither did all the kings of Israel keep such a passover as Josiah kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Judah and Israel that were present, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

text.am: ይህም ፋሲካ ኢዮስያስ በነገሠ በአሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት ተደረገ።
text.en: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josiah was this passover kept.

text.am: ከዚህም ሁሉ በኋላ፥ ኢዮስያስም ቤተ መቅደሱን ካሰናዳ በኋላ፥ የግብጽ ንጉሥ ኒካዑ በኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ አጠገብ ባለው በከርከሚሽ ላይ ይዋጋ ዘንድ ወጣ፤ ኢዮስያስም ሊጋጠመው ወጣ።
text.en: After all this, when Josiah had prepared the temple, Necho king of Egypt came up to fight against Carchemish by Euphrates: and Josiah went out against him.

text.am: እርሱም። የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ ከአንተ ጋር ምን አለኝ? በምዋጋበት በሌላ ቤት ላይ ነው እንጂ በአንተ ላይ ዛሬ አልመጣሁም፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንድቸኵል አዝዞኛል፤ ከእኔ ጋር ያለው እግዚአብሔር እንዳያጠፋህ ይህን በእርሱ ላይ ከማድረግ ተመለስ ብሎ መልእክተኞችን ላከበት።
text.en: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, What have I to do with thee, thou king of Judah? I come not against thee this day, but against the house wherewith I have war: for God commanded me to make haste: forbear thee from meddling with God, who is with me, that he destroy thee not.

text.am: ኢዮስያስ ግን ይዋጋው ዘንድ ተጸናና እንጂ ፊቱን ከእርሱ አልመለሰም፤ በእግዚአብሔርም አፍ የተነገረውን የኒካዑን ቃል አልሰማም፥ በመጊዶም ሸለቆ ይዋጋ ዘንድ መጣ።
text.en: Nevertheless Josiah would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and hearkened not unto the words of Necho from the mouth of God, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.

text.am: ቀስተኞችም ንጉሡን ኢዮስያስን ወጉት፤ ንጉሡም ብላቴናዎቹን። አጥብቄ ቈስያለሁና ከሰልፉ ውስጥ አውጡኝ አላቸው።
text.en: And the archers shot at king Josiah; and the king said to his servants, Have me away; for I am sore wounded.

text.am: ብላቴኖቹም ከሰረገላው አውርደው ለእርሱ በነበረው በሁለተኛው ሰረገላ ውስጥ አስቀመጡት፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም አመጡት፤ እርሱም ሞተ፥ በአባቶቹም መቃብር ተቀበረ፤ ይሁዳና ኢየሩሳሌምም ሁሉ ለኢዮስያስ አለቀሱ።
text.en: His servants therefore took him out of that chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had; and they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died, and was buried in one of the sepulchres of his fathers. And all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

text.am: ኤርምያስም ለኢዮስያስ የልቅሶ ግጥም ገጠመለት፤ እስከ ዛሬም ድረስ ወንዶችና ሴቶች መዘምራን ሁሉ በልቅሶ ግጥማቸው ስለ ኢዮስያስ ይናገሩ ነበር፤ ይህም በእስራኤል ዘንድ ወግ ሆኖ በልቅሶ ግጥም ተጽፎአል።
text.en: And Jeremiah lamented for Josiah: and all the singing men and the singing women spake of Josiah in their lamentations to this day, and made them an ordinance in Israel: and, behold, they are written in the lamentations.

text.am: የቀረውም የኢዮስያስ ነገር፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ሕግ እንደተጻፈ ያደረገው ቸርነት፥
text.en: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his goodness, according to that which was written in the law of the LORD,

text.am: የፊተኛውና የኋለኛውም ነገሩ፥ እነሆ፥ በእስራኤልና በይሁዳ ነገሥታት መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል።
text.en: And his deeds, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

text.am: የአገሩም ሰዎች የኢዮስያስን ልጅ ኢዮአክስን ወስደው በአባቱ ፋንታ በኢየሩሳሌም አነገሡት።
text.en: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and made him king in his father's stead in Jerusalem.

text.am: ኢዮአክስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ ሦስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሦስት ወር ነገሠ።
text.en: Jehoahaz was twenty and three years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months in Jerusalem.

text.am: የግብጽም ንጉሥ በኢየሩሳሌም ከመንግሥቱ አወጣው፥ መቶም መክሊት ብርና አንድ መክሊት ወርቅ ዕዳ ጣለበት።
text.en: And the king of Egypt put him down at Jerusalem, and condemned the land in an hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

text.am: የግብጽም ንጉሥ ወንድሙን ኤልያቄምን በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ አነገሠ፥ ስሙንም ኢዮአቄም ብሎ ለወጠ፤ ኒካዑም ወንድሙን ኢዮአክስን ይዞ ወደ ግብፅ ወሰደው።
text.en: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, and turned his name to Jehoiakim. And Necho took Jehoahaz his brother, and carried him to Egypt.

text.am: ኢዮአቄምም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ አምስት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አሥራ አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ በአምላኩም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ።
text.en: Jehoiakim was twenty and five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD his God.

text.am: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር በእርሱ ላይ መጥቶ ወደ ባቢሎን ይወስደው ዘንድ በሰንሰለት አሰረው።
text.en: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Babylon.

text.am: ናቡከደነፆርም ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት ዕቃ አያሌውን ወደ ባቢሎን አፈለሰ፥ በባቢሎንም በመቅደሱ ውስጥ አኖረው።
text.en: Nebuchadnezzar also carried of the vessels of the house of the LORD to Babylon, and put them in his temple at Babylon.

text.am: የቀረውም የኢዮአቄም ነገር፥ ያደረገውም ርኵሰት፥ በእርሱም የተገኘው ሁሉ፥ እነሆ፥ በእስራኤልና በይሁዳ ነገሥታት መጽሐፍ ተጽፎአል፤ ልጁም ዮአኪን በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።
text.en: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his stead.

text.am: ዮአኪንም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የአሥራ ስምንት ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሦስት ወርና አሥር ቀን ነገሠ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ አደረገ።
text.en: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD.

text.am: ዓመቱ ባለፈ ጊዜ ንጉሡ ናቡከደነፆር ልኮ ወደ ባቢሎን ወሰደው፥ የከበረውንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ዕቃ ከእርሱ ጋር አስወሰደ፤ ወንድሙንም ሴዴቅያስን በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ አነገሠ።
text.en: And when the year was expired, king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of the house of the LORD, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.

text.am: ሴዴቅያስ መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሀያ አንድ ዓመት ጕልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም አሥራ አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ።
text.en: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

text.am: በአምላኩም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም አፍ በተናገረው በነቢዩ በኤርሚያስ ፊት ራሱን አላወረደም።
text.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD his God, and humbled not himself before Jeremiah the prophet speaking from the mouth of the LORD.

text.am: ደግሞም በእግዚአብሔር አምሎት በነበረው በንጉሡ በናቡከደነፆር ላይ ዐመፀ፤ ወደ እስራኤልም አምላክ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንዳይመለስ አንገቱን አደነደነ ልቡንም አጠነከረ።
text.en: And he also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by God: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart from turning unto the LORD God of Israel.

text.am: ደግሞም የካህናቱ አለቆች ሁሉ ሕዝቡም እንደ አሕዛብ ያለ ርኵሰት ሁሉ መተላለፍን አበዙ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም የቀደሰውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት አረከሱ።
text.en: Moreover all the chief of the priests, and the people, transgressed very much after all the abominations of the heathen; and polluted the house of the LORD which he had hallowed in Jerusalem.

text.am: የአባቶቻቸውም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡና ለማደሪያው ስላዘነ ማለዳ ተነሥቶ በመልእክተኞቹ እጅ ወደ እነርሱ ይልክ ነበር።
text.en: And the LORD God of their fathers sent to them by his messengers, rising up betimes, and sending; because he had compassion on his people, and on his dwelling place:

text.am: እነርሱ ግን የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በሕዝቡ ላይ እስኪወጣ ድረስ፥ ፈውስም እስከማይገኝላቸው ድረስ፥ በእግዚአብሔር መልእክተኞች ይሳለቁ፥ ቃሉንም ያቃልሉ፥ በነቢያቱም ላይ ያፌዙ ነበር።
text.en: But they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and misused his prophets, until the wrath of the LORD arose against his people, till there was no remedy.

text.am: ስለዚህም የከለዳውያንን ንጉሥ አመጣባቸው፤ እርሱም ጕልማሶቻቸውን በቤተ መቅደሱ ውስጥ በሰይፍ ገደላቸው፤ ጕልማሳውንና ቈንጆይቱን ሽማግሌውንና አሮጌውን አልማረም፤ ሁሉንም በእጁ አሳልፎ ሰጠው።
text.en: Therefore he brought upon them the king of the Chaldees, who slew their young men with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion upon young man or maiden, old man, or him that stooped for age: he gave them all into his hand.

text.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት ዕቃ ሁሉ ታላቁንና ታናሹን፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት መዝገብ፥ የንጉሡንና የአለቆቹን መዝገብ፥ እነዚህን ሁሉ ወደ ባቢሎን ወሰደ።
text.en: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king, and of his princes; all these he brought to Babylon.

text.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት አቃጠሉ፥ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቅጥር አፈረሱ፥ አዳራሾችዋንም በእሳት አቃጠሉ፥ መልካሙንም ዕቃዋን ሁሉ አጠፉ።
text.en: And they burnt the house of God, and brake down the wall of Jerusalem, and burnt all the palaces thereof with fire, and destroyed all the goodly vessels thereof.

text.am: ከሰይፍም ያመለጡትን ወደ ባቢሎን ማረካቸው፤ የፋርስ ንጉሥም እስኪነግሥ ድረስ ለንጉሡና ለልጆቹ ባሪያዎች ሆኑ፤
text.en: And them that had escaped from the sword carried he away to Babylon; where they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Persia:

text.am: በኤርምያስም አፍ የተነገረው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንዲፈጸም፥ ምድሪቱ ሰንበትን በማድረግዋ እስክታርፍ ድረስ፤ በተፈታችበትም ዘመን ሁሉ፥ ሰባ ዓመት እስኪፈጸም ድረስ፥ ሰንበትን አገኘች።
text.en: To fulfil the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah, until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths: for as long as she lay desolate she kept sabbath, to fulfil threescore and ten years.

text.am: በኤርምያስም አፍ የተነገረው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይፈጸም ዘንድ በፋርስ ንጉሥ በቂሮስ በመጀመሪያው ዓመት እግዚአብሔር የፋርስን ንጉሥ የቂሮስን መንፈስ አስነሣ፤ እርሱም። የፋርስ ንጉሥ ቂሮስ እንዲህ ይላል።
text.en: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah might be accomplished, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

text.am: የሰማይ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር የምድርን መንግሥታት ሁሉ ሰጥቶኛል፤ በይሁዳም ባለችው በኢየሩሳሌም ቤት እሠራለት ዘንድ አዝዞኛል፤ ከሕዝቡ ሁሉ በእናንተ ዘንድ ማንም ቢሆን አምላኩ እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር ይሁን፥ እርሱም ይውጣ ብሎ በመንግሥቱ ሁሉ አዋጅ አስነገረ፥ ደግሞም በጽሕፈት አደረገው።
text.en: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, All the kingdoms of the earth hath the LORD God of heaven given me; and he hath charged me to build him an house in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Who is there among you of all his people? The LORD his God be with him, and let him go up.

text.am: በኤርምያስም አፍ የተናገረው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይፈጸም ዘንድ በፋርስ ንጉሥ በቂሮስ በመጀመሪያው ዓመት እግዚአብሔር የፋርስን ንጉሥ የቂሮስን መንፈስ አስነሣ፤ እርሱም በመንግሥቱ ሁሉ አዋጅ አስነገረ፥ ደግሞም በጽሕፈት አድርጎ እንዲህ አለ።
text.en: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, that the word of the LORD by the mouth of Jeremiah might be fulfilled, the LORD stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying,

text.am: የፋርስ ንጉሥ ቂሮስ እንዲህ ይላል። የሰማይ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር የምድርን መንግሥታት ሁሉ ሰጥቶኛል፤ በይሁዳም ባለችው በኢየሩሳሌም ቤት እሠራለት ዘንድ አዝዞኛል፤
text.en: Thus saith Cyrus king of Persia, The LORD God of heaven hath given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he hath charged me to build him an house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah.

text.am: ከሕዝቡ ሁሉ በእንናተ ዘንድ ማንም ቢሆን አምላኩ ከእርሱ ጋር ይሁን፥ እርሱም በይሁዳ ወዳለችው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይውጣ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ለሚኖረው አምላክ፥ ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት ይሥራ፤
text.en: Who is there among you of all his people? his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and build the house of the LORD God of Israel, (he is the God,) which is in Jerusalem.

text.am: በሚኖርበትም ስፍራ ሁሉ ለቀረው ሰው የአገሩ ሰዎች በብርና በወርቅ በዕቃም በእንስሳም ይርዱት፤ ይህም በኢየሩሳሌም ላለው ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት በፈቃዳቸው ከሚያቀርቡት ሌላ ይሁን።
text.en: And whosoever remaineth in any place where he sojourneth, let the men of his place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with beasts, beside the freewill offering for the house of God that is in Jerusalem.

text.am: የይሁዳና የብንያም የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆችም፥ ካህናቱም፥ ሌዋውያኑም፥ በኢየሩሳሌም ያለውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ለመሥራት ይወጡ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር መንፈሳቸውን ያነሣሣው ሁሉ ተነሡ።
text.en: Then rose up the chief of the fathers of Judah and Benjamin, and the priests, and the Levites, with all them whose spirit God had raised, to go up to build the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem.

text.am: በዙሪያቸውም ያሉ ሁሉ በፈቃዳቸው ካቀረቡት ሁሉ ሌላ በብር ዕቃና በወርቅ በገንዘቦችና በእንስሶች በሌላም ስጦታ አገዙአቸው።
text.en: And all they that were about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with beasts, and with precious things, beside all that was willingly offered.

text.am: ንጉሡ ቂሮስም ናቡከደነፆር ከኢየሩሳሌም ወስዶ በአማልክቱ ቤት ያኖራቸውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ዕቃዎች አወጣ።
text.en: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of the LORD, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Jerusalem, and had put them in the house of his gods;

text.am: የፋርስ ንጉሥ ቂሮስም በመዝገቡ ላይ በነበረው በሚትሪዳጡ እጅ አወጣቸው፥ ለይሁዳም መስፍን ለሰሳብሳር ቈጠራቸው።
text.en: Even those did Cyrus king of Persia bring forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them unto Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.

text.am: ቍጥራቸውም ይህ ነው፤ ሠላሳ የወርቅ አንድ ሺህም የብር ሰሐኖች፥ ሀያ ዘጠኝም ቢላዎች፥
text.en: And this is the number of them: thirty chargers of gold, a thousand chargers of silver, nine and twenty knives,

text.am: ሠላሳ የወርቅ ደካዎች፥ አራት መቶ አሥርም ሌላ ዓይነት የብር ደካዎች፥ አንድ ሺህም ሌላ ዕቃ ነበረ።
text.en: Thirty basons of gold, silver basons of a second sort four hundred and ten, and other vessels a thousand.

text.am: የወርቁና የብሩ ዕቃዎች ሁሉ አምስት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ፤ እነዚህንም ሁሉ ሰሳብሳር ከባቢሎን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ከተመለሱ ምርኮኞቹ ጋር ወሰደ።
text.en: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand and four hundred. All these did Sheshbazzar bring up with them of the captivity that were brought up from Babylon unto Jerusalem.

text.am: የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ወደ ባቢሎን ከማረካቸው ምርኮኞች ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምና ወደ ይሁዳ ወደ እየከተማቸው የተመለሱት የአገር ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው።
text.en: Now these are the children of the province that went up out of the captivity, of those which had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon had carried away unto Babylon, and came again unto Jerusalem and Judah, every one unto his city;

text.am: ከዘሩባቤል፥ ከኢያሱ፥ ከነህምያ፥ ከሠራያ፥ ከረዕላያ፥ ከመርዶክዮስ፥ ከበላሳን፥ ከመሴፋር፥ ከበጉዋይ፥ ከሬሁም፥ ከበዓና ጋር መጡ።
text.en: Which came with Zerubbabel: Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:

text.am: የእስራኤልም ሕዝብ ሰዎች ቍጥር ይህ ነው፤ የፋሮስ ልጆች፥ ሁለት ሺህ መቶ ሰባ ሁለት።
text.en: The children of Parosh, two thousand an hundred seventy and two.

text.am: የሰፋጥያስ ልጆች፥ ሦስት መቶ ሰባ ሁለት።
text.en: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred seventy and two.

text.am: የኤራ ልጆች፥ ሰባት መቶ ሰባ አምስት።
text.en: The children of Arah, seven hundred seventy and five.

text.am: ከኢያሱና ከኢዮአብ ልጆች የሆኑ የፈሐት ሞዓብ ልጆች፥ ሁለት ሺህ ስምንት መቶ አሥራ ሁለት።
text.en: The children of Pahathmoab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve.

text.am: የኤላም ልጆች፥ ሺህ ሁለት መቶ አምሳ አራት።
text.en: The children of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

text.am: የዛቱዕ ልጆች፥ ዘጠኝ መቶ አርባ አምስት።
text.en: The children of Zattu, nine hundred forty and five.

text.am: የዘካይ ልጆች ሰባት መቶ ስድሳ።
text.en: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and threescore.

text.am: የባኒ ልጆች፥ ስድስት መቶ አርባ ሁለት።
text.en: The children of Bani, six hundred forty and two.

text.am: የቤባይ ልጆች፥ ስድስት መቶ ሀያ ሦስት።
text.en: The children of Bebai, six hundred twenty and three.

text.am: የዓዝጋድ ልጆች፥ ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ሀያ ሁለት።
text.en: The children of Azgad, a thousand two hundred twenty and two.

text.am: የአዶኒቃም ልጆች፥ ስድስት መቶ ስድሳ ስድስት።
text.en: The children of Adonikam, six hundred sixty and six.

text.am: የበጉዋይ ልጆች፥ ሁለት ሺህ አምሳ ስድስት።
text.en: The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty and six.

text.am: የዓዲን ልጆች፥ አራት መቶ አምሳ አራት።
text.en: The children of Adin, four hundred fifty and four.

text.am: ከሕዝቅያስ ወገን የአጤር ልጆች፥ ዘጠና ስምንት።
text.en: The children of Ater of Hezekiah, ninety and eight.

text.am: የቤሳይ ልጆች፥ ሦስት መቶ ሀያ ሦስት።
text.en: The children of Bezai, three hundred twenty and three.

text.am: የዮራ ልጆች፥ መቶ አሥራ ሁለት።
text.en: The children of Jorah, an hundred and twelve.

text.am: የሐሱም ልጆች፥ ሁለት መቶ ሀያ ሦስት።
text.en: The children of Hashum, two hundred twenty and three.

text.am: የጋቤር ልጆች፥ ዘጠና አምስት። የቤተ ልሔም ልጆች፥ መቶ ሀያ ሦስት።
text.en: The children of Gibbar, ninety and five.

text.am: የጋቤር ልጆች፥ ዘጠና አምስት። የቤተ ልሔም ልጆች፥ መቶ ሀያ ሦስት።
text.en: The children of Bethlehem, an hundred twenty and three.

text.am: የነጦፋ ሰዎች፥ አምሳ ስድስት።
text.en: The men of Netophah, fifty and six.

text.am: የዓናቶት ሰዎች፥ መቶ ሀያ ስምንት።
text.en: The men of Anathoth, an hundred twenty and eight.

text.am: የዓዝሞት ልጆች፥ አርባ ሁለት።
text.en: The children of Azmaveth, forty and two.

text.am: የቂርያትይዓሪምና የከፊራ የብኤሮትም ልጆች፥ ሰባት መቶ አርባ ሦስት።
text.en: The children of Kirjatharim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty and three.

text.am: የራማና የጌባ ልጆች፥ ስድስት መቶ ሀያ አንድ።
text.en: The children of Ramah and Gaba, six hundred twenty and one.

text.am: የማክማስ ሰዎች፥ መቶ ሀያ ሁለት።
text.en: The men of Michmas, an hundred twenty and two.

text.am: የቤቴልና የጋይ ሰዎች፥ ሁለት መቶ ሀያ ሦስት።
text.en: The men of Bethel and Ai, two hundred twenty and three.

text.am: የናባው ልጆች፥ አምሳ ሁለት።
text.en: The children of Nebo, fifty and two.

text.am: የመጌብስ ልጆች፥ መቶ አምሳ ስድስት።
text.en: The children of Magbish, an hundred fifty and six.

text.am: የሁለተኛውም ኤላም ልጆች፥ ሺህ ሁለት መቶ አምሳ አራት።
text.en: The children of the other Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four.

text.am: የካሪም ልጆች፥ ሦስት መቶ ሀያ።
text.en: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.

text.am: የሎድና የሐዲድ የኦኖም ልጆች፥ ሰባት መቶ ሀያ አምስት።
text.en: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred twenty and five.

text.am: የኢያሪኮ ልጆች፥ ሦስት መቶ አርባ አምስት።
text.en: The children of Jericho, three hundred forty and five.

text.am: የሴናዓ ልጆች፥ ሦስት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ሠላሳ።
text.en: The children of Senaah, three thousand and six hundred and thirty.

text.am: ካህናቱ፤ ከኢያሱ ወገን የዮዳኤ ልጆች፥ ዘጠኝ መቶ ሰባ ሦስት።
text.en: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred seventy and three.

text.am: የኢሜር ልጆች፥ ሺህ አምሳ ሁለት።
text.en: The children of Immer, a thousand fifty and two.

text.am: የፋስኮር ልጆች፥ ሺህ ሁለት መቶ አርባ ሰባት።
text.en: The children of Pashur, a thousand two hundred forty and seven.

text.am: የካሪም ልጆች፥ ሺህ አሥራ ሰባት።
text.en: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.

text.am: ሌዋውያኑ፤ ከሆዳይዋ ወገን የኢያሱና የቀድምኤል ልጆች፥ ሰባ አራት።
text.en: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy and four.

text.am: መዘምራኑ፤ የአሳፍ ልጆች፥ መቶ ሀያ ስምንት።
text.en: The singers: the children of Asaph, an hundred twenty and eight.

text.am: የበረኞች ልጆች፤ የሰሎም ልጆች፥ የአጤር ልጆች፥ የጤልሞን ልጆች፥ የዓቁብ ልጆች፥ የሐጢጣ ልጆች፥ የሶባይ ልጆች፥ ሁሉ መቶ ሠላሳ ዘጠኝ።
text.en: The children of the porters: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, in all an hundred thirty and nine.

text.am: ናታኒም፤ የሲሐ ልጆች፥ የሐሡፋ ልጆች፥
text.en: The Nethinims: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,

text.am: የጠብዖት ልጆች፥ የኬራስ ልጆች፥ የሲዓ ልጆች፤
text.en: The children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,

text.am: የፋዶን ልጆች፥ የልባና ልጆች፥
text.en: The children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,

text.am: የአጋባ ልጆች፥ የዓቁብ ልጆች፥ የአጋብ ልጆች፥ የሰምላይ ልጆች፥ የሐናን ልጆች፥
text.en: The children of Hagab, the children of Shalmai, the children of Hanan,

text.am: የጌዴል ልጆች፥ የጋሐር ልጆች፥ የራያ ልጆች፥
text.en: The children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,

text.am: የረአሶን ልጆች፥ የኔቆዳ ልጆች፥
text.en: The children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,

text.am: የጋሴም ልጆች፥ የዖዛ ልጆች፥ የፋሴሐ ልጆች፥
text.en: The children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,

text.am: የቤሳይ ልጆች፥ የአስና ልጆች፥ የምዑናውያን ልጆች፥ የንፉሰሲም ልጆች፥
text.en: The children of Asnah, the children of Mehunim, the children of Nephusim,

text.am: የበቅቡቅ ልጆች፥ የሐቁፋ ልጆች፥ የሐርሑር ልጆች፥
text.en: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,

text.am: የበስሎት ልጆች፥ የምሒዳ ልጆች፥
text.en: The children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,

text.am: የሐርሳ ልጆች፥ የበርቆስ ልጆች፥
text.en: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Thamah,

text.am: የሲሣራ ልጆች፥ የቴማ ልጆች፥ የንስያ ልጆች፥ የሐጢፋ ልጆች።
text.en: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.

text.am: የሰሎሞንም ባሪያዎች ልጆች፤ የሶጣይ ልጆች፥ የሶፌሬት ልጆች፥ የፍሩዳ ልጆች፥
text.en: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Peruda,

text.am: የየዕላ ልጆች፥ የደርቆን ልጆች፥ የጌዴል ልጆች፥
text.en: The children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,

text.am: የሰፋጥያስ ልጆች፥ የሐጢል ልጆች፥ የፈክራት ልጆች፥ የሐፂቦይም ልጆች፥ የአሚ ልጆች።
text.en: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth of Zebaim, the children of Ami.

text.am: እነዚህ ናታኒም ሁሉና የሰሎሞን ባሪያዎች ልጆች ሦስት መቶ ዘጠና ሁለት ነበሩ።
text.en: All the Nethinims, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred ninety and two.

text.am: ከቴልሜላ፥ ከቴላሬሳ፥ ከክሩብ፥ ከአዳን፥ ከኢሜር የወጡ እነዚህ ነበሩ፤ ነገር ግን የአባቶቻቸውን ቤቶችና ዘራቸውን ወይም ከእስራኤል ወገን መሆናቸውን ያስታውቁ ዘንድ አልቻሉም፤
text.en: And these were they which went up from Telmelah, Telharsa, Cherub, Addan, and Immer: but they could not shew their father's house, and their seed, whether they were of Israel:

text.am: የዳላያ ልጆች፥ የጦብያ ልጆች፥ የኔቆዳ ልጆች፥ ስድስት መቶ አምሳ ሁለት ነበሩ።
text.en: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred fifty and two.

text.am: ከካህናቱም ልጆች፤ የኤብያ ልጆች፥ የአቆስ ልጆች፥ ከገለዓዳዊው ከቤርዜሊ ልጆች ሚስት ያገባ፥ በስሙም የተጠራ የቤርዜሊ ልጆች።
text.en: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Koz, the children of Barzillai; which took a wife of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and was called after their name:

text.am: እነዚህ በትውልድ መጽሐፍ ትውልዳቸውን ፈለጉ፤ ነገር ግን አልተገኘም፥ ከክህነትም ተከለከሉ።
text.en: These sought their register among those that were reckoned by genealogy, but they were not found: therefore were they, as polluted, put from the priesthood.

text.am: ሐቴርሰታም። በኡሪምና በቱሚም የሚፈርድ ካህን እስኪነሣ ድረስ ከቅዱሰ ቅዱሳን አትበሉም አላቸው።
text.en: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and with Thummim.

text.am: ሰባት ሺህ ሦስት መቶ ሠላሳ ሰባት ከነበሩ ከሎሌዎቻቸውና ከገረዶቻቸው ሌላ ጉባኤው ሁሉ አርባ ሁለት ሺህ ሦስት መቶ ስድሳ ነበሩ። ሁለት መቶም ወንዶችና ሴቶች መዘምራን ነበሩአቸው።
text.en: The whole congregation together was forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore,

text.am: ሰባት ሺህ ሦስት መቶ ሠላሳ ሰባት ከነበሩ ከሎሌዎቻቸውና ከገረዶቻቸው ሌላ ጉባኤው ሁሉ አርባ ሁለት ሺህ ሦስት መቶ ስድሳ ነበሩ። ሁለት መቶም ወንዶችና ሴቶች መዘምራን ነበሩአቸው።
text.en: Beside their servants and their maids, of whom there were seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven: and there were among them two hundred singing men and singing women.

text.am: ፈረሶቻቸውም ሰባት መቶ ሠላሳ ስድስት በቅሎቻቸውም ሁለት መቶ አርባ አምስት፥
text.en: Their horses were seven hundred thirty and six; their mules, two hundred forty and five;

text.am: ግመሎቻቸውም አራት መቶ ሠላሳ አምስት፥ አህዮቻቸውም ስድስት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ሀያ ነበሩ።
text.en: Their camels, four hundred thirty and five; their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.

text.am: በኢየሩሳሌምም ወዳለው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት በመጡ ጊዜ ከአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች አያሌዎች ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት በስፍራው ይሠራ ዘንድ በፈቃዳቸው ሰጡ።
text.en: And some of the chief of the fathers, when they came to the house of the LORD which is at Jerusalem, offered freely for the house of God to set it up in his place:

text.am: ስድሳ አንድ ሺህም የወርቅ ዳሪክ፥ አምስት ሺህም ምናን ብር፥ አንድ መቶም የካህናት ልብስ እንደ ችሎታቸው ወደ ሥራው ቤተ መዛግብት አቀረቡ።
text.en: They gave after their ability unto the treasure of the work threescore and one thousand drams of gold, and five thousand pound of silver, and one hundred priests' garments.

text.am: ካህናቱና ሌዋውያኑም፥ ከሕዝቡም አያሌዎች፥ መዘምራኑና በረኞቹም፥ ናታኒምም በከተሞቻቸው፥ እስራኤልም ሁሉ በከተሞቻቸው ተቀመጡ።
text.en: So the priests, and the Levites, and some of the people, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, dwelt in their cities, and all Israel in their cities.

text.am: ሰባተኛውም ወር በደረሰ ጊዜ፥ የእስራኤልም ልጆች በከተሞቻቸው ሳሉ፥ ሕዝቡ እንደ አንድ ሰው ሆነው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ተሰበሰቡ።
text.en: And when the seventh month was come, and the children of Israel were in the cities, the people gathered themselves together as one man to Jerusalem.

text.am: የኢዮሴዴቅም ልጅ ኢያሱ፥ ወንድሞቹም ካህናቱ፥ የሰላትያልም ልጅ ዘሩባቤል ወንድሞቹም ተነሥተው በእግዚአብሔር ሰው በሙሴ ሕግ እንደ ተጻፈ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ያቀርቡበት ዘንድ የእስራኤልን አምላክ መሠዊያ ሠሩ።
text.en: Then stood up Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and his brethren the priests, and Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and his brethren, and builded the altar of the God of Israel, to offer burnt offerings thereon, as it is written in the law of Moses the man of God.

text.am: በአገሩም ካሉት አሕዛብ ፈርተው ነበርና መሠዊያውን በስፍራው ላይ አስቀመጡት፥ በጥዋትና በማታም የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር አቀረቡበት።
text.en: And they set the altar upon his bases; for fear was upon them because of the people of those countries: and they offered burnt offerings thereon unto the LORD, even burnt offerings morning and evening.

text.am: እንደ ተጻፈውም የዳስ በዓል አደረጉ፤ እንደ ሥርዓቱም ለየዕለቱ የተገባውን የየዕለቱን የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በቍጥር አቀረቡ።
text.en: They kept also the feast of tabernacles, as it is written, and offered the daily burnt offerings by number, according to the custom, as the duty of every day required;

text.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ዘወትር የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት፥ የመባቻውንም መሥዋዕት፥ የተቀደሱትንም የእግዚአብሔር በዓላት ሁሉ መሥዋዕት፥ ሰውም ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር በፈቃድ የሰጠውን ቍርባን አቀረቡ።
text.en: And afterward offered the continual burnt offering, both of the new moons, and of all the set feasts of the LORD that were consecrated, and of every one that willingly offered a freewill offering unto the LORD.

text.am: በሰባተኛው ወር በመጀመሪያው ቀን ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ማቅረብ ጀመሩ፤ የእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ ገና አልተመሠረተም ነበር።
text.en: From the first day of the seventh month began they to offer burnt offerings unto the LORD. But the foundation of the temple of the LORD was not yet laid.

text.am: ለጠራቢዎችና ለአናጢዎችም ገንዘብ ሰጡ፤ የፋርስም ንጉሥ ቂሮስ እንደ ፈቀደላቸው የዝግባ ዛፍ ከሊባኖስ በባሕር ወደ ኢዮጴ ያመጡ ዘንድ ለሲዶናና ለጢሮስ ሰዎች መብልና መጠጥ ዘይትም ሰጡ።
text.en: They gave money also unto the masons, and to the carpenters; and meat, and drink, and oil, unto them of Zidon, and to them of Tyre, to bring cedar trees from Lebanon to the sea of Joppa, according to the grant that they had of Cyrus king of Persia.

text.am: በኢየሩሳሌም ወዳለው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት በመጡ በሁለተኛው ዓመት በሁለተኛው ወር የሰላትያል ልጅ ዘሩባቤል፥ የኢዩሴዴቅም ልጅ ኢያሱ፥ የቀሩትም ወንድሞቻቸው ካህናትና ሌዋውያን፥ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም የተመለሱት ምርኮኞች ሁሉ ጀመሩ፤ ሌዋውያንንም ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሥራ እንዲያሠሩት ሾሙአቸው።
text.en: Now in the second year of their coming unto the house of God at Jerusalem, in the second month, began Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua the son of Jozadak, and the remnant of their brethren the priests and the Levites, and all they that were come out of the captivity unto Jerusalem; and appointed the Levites, from twenty years old and upward, to set forward the work of the house of the LORD.

text.am: ኢያሱም ልጆቹም ወንድሞቹም፥ የይሁዳም ልጆች ቀድምኤልና ልጆቹ፥ የኤንሐዳድም ልጆች፥ ልጆቻቸውና ወንድሞቻቸው ሌዋውያንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት የሚሠሩትን ያሠሩ ዘንድ በአንድነት ቆሙ።
text.en: Then stood Jeshua with his sons and his brethren, Kadmiel and his sons, the sons of Judah, together, to set forward the workmen in the house of God: the sons of Henadad, with their sons and their brethren the Levites.

text.am: አናጢዎቹም የእግዚአብሔርን መቅደስ በመሠረቱ ጊዜ ካህናቱ ልብሳቸውን ለብሰው መለከቱን ይዘው፥ የአሳፍም ልጆች ሌዋውያን ጸናጽል ይዘው እንደ እስራኤል ንጉሥ እንደ ዳዊት ሥርዓት እግዚአብሔርን ያመሰግኑ ዘንድ ቆሙ።
text.en: And when the builders laid the foundation of the temple of the LORD, they set the priests in their apparel with trumpets, and the Levites the sons of Asaph with cymbals, to praise the LORD, after the ordinance of David king of Israel.

text.am: ደግሞ። ቸር ነውና፥ ለእስራኤልም ምሕረቱ ለዘላለም ነውና እያሉ እግዚአብሔርንም እያመሰገኑና እያከበሩ እርስ በእርሳቸው ያስተዛዝሉ ነበር፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ስለ ተመሠረተ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን እያመሰገኑ በታላቅ ድምፅ እልል አሉ።
text.en: And they sang together by course in praising and giving thanks unto the LORD; because he is good, for his mercy endureth for ever toward Israel. And all the people shouted with a great shout, when they praised the LORD, because the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid.

text.am: የፊተኛውን ቤት ያዩ ሽማግሌዎች የሆኑ ብዙ ካህናትና ሌዋውያን የአባቶችም ቤቶች አለቆች ግን ይህ መቅደስ በፊታቸው በተመሠረተ ጊዜ በታላቅ ድምፅ ያለቅሱ ነበር፤ ብዙ ሰዎችም በደስታ ይጮኹ ነበር፤
text.en: But many of the priests and Levites and chief of the fathers, who were ancient men, that had seen the first house, when the foundation of this house was laid before their eyes, wept with a loud voice; and many shouted aloud for joy:

text.am: ደስ ብሎአቸው የሚጮኹትን ድምፅ ከሕዝቡ ልቅሶ ድምፅ መለየት የሚችል አልነበረም፤ ሕዝቡም በታላቅ ድምፅ ይጮኽ ነበር፥ ድምፁም ከሩቅ ይሰማ ነበር።
text.en: So that the people could not discern the noise of the shout of joy from the noise of the weeping of the people: for the people shouted with a loud shout, and the noise was heard afar off.

text.am: የይሁዳና የብንያምም ጠላቶች ምርኮኞቹ ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር መቅደስ እንደ ሠሩ ሰሙ።
text.en: Now when the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin heard that the children of the captivity builded the temple unto the LORD God of Israel;

text.am: ወደ ዘሩባቤልና ወደ አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ቀርበው። የአሦር ንጉሥ አስራዶን ወደዚህ ካመጣን ቀን ጀምሮ ለአምላካችሁ እንሠዋለንና፥ እንደ እናንተም እንፈልገዋለንና ከእናንተ ጋር እንሥራ አሉአቸው።
text.en: Then they came to Zerubbabel, and to the chief of the fathers, and said unto them, Let us build with you: for we seek your God, as ye do; and we do sacrifice unto him since the days of Esarhaddon king of Assur, which brought us up hither.

text.am: ዘሩባቤልና ኢያሱም የቀሩትም የእስራኤል አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች። የአምላካችንን ቤት መሥራት ለእኛና ለእናንተ አይደለም፤ እኛ ለብቻችን ግን የፋርስ ንጉሥ ቂሮስ እንዳዘዘን ለእስራኤል አምላክ ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት እንሠራለን አሉአቸው።
text.en: But Zerubbabel, and Jeshua, and the rest of the chief of the fathers of Israel, said unto them, Ye have nothing to do with us to build an house unto our God; but we ourselves together will build unto the LORD God of Israel, as king Cyrus the king of Persia hath commanded us.

text.am: የምድሩም ሕዝብ የይሁዳን ሕዝብ እጅ ያደክሙ ነበር፥ እንዳይሠሩም አስፈራሩአቸው፥
text.en: Then the people of the land weakened the hands of the people of Judah, and troubled them in building,

text.am: ምክራቸውንም ያፈርሱ ዘንድ በፋርሱ ንጉሥ በቂሮስ ዘመን ሁሉ እስከ ፋርስ ንጉሥ እስከ ዳርዮስ መንግሥት ድረስ መካሪዎችን ገዙባቸው።
text.en: And hired counsellors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius king of Persia.

text.am: በአርጤክስስም መንግሥት፥ በመንግሥቱም በመጀመሪያ ዘመን፥ በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም በሚኖሩት ላይ የክስ ነገር ጻፉ።
text.en: And in the reign of Ahasuerus, in the beginning of his reign, wrote they unto him an accusation against the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem.

text.am: በአርጤክስስ ዘመን ቢሽላም፥ ሚትሪዳጡ፥ ጣብኤል ተባባሪዎቹም ለፋርስ ንጉሥ ለአርጤክስስ ጻፉ፤ ደብዳቤውም በሶርያ ፊደልና በሶርያ ቋንቋ ተጽፎ ነበር።
text.en: And in the days of Artaxerxes wrote Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of their companions, unto Artaxerxes king of Persia; and the writing of the letter was written in the Syrian tongue, and interpreted in the Syrian tongue.

text.am: አዛዡ ሬሁም ጸሐፊውም ሲምሳይ በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ ለንጉሡ ለአርጤክስስ እንዲህ የሚል ደብዳቤ ጻፉ።
text.en: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king in this sort:

text.am: አዛዡ ሬሁም ጸሐፊውም ሲምሳይ የቀሩትም ተባባሪዎቻቸው፥ ዲናውያን፥ አፈርሳትካውያን፥ ጠርፈላውያን፥ አፈርሳውያን፥ አርካውያን፥ ባቢሎናውያን፥ ሱስናካውያን፥ ዴሐውያን፥ ኤላማውያን፥
text.en: Then wrote Rehum the chancellor, and Shimshai the scribe, and the rest of their companions; the Dinaites, the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Susanchites, the Dehavites, and the Elamites,

text.am: ታላቁና ኃይለኛው አስናፈር ያፈለሳቸው በሰማርያና በወንዝ ማዶ ያኖራቸው የቀሩትም አሕዛብ ደብዳቤውን ጻፉ።
text.en: And the rest of the nations whom the great and noble Asnappar brought over, and set in the cities of Samaria, and the rest that are on this side the river, and at such a time.

text.am: ለንጉሡ ለአርጤክስስ የላኩት የደብዳቤ ግልባጭ ይህ ነው። በወንዝ ማዶ ያሉት ሰዎች ባሪያዎችህ፤
text.en: This is the copy of the letter that they sent unto him, even unto Artaxerxes the king; Thy servants the men on this side the river, and at such a time.

text.am: አሁንም ከአንተ ዘንድ የወጡ አይሁድ ወደ እኛ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም እንደ መጡ ንጉሡ ይወቅ፤ ዓመፀኛይቱንና እጅግም የከፋቺቱን ከተማ ይሠራሉ፥ ቅጥርዋንም ያድሳሉ፥ መሠረትዋንም ጠገኑ።
text.en: Be it known unto the king, that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem, building the rebellious and the bad city, and have set up the walls thereof, and joined the foundations.

text.am: አሁንም ይህች ከተማ የተሠራች እንደ ሆነ፥ ቅጥርዋም የታደሰ እንደ ሆነ፥ ግብርና ቀረጥ መጥንም እንዳይሰጡ፥ የንጉሡም ግቢው እንዲጐድል ንጉሡ ይወቅ።
