text.en: So Esther's maids and her chamberlains came and told it her. Then was the queen exceedingly grieved; and she sent raiment to clothe Mordecai, and to take away his sackcloth from him: but he received it not.

text.am: አስቴርም ያገለግላት ዘንድ ንጉሡ ያቆመውን አክራትዮስን ጠራች እርሱም ከጃንደረቦች አንዱ ነበረ፥ እርስዋም ይህ ነገር ምንና ምን እንደ ሆነ ያስታውቃት ዘንድ ወደ መርዶክዮስ እንዲሄድ አዘዘችው።
text.en: Then called Esther for Hatach, one of the king's chamberlains, whom he had appointed to attend upon her, and gave him a commandment to Mordecai, to know what it was, and why it was.

text.am: አክራትዮስም በንጉሥ በር ፊት ወደ ነበረችው ወደ ከተማይቱ አደባባይ ወደ መርዶክዮስ ወጣ።
text.en: So Hatach went forth to Mordecai unto the street of the city, which was before the king's gate.

text.am: መርዶክዮስም የተደረገውን ሁሉ፥ አይሁድንም ለማጥፋት ሐማ በንጉሡ ግምጃ ቤት ይመዝን ዘንድ የተናገረውን የብሩን ቍጥር ነገረው።
text.en: And Mordecai told him of all that had happened unto him, and of the sum of the money that Haman had promised to pay to the king's treasuries for the Jews, to destroy them.

text.am: ለአስቴርም እንዲያሳያት ለመጥፋታቸው በሱሳ የተነገረውን የአዋጁን ጽሕፈት ቅጅ ሰጠው፤ ወደ ንጉሡም ገብታ ስለ ሕዝብዋ ትለምነውና ትማልደው ዘንድ እንዲነግራትና እንዲያዝዛት ነገረው።
text.en: Also he gave him the copy of the writing of the decree that was given at Shushan to destroy them, to shew it unto Esther, and to declare it unto her, and to charge her that she should go in unto the king, to make supplication unto him, and to make request before him for her people.

text.am: አክራትዮስም መጥቶ የመርዶክዮስን ቃል ለአስቴር ነገራት።
text.en: And Hatach came and told Esther the words of Mordecai.

text.am: አስቴርም አክራትዮስን ተናገረችው፥ ለመርዶክዮስም እንዲህ የሚል መልእክት ሰጠችው።
text.en: Again Esther spake unto Hatach, and gave him commandment unto Mordecai;

text.am: የንጉሡ ባሪያዎችና በአገሮችም የሚኖሩ ሕዝብ ሁሉ ወንድ ወይም ሴት ቢሆን ሳይጠራ ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ውስጠኛው ወለል የሚገባ ሁሉ፥ በሕይወት ይኖር ዘንድ ንጉሡ የወርቁን ዘንግ ካልዘረጋለት በቀር፥ እርሱ ይሞት ዘንድ ሕግ እንዳለ ያውቃሉ፤ እኔ ግን ወደ ንጉሡ ለመግባት ይህን ሠላሳውን ቀን አልተጠራሁም።
text.en: All the king's servants, and the people of the king's provinces, do know, that whosoever, whether man or woman, shall come unto the king into the inner court, who is not called, there is one law of his to put him to death, except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre, that he may live: but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days.

text.am: አክራትዮስም የአስቴርን ቃል ለመርዶክዮስ ነገረው።
text.en: And they told to Mordecai Esther's words.

text.am: መርዶክዮስም አክራትዮስን። ሂድና ለአስቴር እንዲህ በላት አለው። አንቺ። በንጉሥ ቤት ስለ ሆንሁ ከአይሁድ ሁሉ ይልቅ እድናለሁ ብለሽ በልብሽ አታስቢ።
text.en: Then Mordecai commanded to answer Esther, Think not with thyself that thou shalt escape in the king's house, more than all the Jews.

text.am: በዚህ ጊዜ ቸል ብትዪ ዕረፍትና መዳን ለአይሁድ ከሌላ ስፍራ ይሆንላቸዋል፥ አንቺና የአባትሽ ቤት ግን ትጠፋላችሁ፤ ደግሞስ ወደ መንግሥት የመጣሽው እንደዚህ ላለው ጊዜ እንደ ሆነ ማን ያውቃል?
text.en: For if thou altogether holdest thy peace at this time, then shall there enlargement and deliverance arise to the Jews from another place; but thou and thy father's house shall be destroyed: and who knoweth whether thou art come to the kingdom for such a time as this?

text.am: አስቴርም እንዲህ ብሎ ለመርዶክዮስ እንዲመልስ አዘዘችው።
text.en: Then Esther bade them return Mordecai this answer,

text.am: ሄደህ በሱሳ ያሉትን አይሁድ ሁሉ ሰብስብ፥ ለእኔም ጹሙ፤ ሦስት ቀን ሌሊቱንና ቀኑን አትብሉም፥ አትጠጡም፤ እኔና ደንገጥሮቼ ደግሞ እንዲሁ እንጾማለን፤ ምንም እንኳ ያለ ሕግ ቢሆን ወደ ንጉሡ እገባለሁ፤ ብጠፋም እጠፋለሁ።
text.en: Go, gather together all the Jews that are present in Shushan, and fast ye for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night or day: I also and my maidens will fast likewise; and so will I go in unto the king, which is not according to the law: and if I perish, I perish.

text.am: መርዶክዮስም ሄዶ አስቴር እንዳዘዘችው ሁሉ አደረገ።
text.en: So Mordecai went his way, and did according to all that Esther had commanded him.

text.am: በሦስተኛውም ቀን አስቴር ልብሰ መንግሥትዋን ለብሳ በንጉሡ ቤት ትይዩ በንጉሡ ቤት በውስጠኛው ወለል ቆመች፤ ንጉሡም በቤቱ መግቢያ ትይዩ በቤተ መንግሥቱ ውስጥ በንጉሡ ዙፋን ላይ ተቀምጦ ነበር።
text.en: Now it came to pass on the third day, that Esther put on her royal apparel, and stood in the inner court of the king's house, over against the king's house: and the king sat upon his royal throne in the royal house, over against the gate of the house.

text.am: ንጉሡም ንግሥቲቱ አስቴር በወለሉ ላይ ቆማ ባየ ጊዜ በዓይኑ ሞገስ አገኘች፤ ንጉሡም በእጁ የነበረውን የወርቁን ዘንግ ለአስቴር ዘረጋላት፤ አስቴርም ቀርባ የዘንጉን ጫፍ ነካች።
text.en: And it was so, when the king saw Esther the queen standing in the court, that she obtained favour in his sight: and the king held out to Esther the golden sceptre that was in his hand. So Esther drew near, and touched the top of the sceptre.

text.am: ንጉሡም። ንግሥት አስቴር ሆይ፥ የምትለምኚኝ ምንድር ነው? የምትሺውስ ምንድር ነው? እስከ መንግሥቴ እኵሌታ እንኳ ቢሆን ይሰጥሻል አላት።
text.en: Then said the king unto her, What wilt thou, queen Esther? and what is thy request? it shall be even given thee to the half of the kingdom.

text.am: አስቴርም። ለንጉሡ መልካም ሆኖ ቢታይ ንጉሡ ወዳዘጋጀሁለት ግብዣ ከሐማ ጋር ዛሬ ይምጣ አለች።
text.en: And Esther answered, If it seem good unto the king, let the king and Haman come this day unto the banquet that I have prepared for him.

text.am: ንጉሡም። አስቴር እንዳለች ይደረግ ዘንድ ሐማን አስቸኵሉት አለ። ንጉሡና ሐማ አስቴር ወዳዘጋጀችው ግብዣ መጡ።
text.en: Then the king said, Cause Haman to make haste, that he may do as Esther hath said. So the king and Haman came to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

text.am: ንጉሡም በወይኑ ጠጅ ግብዣ ሳለ አስቴርን። የምትሺው ምንድር ነው? ይሰጥሻል፤ ልመናሽስ ምንድር ነው? እስከ መንግሥቴ እኵሌታ እንኳ ቢሆን ይደረግልሻል አላት።
text.en: And the king said unto Esther at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: and what is thy request? even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.

text.am: አስቴርም መልሳ። ልመናዬና የምሻው ነገር ይህ ነው፤
text.en: Then answered Esther, and said, My petition and my request is;

text.am: በንጉሡ ዘንድ ሞገስ አግኝቼ እንደ ሆነ፥ ልመናዬንም ይፈጽም ዘንድና የምሻውን ያደርግ ዘንድ ንጉሡ ደስ ቢያሰኘው፥ ንጉሡና ሐማ ወደማዘጋጅላቸው ግብዣ ይምጡ፤ እንደ ንጉሡም ነገር ነገ አደርጋለሁ አለች።
text.en: If I have found favour in the sight of the king, and if it please the king to grant my petition, and to perform my request, let the king and Haman come to the banquet that I shall prepare for them, and I will do to morrow as the king hath said.

text.am: በዚያም ቀን ሐማ ደስ ብሎት በልቡም ተደስቶ ወጣ፤ ነገር ግን መርዶክዮስ በንጉሡ በር ያለ መነሣትና ያለ መናወጥ ተቀምጦ ባየ ጊዜ ሐማ በመርዶክዮስ ላይ እጅግ ተቈጣ።
text.en: Then went Haman forth that day joyful and with a glad heart: but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king's gate, that he stood not up, nor moved for him, he was full of indignation against Mordecai.

text.am: ሐማ ግን ታግሦ ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ፤ ልኮም ወዳጆቹንና ሚስቱን ዞሳራን አስጠራ።
text.en: Nevertheless Haman refrained himself: and when he came home, he sent and called for his friends, and Zeresh his wife.

text.am: ሐማም የሀብቱን ክብርና የልጆቹን ብዛት፥ ንጉሡም ያከበረበትን ክብር ሁሉ፥ በንጉሡም አዛውንትና ባሪያዎች ላይ ከፍ ከፍ እንዳደረገው አጫወታቸው።
text.en: And Haman told them of the glory of his riches, and the multitude of his children, and all the things wherein the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.

text.am: ሐማም። ንግሥቲቱ አስቴር ወዳዘጋጀችው ግብዣ ከእኔ በቀር ከንጉሡ ጋር ማንንም አልጠራችም፤ ደግሞ ነገ ከንጉሡ ጋር ወደ እርስዋ ተጠርቻለሁ።
text.en: Haman said moreover, Yea, Esther the queen did let no man come in with the king unto the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and to morrow am I invited unto her also with the king.

text.am: ነገር ግን አይሁዳዊው መርዶክዮስ በንጉሡ በር ተቀምጦ ካየሁ ይህ ሁሉ ለእኔ ምንምን አይጠቅምም አለ።
text.en: Yet all this availeth me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king's gate.

text.am: ሚስቱም ዞሳራና ወዳጆቹ ሁሉ። ቁመቱ አምሳ ክንድ የሆነ ግንድ ይደረግ፥ ነገም መርዶክዮስ ይሰቀልበት ዘንድ ለንጉሡ ተናገር፤ ደስም ብሎህ ከንጉሡ ጋር ወደ ግብዣው ግባ አሉት። ነገራቸውም ሐማን ደስ አሰኘው፥ ግንዱንም አስደረገ።
text.en: Then said Zeresh his wife and all his friends unto him, Let a gallows be made of fifty cubits high, and to morrow speak thou unto the king that Mordecai may be hanged thereon: then go thou in merrily with the king unto the banquet. And the thing pleased Haman; and he caused the gallows to be made.

text.am: በዚያም ሌሊት እንቅልፍ ከንጉሡ ሸሸ፤ የዘመኑንም ታሪክ መጽሐፍ ያመጡ ዘንድ አዘዘ፥ በንጉሡም ፊት ተነበበ።
text.en: On that night could not the king sleep, and he commanded to bring the book of records of the chronicles; and they were read before the king.

text.am: ደጁንም ከሚጠብቁት ከንጉሡ ጃንደረቦች ሁለቱ ገበታና ታራ እጃቸውን በንጉሡ በአርጤክስስ ላይ ያነሡ ዘንድ እንደ ፈለጉ፥ መርዶክዮስ እንደ ነገረው ተጽፎ ተገኘ።
text.en: And it was found written, that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king's chamberlains, the keepers of the door, who sought to lay hand on the king Ahasuerus.

text.am: ንጉሡም። ስለዚህ ነገር ለመርዶክዮስ ምን ክብርና በጎነት ተደረገለት? አለ። ንጉሡንም የሚያገለግሉ ብላቴኖች። ምንም አልተደረገለትም አሉት።
text.en: And the king said, What honour and dignity hath been done to Mordecai for this? Then said the king's servants that ministered unto him, There is nothing done for him.

text.am: ንጉሡም። በአዳራሹ ማን አለ? አለ። ሐማም ባዘጋጀው ግንድ ላይ መርዶክዮስን ለማሰቀል ለንጉሡ ይናገር ዘንድ ወደ ንጉሡ ቤት ወደ ውጭው አዳራሽ ገብቶ ነበር።
text.en: And the king said, Who is in the court? Now Haman was come into the outward court of the king's house, to speak unto the king to hang Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.

text.am: የንጉሡም ብላቴኖች። እነሆ ሐማ በአዳራሹ ቆሞአል አሉት። ንጉሡም። ይግባ አለ።
text.en: And the king's servants said unto him, Behold, Haman standeth in the court. And the king said, Let him come in.

text.am: ሐማም ገባ፤ ንጉሡም። ንጉሡ ሊያከብረው ለሚወድደው ሰው ምን ይደረግለታል? አለው። ሐማም በልቡ። ንጉሡ ከእኔ ይልቅ ማንን ያከብር ዘንድ ይወድዳል? አለ።
text.en: So Haman came in. And the king said unto him, What shall be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour? Now Haman thought in his heart, To whom would the king delight to do honour more than to myself?

text.am: ሐማም ንጉሡን እንዲህ አለው። ንጉሡ ያከብረው ዘንድ ለሚወድደው ሰው እንዲህ ይደረግ፤
text.en: And Haman answered the king, For the man whom the king delighteth to honour,

text.am: ንጉሡ የለበሰው የክብር ልብስ፥ ንጉሡም የተቀመጠበት ፈረስ ይምጣለት፥ የንጉሡም ዘውድ በራሱ ላይ ይደረግ፤
text.en: Let the royal apparel be brought which the king useth to wear, and the horse that the king rideth upon, and the crown royal which is set upon his head:

text.am: ልብሱንና ፈረሱንም ከንጉሡ አዛውንት በዋነኛው እጅ ያስረክቡት፤ ንጉሡም ያከብረው ዘንድ የሚወድደውን ሰው ያልብሱት፤ በፈረሱም ላይ አስቀምጠውት በከተማይቱ አደባባይ ያሳልፉት፤ በፊቱም። ንጉሡ ያከብረው ዘንድ ለሚወድደው ሰው እንዲህ ይደረግለታል ተብሎ አዋጅ ይነገር።
text.en: And let this apparel and horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king's most noble princes, that they may array the man withal whom the king delighteth to honour, and bring him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaim before him, Thus shall it be done to the man whom the king delighteth to honour.

text.am: ንጉሡም ሐማን። ፍጠን፥ እንደ ተናገርኸውም ልብሱንና ፈረሱን ውሰድ፤ በንጉሡም በር ለሚቀመጠው አይሁዳዊ ለመርዶክዮስ እንዲሁ አድርግለት፤ ከተናገርኸውም ሁሉ ምንም አይቅር አለው።
text.en: Then the king said to Haman, Make haste, and take the apparel and the horse, as thou hast said, and do even so to Mordecai the Jew, that sitteth at the king's gate: let nothing fail of all that thou hast spoken.

text.am: ሐማም ልብሱንና ፈረሱን ወሰደ፥ መርዶክዮስንም አለበሰው፥ በፈረሱም ላይ አስቀመጠው፥ በከተማይቱም አደባባይ በፊቱ አሳለፈው። በፊቱም። ንጉሡ ያከብረው ዘንድ ለሚወድደው ሰው እንዲህ ይደረግለታል ብሎ አዋጅ ነገረ።
text.en: Then took Haman the apparel and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and brought him on horseback through the street of the city, and proclaimed before him, Thus shall it be done unto the man whom the king delighteth to honour.

text.am: መርዶክዮስም ወደ ንጉሡ በር ተመለሰ። ሐማ ግን አዝኖና ራሱን ተከናንቦ ቸኵሎ ወደ ቤቱ ሄደ።
text.en: And Mordecai came again to the king's gate. But Haman hasted to his house mourning, and having his head covered.

text.am: ሐማም ለሚስቱ ለዞሳራና ለወዳጆቹ ሁሉ ያገኘውን ሁሉ አጫወታቸው። ጥበበኞቹና ሚስቱ ዞሳራም። በፊቱ መውደቅ የጀመርህለት መርዶክዮስ ከአይሁድ ወገን የሆነ እንደ ሆነ በፊቱ ፈጽሞ ትወድቃለህ እንጂ አታሸንፈውም አሉት።
text.en: And Haman told Zeresh his wife and all his friends every thing that had befallen him. Then said his wise men and Zeresh his wife unto him, If Mordecai be of the seed of the Jews, before whom thou hast begun to fall, thou shalt not prevail against him, but shalt surely fall before him.

text.am: እነርሱም ሲናገሩት ሳሉ እነሆ የንጉሡ ጃንደረቦች መጡ፥ አስቴርም ወዳዘጋጀችው ግብዣ ይመጣ ዘንድ ሐማን አስቸኰሉት።
text.en: And while they were yet talking with him, came the king's chamberlains, and hasted to bring Haman unto the banquet that Esther had prepared.

text.am: ንጉሡና ሐማም ከንግሥቲቱ ከአስቴር ጋር ለመጠጣት መጡ።
text.en: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.

text.am: በሁለተኛውም ቀን ንጉሡ በወይኑ ጠጅ ግብዣ ሳለ አስቴርን። ንግሥት አስቴር ሆይ፥ የምትለምኚኝ ምንድር ነው? ይሰጥሻል፤ የምትሺውስ ምንድር ነው? እስከ መንግሥቴ እኵሌታ እንኳ ቢሆን ይደረግልሻል አላት።
text.en: And the king said again unto Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, What is thy petition, queen Esther? and it shall be granted thee: and what is thy request? and it shall be performed, even to the half of the kingdom.

text.am: ንግሥቲቱም አስቴር መልሳ። ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ በአንተ ዘንድ ሞገስ አግኝቼ እንደ ሆነ፥ ንጉሡንም ደስ ቢያሰኘው፥ ሕይወቴ በልመናዬ ሕዝቤም በመሻቴ ይሰጠኝ፤
text.en: Then Esther the queen answered and said, If I have found favour in thy sight, O king, and if it please the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request:

text.am: እኔና ሕዝቤ ለመጥፋትና ለመገደል ለመደምሰስም ተሸጠናልና። ባርያዎች ልንሆን ተሸጠን እንደ ሆነ ዝም ባልሁ ነበር፤ የሆነ ሆኖ ጠላቱ የንጉሡን ጉዳት ለማቅናት ባልቻለም ነበር አለች።
text.en: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for bondmen and bondwomen, I had held my tongue, although the enemy could not countervail the king's damage.

text.am: ንጉሡም አርጤክስስ ንግሥቲቱን አስቴርን። ይህን ያደርግ ዘንድ በልቡ የደፈረ ማን ነው? እርሱስ ወዴት ነው? ብሎ ተናገራት።
text.en: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen, Who is he, and where is he, that durst presume in his heart to do so?

text.am: አስቴርም። ያ ጠላትና ባለጋራ ሰው ክፉው ሐማ ነው አለች። ሐማም በንጉሡና በንግሥቲቱ ፊት ደነገጠ።
text.en: And Esther said, The adversary and enemy is this wicked Haman. Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.

text.am: ንጉሡም ተቈጥቶ የወይን ጠጅ ከመጠጣቱ ተነሣ፥ ወደ ንጉሡም ቤት አታክልት ውስጥ ሄደ። ሐማም ከንጉሡ ዘንድ ክፉ ነገር እንደ ታሰበበት አይቶአልና ከንግሥቲቱ ከአስቴር ሕይወቱን ይለምን ዘንድ ቆመ።
text.en: And the king arising from the banquet of wine in his wrath went into the palace garden: and Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen; for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.

text.am: ንጉሡም ከቤቱ አታክልት ወደ ወይን ጠጁ ግብዣ ስፍራ ተመለሰ፤ ሐማም አስቴር ባለችበት አልጋ ላይ ወድቆ ነበር። ንጉሡም። ደግሞ በቤቴ በእኔ ፊት ንግሥቲቱን ይጋፋታልን? አለ። ይህም ቃል ከንጉሡ አፍ በወጣ ጊዜ የሐማን ፊት ሸፈኑት።
text.en: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman was fallen upon the bed whereon Esther was. Then said the king, Will he force the queen also before me in the house? As the word went out of the king's mouth, they covered Haman's face.

text.am: በንጉሡም ፊት ካሉት ጃንደረቦች አንዱ ሐርቦና። እነሆ ሐማ ለንጉሡ በጎ ለተናገረው ለመርዶክዮስ ያሠራው ርዝመቱ አምሳ ክንድ የሆነው ግንድ በሐማ ቤት ተተክሎአል አለ። ንጉሡም። በእርሱ ላይ ስቀሉት አለ።
text.en: And Harbonah, one of the chamberlains, said before the king, Behold also, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman had made for Mordecai, who had spoken good for the king, standeth in the house of Haman. Then the king said, Hang him thereon.

text.am: ሐማንም ለመርዶክዮስ ባዘጋጀው ግንድ ላይ ሰቀሉት፤ በዚያም ጊዜ የንጉሡ ቍጣ በረደ።
text.en: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then was the king's wrath pacified.

text.am: በዚያም ቀን ንጉሡ አርጤክስስ የአይሁድን ጠላት የሐማን ቤት ለንግሥቲቱ ለአስቴር ሰጠ። አስቴርም ለእርስዋ ምን እንደ ሆነ ነግራው ነበርና መርዶክዮስ ወደ ንጉሡ ፊት ገባ።
text.en: On that day did the king Ahasuerus give the house of Haman the Jews' enemy unto Esther the queen. And Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was unto her.

text.am: ንጉሡም ከሐማ ያወለቀውን ቀለበቱን አወጣ፥ ለመርዶክዮስም ሰጠው። አስቴርም በሐማ ቤት ላይ መርዶክዮስን ሾመች።
text.en: And the king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it unto Mordecai. And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.

text.am: አስቴርም እንደ ገና በንጉሡ ፊት ተናገረች፤ በእግሩም ላይ ወድቃ እያለቀሰች የአጋጋዊውን የሐማን ክፋትና በአይሁድ ላይ የተተነኰለውን ተንኰል ይሽር ዘንድ ለመነችው።
text.en: And Esther spake yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet, and besought him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his device that he had devised against the Jews.

text.am: ንጉሡም የወርቁን ዘንግ ለአስቴር ዘረጋላት፤ አስቴርም ተነሥታ በንጉሡ ፊት ቆመችና።
text.en: Then the king held out the golden sceptre toward Esther. So Esther arose, and stood before the king,

text.am: ንጉሡን ደስ ቢያሰኘው፥ በፊቱም ሞገስ አግኝቼ እንደሆነ፥ ይህም ነገር በፊቱ ቅን ቢሆን፥ እኔም በእርሱ ዘንድ ተወድጄ እንደ ሆነ፥ አጋጋዊው የሐመዳቱ ልጅ ሐማ በንጉሡ አገር ሁሉ ያሉትን አይሁድ ለማጥፋት የጻፈው ተንኰል ይገለበጥ ዘንድ ይጻፍ።
text.en: And said, If it please the king, and if I have found favour in his sight, and the thing seem right before the king, and I be pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews which are in all the king's provinces:

text.am: እኔ በሕዝቤ ላይ የሚወርደውን ክፉ ነገር አይ ዘንድ እንዴት እችላለሁ? ወይስ የዘመዶቼን ጥፋት አይ ዘንድ እንዴት እችላለሁ? አለች።
text.en: For how can I endure to see the evil that shall come unto my people? or how can I endure to see the destruction of my kindred?

text.am: ንጉሡም አርጤክስስ ንግሥቲቱን አስቴርንና አይሁዳዊውን መርዶክዮስን። እነሆ የሐማን ቤት ለአስቴር ሰጥቻለሁ፥ እርሱም እጆቹን በአይሁድ ላይ ስለ ዘረጋ በግንድ ላይ ተሰቀለ።
text.en: Then the king Ahasuerus said unto Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, Behold, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and him they have hanged upon the gallows, because he laid his hand upon the Jews.

text.am: በንጉሡ ስም የተጻፈና በንጉሡ ቀለበት የታተመ አይገለበጥምና እናንተ ደግሞ ደስ የሚያሰኛችሁን በንጉሡ ስም ስለ አይሁድ ጻፉ፥ በንጉሡም ቀለበት አትሙ አላቸው።
text.en: Write ye also for the Jews, as it liketh you, in the king's name, and seal it with the king's ring: for the writing which is written in the king's name, and sealed with the king's ring, may no man reverse.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜም ኒሳን በተባለው በመጀመሪያው ወር ከወሩም በሀያ ሦስተኛው ቀን የንጉሡ ጸሐፊዎች ተጠሩ፤ መርዶክዮስም ስለ አይሁድ እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ ከህንድ ጀምሮ እስከ ኢትዮጵያ ድረስ በመቶ ሀያ ሰባቱ አገሮች ላሉ ሹማምትና አለቆች አዛውንትም ለእያንዳንዱም አገር እንደ ጽሕፈቱ ለእያንዳንዱም ሕዝብ እንደ ቋንቋው ለአይሁድም እንደ ጽሕፈታቸውና እንደ ቋንቋቸው ተጻፈ።
text.en: Then were the king's scribes called at that time in the third month, that is, the month Sivan, on the three and twentieth day thereof; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded unto the Jews, and to the lieutenants, and the deputies and rulers of the provinces which are from India unto Ethiopia, an hundred twenty and seven provinces, unto every province according to the writing thereof, and unto every people after their language, and to the Jews according to their writing, and according to their language.

text.am: በንጉሡም በአርጤክስስ ስም አስጻፈው፥ በንጉሡም ቀለበት አሳተመው፤ ደብዳቤውንም በንጉሡ ፈረስ ቤት በተወለዱት፥ ለንጉሡም አገልግሎት በተለዩ በፈጣን ፈረሶች በተቀመጡ መልእክተኞች እጅ ሰደደው።
text.en: And he wrote in the king Ahasuerus' name, and sealed it with the king's ring, and sent letters by posts on horseback, and riders on mules, camels, and young dromedaries:

text.am: በዚያም ደብዳቤ በከተሞቹ ሁሉ የሚኖሩት አይሁድ እንዲሰበሰቡ፥ ለሕይወታቸውም እንዲቆሙ፥ በጥል የሚነሡባቸውን የሕዝቡንና የአገሩን ሠራዊት ሁሉ ከሕፃናቶቻቸውና ከሴቶቻቸው ጋር እንዲያጠፉና እንዲገድሉ እንዲደመስሱም፥ ምርኮአቸውንም እንዲዘርፉ ንጉሡ ፈቀደላቸው።
text.en: Wherein the king granted the Jews which were in every city to gather themselves together, and to stand for their life, to destroy, to slay, and to cause to perish, all the power of the people and province that would assault them, both little ones and women, and to take the spoil of them for a prey,

text.am: ይህም አዳር በሚባለው በአሥራ ሁለተኛው ወር በአሥራ ሦስተኛው ቀን በንጉሡ በአርጤክስስ አገሮች ሁሉ በአንድ ቀን እንዲሆን ነው።
text.en: Upon one day in all the provinces of king Ahasuerus, namely, upon the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

text.am: አይሁድም ጠላቶቻቸውን እንዲበቀሉ በዚያ ቀን ይዘጋጁ ዘንድ የደብዳቤው ቅጅ በየአገሩ ላሉ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ታወጀ።
text.en: The copy of the writing for a commandment to be given in every province was published unto all people, and that the Jews should be ready against that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.

text.am: ለንጉሡ አገልግሎት በተለዩ በፈጣን ፈረሶች የተቀመጡት መልእክተኞች በንጉሡ ትእዛዝ ተርበትብተውና ቸኵለው ወጡ፤ አዋጁም በሱሳ ግንብ ተነገረ።
text.en: So the posts that rode upon mules and camels went out, being hastened and pressed on by the king's commandment. And the decree was given at Shushan the palace.

text.am: መርዶክዮስም በሰማያዊና በነጭ ሐር የተሠራውን የንጉሡን የክብር ልብስ ለብሶ ታላቅም የወርቅ አክሊል ደፍቶ ከጥሩ በፍታና ከሐምራዊ ግምጃ የተሠራ መጐናጸፊያ ተጐናጽፎ ከንጉሡ ፊት ወጣ፤ የሱሳም ከተማ ደስ አላት፥ እልልም አለች።
text.en: And Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal apparel of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a garment of fine linen and purple: and the city of Shushan rejoiced and was glad.

text.am: ለአይሁድም ብርሃንና ደስታ ተድላና ክብርም ሆነ።
text.en: The Jews had light, and gladness, and joy, and honour.

text.am: የንጉሡም ትእዛዝና አዋጅ በደረሰበት አገርና ከተማ ሁሉ ለአይሁድ ደስታና ተድላ፥ የግብዣም ቀን መልካምም ቀን ሆነ። አይሁድንም መፍራት ስለ ወደቀባቸው ከምድር አሕዛብ ብዙ ሰዎች አይሁድ ሆኑ።
text.en: And in every province, and in every city, whithersoever the king's commandment and his decree came, the Jews had joy and gladness, a feast and a good day. And many of the people of the land became Jews; for the fear of the Jews fell upon them.

text.am: አዳር በሚባለውም በአሥራ ሁለተኛው ወር ከወሩም በአሥራ ሦስተኛው ቀን፥ የንጉሡ ትእዛዝና አዋጅ ሊፈጸምበት በነበረው ቀን፥ የአይሁድ ጠላቶች ሊሠለጥኑባቸው በነበረው ቀን፥ አይሁድ በጠላቶቻቸው ላይ እንዲሠለጥኑ ነገሩ ተገለበጠ።
text.en: Now in the twelfth month, that is, the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the same, when the king's commandment and his decree drew near to be put in execution, in the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to have power over them, (though it was turned to the contrary, that the Jews had rule over them that hated them;)

text.am: አይሁድም ክፋታቸውን በሚሹት ሰዎች ላይ እጃቸውን ይዘረጉ ዘንድ በንጉሡ በአርጤክስስ አገሮች ሁሉ በነበሩ ከተሞቻቸው ውስጥ ተሰበሰቡ፤ እነርሱንም መፍራት በአሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ ወድቆ ነበርና እነርሱን የሚቃወም ሰው አልነበረም።
text.en: The Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, to lay hand on such as sought their hurt: and no man could withstand them; for the fear of them fell upon all people.

text.am: መርዶክዮስን መፍራት በላያቸው ስለ ወደቀ በየአገሩ የነበሩ አዛውንትና ሹማምቶች አለቆችም፥ የንጉሡንም ሥራ የሚሠሩቱ ሁሉ አይሁድን አገዙ።
text.en: And all the rulers of the provinces, and the lieutenants, and the deputies, and officers of the king, helped the Jews; because the fear of Mordecai fell upon them.

text.am: ያ ሰው መርዶክዮስ ከፍ ከፍ እያለ ስለ ሄደ በንጉሡ ቤት ታላቅ ሆኖ ነበርና፥ የመርዶክዮስም ዝና በየአገሩ ሁሉ ተሰምቶ ነበርና።
text.en: For Mordecai was great in the king's house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces: for this man Mordecai waxed greater and greater.

text.am: አይሁድም ጠላቶቻቸውን ሁሉ በሰይፍ እየመቱ ገደሉአቸው፥ አጠፉአቸውም፤ በሚጠሉአቸውም ላይ እንደ ወደዱ አደረጉባቸው።
text.en: Thus the Jews smote all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and slaughter, and destruction, and did what they would unto those that hated them.

text.am: አይሁድም በሱሳ ግንብ አምስት መቶ ያህል ሰዎች ገደሉ አጠፉም።
text.en: And in Shushan the palace the Jews slew and destroyed five hundred men.

text.am: ፈርሰኔስ፥ ደልፎን፥ ፋስጋ፥ ፋረዳታ፥
text.en: And Parshandatha, and Dalphon, and Aspatha,

text.am: ፈርሰኔስ፥ ደልፎን፥ ፋስጋ፥ ፋረዳታ፥
text.en: And Poratha, and Adalia, and Aridatha,

text.am: በርያ፥ ሰርባካ፥ መርመሲማ፥ ሩፋዮስ፥ አርሳዮስ፥ ዛቡታዮስ የሚባሉትን፥
text.en: And Parmashta, and Arisai, and Aridai, and Vajezatha,

text.am: የሐመዳቱን ልጅ የአይሁድን ጠላት አሥሩን የሐማን ልጆች ገደሉ፤ ነገር ግን ወደ ብዝበዛው እጃቸውን አልዘረጉም።
text.en: The ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the enemy of the Jews, slew they; but on the spoil laid they not their hand.

text.am: በዚያም ቀን በሱሳ ግንብ የተገደሉት ሰዎች ቍጥር ወደ ንጉሡ መጣ።
text.en: On that day the number of those that were slain in Shushan the palace was brought before the king.

text.am: ንጉሡም ንግሥቲቱን አስቴርን። አይሁድ በሱሳ ግንብ አምስት መቶ ሰዎችንና አሥሩን የሐማ ልጆች ገደሉ አጠፉአቸውም፤ በቀሩትስ በንጉሡ አገሮች እንዴት አድርገው ይሆን! አሁንስ ልመናሽ ምንድር ነው? ይሰጥሻል፤ ሌላስ የምትሺው ምንድር ነው? ይደረጋል አላት።
text.en: And the king said unto Esther the queen, The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in Shushan the palace, and the ten sons of Haman; what have they done in the rest of the king's provinces? now what is thy petition? and it shall be granted thee: or what is thy request further? and it shall be done.

text.am: አስቴርም። ንጉሡን ደስ ቢያሰኘው በሱሳ የሚኖሩ አይሁድ ዛሬ እንደ ተደረገው ትእዛዝ ነገ ደግሞ ያድርጉ፤ አሥሩም የሐማ ልጆች በግንድ ላይ ይሰቀሉ አለች።
text.en: Then said Esther, If it please the king, let it be granted to the Jews which are in Shushan to do to morrow also according unto this day's decree, and let Haman's ten sons be hanged upon the gallows.

text.am: ንጉሡም ይህ ይደረግ ዘንድ አዘዘ፤ አዋጅም በሱሳ ተነገረ፤ አሥሩንም የሐማን ልጆች ሰቀሉ።
text.en: And the king commanded it so to be done: and the decree was given at Shushan; and they hanged Haman's ten sons.

text.am: በሱሳም የነበሩ አይሁድ አዳር በሚባለው ወር በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን ደግሞ ተሰብስበው በሱሳ ሦስት መቶ ያህል ሰዎች ገደሉ፤ ነገር ግን ወደ ብዝበዛው እጃቸውን አልዘረጉም።
text.en: For the Jews that were in Shushan gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and slew three hundred men at Shushan; but on the prey they laid not their hand.

text.am: የቀሩትም በንጉሡ አገር ያሉ አይሁድ ተሰብስበው ለሕይወታቸው ቆሙ፥ ከጠላቶቻቸውም ዐረፉ፤ ከሚጠሉአቸውም ሰባ አምስት ሺህ ገደሉ፤ ነገር ግን ወደ ብዝበዛው እጃቸውን አልዘረጉም።
text.en: But the other Jews that were in the king's provinces gathered themselves together, and stood for their lives, and had rest from their enemies, and slew of their foes seventy and five thousand, but they laid not their hands on the prey,

text.am: አዳር በሚባለው ወር በአሥራ ሦስተኛው ቀን ይህ ተደረገ፤ በአሥራ አራተኛውም ቀን ዐረፉ፥ የግብዣና የደስታም ቀን አደረጉ።
text.en: On the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of the same rested they, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

text.am: በሱሳ የነበሩት አይሁድ ግን በአሥራ ሦስተኛውና በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን ተሰበሰቡ፤ በአሥራ አምስተኛውም ቀን ዐረፉ፥ የመጠጥና የደስታም ቀን አደረጉት።
text.en: But the Jews that were at Shushan assembled together on the thirteenth day thereof, and on the fourteenth thereof; and on the fifteenth day of the same they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

text.am: ስለዚህም በመንደሮችና ባልተመሸጉ ከተሞች የሚኖሩ አይሁድ አዳር በሚባለው ወር አሥራ አራተኛውን ቀን የደስታና የመጠጥ የመልካምም ቀን፥ እርስ በርሳቸውም ስጦታ የሚሰጣጡበት ቀን ያደርጉታል።
text.en: Therefore the Jews of the villages, that dwelt in the unwalled towns, made the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, and a good day, and of sending portions one to another.

text.am: መርዶክዮስም ይህን ነገር ጻፈ፥ በንጉሡም በአርጤክስስ አገሮች ሁሉ በቅርብና በሩቅ ወዳሉት አይሁድ ሁሉ ደብዳቤዎችን ላከ።
text.en: And Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters unto all the Jews that were in all the provinces of the king Ahasuerus, both nigh and far,

text.am: በየዓመቱም አዳር በሚባለው ወር አሥራ አራተኛውና አሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን፥
text.en: To stablish this among them, that they should keep the fourteenth day of the month Adar, and the fifteenth day of the same, yearly,

text.am: አይሁድ ከጠላቶቻቸው ዕረፍትን ያገኙበት ቀን፥ ወሩም ከኀዘን ወደ ደስታ ከልቅሶም ወደ መልካም ቀን የተለወጠበት ወር ሆኖ ይጠብቁት ዘንድ፥ የግብዣና የደስታም ቀን፥ እርስ በርሳቸውም ስጦታ የሚሰጣጡበትና ለድሆች ስጦታ የሚሰጡበት ቀን ያደርጉት ዘንድ አዘዛቸው።
text.en: As the days wherein the Jews rested from their enemies, and the month which was turned unto them from sorrow to joy, and from mourning into a good day: that they should make them days of feasting and joy, and of sending portions one to another, and gifts to the poor.

text.am: አይሁድም ለመሥራት የጀመሩትን፥ መርዶክዮስም የጻፈላቸውን ያደርጉ ዘንድ ተቀበሉት፤
text.en: And the Jews undertook to do as they had begun, and as Mordecai had written unto them;

text.am: አጋጋዊው የሐመዳቱ ልጅ የአይሁድ ሁሉ ጠላት ሐማ አይሁድን ያጠፋ ዘንድ ተተንኵሎ ነበር፤ ሊደመስሳቸውና ሊያጠፋቸውም ፉር የሚባል ዕጣ ጥሎ ነበር።
text.en: Because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had devised against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast Pur, that is, the lot, to consume them, and to destroy them;

text.am: አስቴርም ወደ ንጉሡ ፊት በገባች ጊዜ በአይሁድ ላይ የተተነኰለው ክፉ ተንኰል በራሱ ላይ እንዲመለስ፥ እርሱና ልጆቹም በግንድ ላይ እንዲሰቀሉ በደብዳቤው አዘዘ።
text.en: But when Esther came before the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked device, which he devised against the Jews, should return upon his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.

text.am: ስለዚህም እነዚህ ቀኖች እንደ ፉር ስም ፉሪም ተባሉ። በዚህም ደብዳቤ ስለ ተጻፈው ቃል ሁሉ፥ ስላዩትና ስላገኙአቸውም ነገር ሁሉ፥
text.en: Wherefore they called these days Purim after the name of Pur. Therefore for all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and which had come unto them,

text.am: አይሁድ እነዚህን ሁለት ቀኖች እንደ ጽሕፈቱና እንደ ጊዜው በየዓመቱ ይጠብቁ ዘንድ፥ እነዚህም ቀኖች በየትውልዳቸውና በየወገናቸው በየአገራቸውም በየከተማቸውም የታሰቡና የተከበሩ ይሆኑ ዘንድ፥ እነዚህም የፉሪም ቀኖች በአይሁድ ዘንድ እንዳይሻሩ፥ መታሰባቸውም ከዘራቸው እንዳይቈረጥ፥ በራሳቸውና በዘራቸው ወደ እነርሱም በተጠጉት ሁሉ ላይ እንዳይቀር ሥርዓት አድርገው ተቀበሉ።
text.en: The Jews ordained, and took upon them, and upon their seed, and upon all such as joined themselves unto them, so as it should not fail, that they would keep these two days according to their writing, and according to their appointed time every year;

text.am: አይሁድ እነዚህን ሁለት ቀኖች እንደ ጽሕፈቱና እንደ ጊዜው በየዓመቱ ይጠብቁ ዘንድ፥ እነዚህም ቀኖች በየትውልዳቸውና በየወገናቸው በየአገራቸውም በየከተማቸውም የታሰቡና የተከበሩ ይሆኑ ዘንድ፥ እነዚህም የፉሪም ቀኖች በአይሁድ ዘንድ እንዳይሻሩ፥ መታሰባቸውም ከዘራቸው እንዳይቈረጥ፥ በራሳቸውና በዘራቸው ወደ እነርሱም በተጠጉት ሁሉ ላይ እንዳይቀር ሥርዓት አድርገው ተቀበሉ።
text.en: And that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor the memorial of them perish from their seed.

text.am: የአቢካኢልም ልጅ ንግሥቲቱ አስቴርና አይሁዳዊው መርዶክዮስ ይህችን ስለ ፉሪም የምትናገረውን ሁለተኛይቱን ደብዳቤ በሥልጣናቸው ሁሉ ያጸኑአት ዘንድ ጻፉ።
text.en: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew, wrote with all authority, to confirm this second letter of Purim.

text.am: ደብዳቤዎቹንም በአርጤክስስ መንግሥት በመቶ ሀያ ሰባቱ አገሮች ወዳሉ አይሁድ ሁሉ በሰላምና በእውነት ቃል ላኩ።
text.en: And he sent the letters unto all the Jews, to the hundred twenty and seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus, with words of peace and truth,

text.am: እነዚህንም የፉሪም ቀኖች፥ አይሁዳዊው መርዶክዮስና ንግሥቲቱ አስቴር እንዳዘዙ፥ ለራሳቸውና ለዘራቸውም የጾማቸውንና የልቅሶአቸውን ነገር ለማክበር እንደ ተቀበሉ፥ በየጊዜያቸው ያጸኑ ዘንድ ጻፉ።
text.en: To confirm these days of Purim in their times appointed, according as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had enjoined them, and as they had decreed for themselves and for their seed, the matters of the fastings and their cry.

text.am: የአስቴርም ትእዛዝ ይህን የፉሪምን ነገር አጸና፤ በመጽሐፍም ተጻፈ።
text.en: And the decree of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.

text.am: ንጉሡም አርጤክስስ በምድርና በባሕር ደሴቶች ላይ ግብር ጣለ።
text.en: And the king Ahasuerus laid a tribute upon the land, and upon the isles of the sea.

text.am: የኃይሉና የብርታቱም ሥራ ሁሉ ንጉሡም እስከ ምን ድረስ እንዳከበረው የመርዶክዮስ ክብር ታላቅነት፥ በሜዶንና በፋርስ ነገሥታት ታሪክ መጽሐፍ የተጻፈ አይደለምን?
text.en: And all the acts of his power and of his might, and the declaration of the greatness of Mordecai, whereunto the king advanced him, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

text.am: አይሁዳዊውም መርዶክዮስ ለንጉሡ ለአርጤክስስ በማዕርግ ሁለተኛ ነበረ፤ በአይሁድም ዘንድ የከበረ፥ በብዙ ወንድሞችም ዘንድ የተወደደ፥ ለሕዝቡም መልካምን የፈለገ፥ ለዘሩም ሁሉ በደኅና የተናገረ ነበረ።
text.en: For Mordecai the Jew was next unto king Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews, and accepted of the multitude of his brethren, seeking the wealth of his people, and speaking peace to all his seed.

text.am: ዖፅ በሚባል አገር ስሙ ኢዮብ የተባለ አንድ ሰው ነበረ፤ ያም ሰው ፍጹምና ቅን፥ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈራ፥ ከክፋትም የራቀ ነበረ።
text.en: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job; and that man was perfect and upright, and one that feared God, and eschewed evil.

text.am: ሰባትም ወንዶች ሦስትም ሴቶች ልጆች ተወልደውለት ነበር።
text.en: And there were born unto him seven sons and three daughters.

text.am: ሀብቱም ሰባት ሺህ በጎች፥ ሦስት ሺህም ግመሎች፥ አምስት መቶም ጥማድ በሬ፥ አምስት መቶም እንስት አህዮች ነበረ፥ እጅግ ብዙም ባሪያዎች ነበሩት፤ ያም ሰው በምሥራቅ ካሉ ሰዎች ሁሉ ይልቅ ታላቅ ነበረ።
text.en: His substance also was seven thousand sheep, and three thousand camels, and five hundred yoke of oxen, and five hundred she asses, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the men of the east.

text.am: ወንዶች ልጆቹም ሄደው በየተራ በያንዳንዳቸው ቤት ግብዣ ያደርጉ ነበር፤ ሦስቱ እኅቶቻቸውም ከእነርሱ ጋር ይበሉና ይጠጡ ዘንድ እነርሱ ልከው ይጠሩአቸው ነበር።
text.en: And his sons went and feasted in their houses, every one his day; and sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

text.am: የግብዣውም ቀኖች ባለፉ ጊዜ ኢዮብ። ምናልባት ልጆቼ በድለው፥ እግዚአብሔርንም በልባቸው ሰድበው ይሆናል ብሎ ይልክና ይቀድሳቸው ነበር፤ ኢዮብም ማልዶ ተነሣ፥ እንደ ቍጥራቸውም ሁሉ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት አቀረበ። እንዲሁ ኢዮብ ሁልጊዜ ያደርግ ነበር።
text.en: And it was so, when the days of their feasting were gone about, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all: for Job said, It may be that my sons have sinned, and cursed God in their hearts. Thus did Job continually.

text.am: ከዕለታት አንድ ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የአምላክ ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመቆም መጡ፥ ሰይጣንም ደግሞ በመካከላቸው መጣ።
text.en: Now there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan came also among them.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰይጣንን። ከወዴት መጣህ? አለው። ሰይጣንም። ምድርን ሁሉ ዞርሁአት፥ በእርስዋም ተመላለስሁ ብሎ ለእግዚአብሔር መለሰ።
text.en: And the LORD said unto Satan, Whence comest thou? Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰይጣንን። በውኑ ባሪያዬን ኢዮብን ተመለከትኸውን? በምድር ላይ እንደ እርሱ ፍጹምና ቅን፥ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈራ፥ ከክፋትም የራቀ ሰው የለም አለው።
text.en: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil?

text.am: ሰይጣንም ለእግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ብሎ መለሰለት። በውኑ ኢዮብ እግዚአብሔርን የሚፈራ በከንቱ ነውን?
text.en: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?

text.am: እርሱንና ቤቱን በዙሪያውም ያሉትን ሁሉ አላጠርህለትምን? የእጁን ሥራ ባርከህለታል፥ ከብቱም በምድር ላይ በዝቶአል።
text.en: Hast not thou made an hedge about him, and about his house, and about all that he hath on every side? thou hast blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

text.am: ነገር ግን እጅህን ዘርግተህ ያለውን ሁሉ ዳብስ፤ በእውነት በፊትህ ይሰድብሃል።
text.en: But put forth thine hand now, and touch all that he hath, and he will curse thee to thy face.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰይጣንን። እነሆ ለእርሱ ያለው ሁሉ በእጅህ ነው፥ ነገር ግን በእርሱ ላይ እጅህን አትዘርጋ አለው። ሰይጣንም ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወጣ።
text.en: And the LORD said unto Satan, Behold, all that he hath is in thy power; only upon himself put not forth thine hand. So Satan went forth from the presence of the LORD.

text.am: አንድ ቀንም እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የኢዮብ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆች በታላቅ ወንድማቸው ቤት ይበሉና የወይን ጠጅ ይጠጡ ነበር።
text.en: And there was a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:

text.am: መልክተኛም ወደ ኢዮብ መጥቶ። በሬዎች እርሻ ያርሱ፥ በአጠገባቸውም አህዮች ይሰማሩ ነበር፤
text.en: And there came a messenger unto Job, and said, The oxen were plowing, and the asses feeding beside them:

text.am: የሳባም ሰዎች አደጋ ጣሉ፥ ወሰዱአቸውም፥ ብላቴኖቹንም በሰይፍ ስለት ገደሉ፤ እኔም እነግርህ ዘንድ ብቻዬን አመለጥሁ አለው።
text.en: And the Sabeans fell upon them, and took them away; yea, they have slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

text.am: እርሱም ገና ሲናገር ሌላ መጥቶ። የእግዚአብሔር እሳት ከሰማይ ወደቀች፥ በጎቹንም አቃጠለች፥ ጠባቂዎችንም በላች፤ እኔም እነግርህ ዘንድ ብቻዬን አመለጥሁ አለው።
text.en: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The fire of God is fallen from heaven, and hath burned up the sheep, and the servants, and consumed them; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

text.am: እርሱም ገና ሲናገር ሌላ መጥቶ። ከለዳውያን በሦስት ረድፍ ተከፍለው በግመሎች ላይ አደጋ ጣሉ፥ ወሰዱአቸውም፥ ብላቴኖቹንም በሰይፍ ስለት ገደሉ፤ እኔም እነግርህ ዘንድ ብቻዬን አመለጥሁ አለው።
text.en: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, The Chaldeans made out three bands, and fell upon the camels, and have carried them away, yea, and slain the servants with the edge of the sword; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

text.am: እርሱም ገና ሲናገር ሌላ መጥቶ። ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችህ በታላቅ ወንድማቸው ቤት ይበሉና የወይን ጠጅ ይጠጡ ነበር፤
text.en: While he was yet speaking, there came also another, and said, Thy sons and thy daughters were eating and drinking wine in their eldest brother's house:

text.am: እነሆም፥ ዐውሎ ነፋስ ከምድረ በዳ መጥቶ የቤቱን አራቱን ማዕዘን መታው፥ በብላቴኖቹም ላይ ወደቀ፥ ሞቱም፤ እኔም እነግርህ ዘንድ ብቻዬን አመለጥሁ አለው።
text.en: And, behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and smote the four corners of the house, and it fell upon the young men, and they are dead; and I only am escaped alone to tell thee.

text.am: ኢዮብም ተነሣ መጐናጸፊያውንም ቀደደ፥ ራሱንም ተላጨ፥ በምድርም ላይ ተደፍቶ ሰገደ፤
text.en: Then Job arose, and rent his mantle, and shaved his head, and fell down upon the ground, and worshipped,

text.am: እንዲህም አለ። ራቁቴን ከእናቴ ማኅፀን ወጥቻለሁ፥ ራቁቴንም ወደዚያ እመለሳለሁ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሰጠ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ነሣ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ስም የተባረከ ይሁን።
text.en: And said, Naked came I out of my mother's womb, and naked shall I return thither: the LORD gave, and the LORD hath taken away; blessed be the name of the LORD.

text.am: በዚህ ሁሉ ኢዮብ አልበደለም፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ስንፍናን አልሰጠም።
text.en: In all this Job sinned not, nor charged God foolishly.

text.am: ከዕለታት አንድ ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤ የአምላክ ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመቆም መጡ፥ ሰይጣን ደግሞ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመቆም በመካከላቸው መጣ።
text.en: Again there was a day when the sons of God came to present themselves before the LORD, and Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰይጣንን። ከወዴት መጣህ? አለው። ሰይጣንም። በምድር ላይ ዞርሁ፥ በእርስዋም ተመላለስሁ ብሎ ለእግዚአብሔር መለሰ።
text.en: And the LORD said unto Satan, From whence comest thou? And Satan answered the LORD, and said, From going to and fro in the earth, and from walking up and down in it.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሰይጣንን። በውኑ ባሪያዬን ኢዮብን ተመለከትኸውን? በምድር ላይ እንደ እርሱ ፍጹምና ቅን፥ እግዚአብሔርንም የሚፈራ፥ ከክፋትም የራቀ ሰው የለም፤ በከንቱም አጠፋው ዘንድ አንተ በእርሱ ላይ ምንም ብታንቀሳቅሰኝ፥ እስከ አሁን ፍጹምነቱን ይዞአል።
text.en: And the LORD said unto Satan, Hast thou considered my servant Job, that there is none like him in the earth, a perfect and an upright man, one that feareth God, and escheweth evil? and still he holdeth fast his integrity, although thou movedst me against him, to destroy him without cause.

text.am: ሰይጣንም መልሶ እግዚአብሔርን። ቁርበት ስለ ቁርበት ነው፤ ሰው ያለውን ሁሉ ስለ ሕይወቱ ይሰጣል።
text.en: And Satan answered the LORD, and said, Skin for skin, yea, all that a man hath will he give for his life.

text.am: ነገር ግን አሁን እጅህን ዘርግተህ አጥንቱንና ሥጋውን ዳብስ፤ በእውነት በፊትህ ይሰድብሃል አለው።
text.en: But put forth thine hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will curse thee to thy face.

text.am: እግዚአብሔም ሰይጣንን። ሕይወቱን ተወው እንጂ እነሆ፥ እርሱ በእጅህ ነው አለው።
text.en: And the LORD said unto Satan, Behold, he is in thine hand; but save his life.

text.am: ሰይጣንም ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወጣ፥ ኢዮብንም ከእግሩ ጫማ ጀምሮ እስከ አናቱ ድረስ በክፉ ቍስል መታው።
text.en: So went Satan forth from the presence of the LORD, and smote Job with sore boils from the sole of his foot unto his crown.

text.am: ሥጋውንም ይፍቅበት ዘንድ ገል ወሰደ፥ በአመድም ላይ ተቀመጠ።
text.en: And he took him a potsherd to scrape himself withal; and he sat down among the ashes.

text.am: ሚስቱም። እስከ አሁን ፍጹምነትህን ይዘሃልን? እግዚአብሔርን ስደብና ሙት አለችው።
text.en: Then said his wife unto him, Dost thou still retain thine integrity? curse God, and die.

text.am: እርሱ ግን አንቺ ከሰነፎች ሴቶች እንደ አንዲቱ ተናገርሽ፤ ከእግዚአብሔር እጅ መልካሙን ተቀበልን፥ ክፉ ነገርንስ አንቀበልምን? አላት። በዚህ ሁሉ ኢዮብ በከንፈሩ አልበደለም።
text.en: But he said unto her, Thou speakest as one of the foolish women speaketh. What? shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil? In all this did not Job sin with his lips.

text.am: ሦስቱም የኢዮብ ወዳጆች ይህን የደረሰበትን ክፉ ነገር ሁሉ ሰምተው ከየአገራቸው መጡ፤ እነርሱም ቴማናዊው ኤልፋዝ፥ ሹሐዊው በልዳዶስ፥ ነዕማታዊው ሶፋር ነበሩ። እነርሱም ሊያዝኑለትና ሊያጽናኑት በአንድነት ወደ እርሱ ለመምጣት ተስማሙ።
text.en: Now when Job's three friends heard of all this evil that was come upon him, they came every one from his own place; Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite: for they had made an appointment together to come to mourn with him and to comfort him.

text.am: ከሩቅም ሆነው ዓይናቸውን ባነሡ ጊዜ አላወቁትም፤ ድምፃቸውንም አሰምተው አለቀሱ፤ እያንዳንዳቸውም መጐናጸፊያቸውን ቀደዱ፥ ወደ ላይም ወደ ራሳቸው ላይ ትቢያ ነሰነሱ።
text.en: And when they lifted up their eyes afar off, and knew him not, they lifted up their voice, and wept; and they rent every one his mantle, and sprinkled dust upon their heads toward heaven.

text.am: ሰባት ቀንና ሰባት ሌሊትም ከእርሱ ጋር በምድር ላይ ተቀመጡ፤ ሕመሙም እጅግ እንደ በዛ አይተዋልና ከእነርሱ አንድ ቃል የሚናገረው አልነበረም።
text.en: So they sat down with him upon the ground seven days and seven nights, and none spake a word unto him: for they saw that his grief was very great.

text.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ኢዮብ አፉን ከፍቶ የተወለደበትን ቀን ረገመ።
text.en: After this opened Job his mouth, and cursed his day.

text.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህ አለ።
text.en: And Job spake, and said,

text.am: ያ የተወለድሁበት ቀን ይጥፋ፥
text.en: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night in which it was said, There is a man child conceived.

text.am: ያ ቀን ጨለማ ይሁን፤
text.en: Let that day be darkness; let not God regard it from above, neither let the light shine upon it.

text.am: ጨለማና የሞት ጥላ የራሳቸው ገንዘብ ያድርጉት፤
text.en: Let darkness and the shadow of death stain it; let a cloud dwell upon it; let the blackness of the day terrify it.

text.am: ያን ሌሊት ጨለማ ይያዘው፤
text.en: As for that night, let darkness seize upon it; let it not be joined unto the days of the year, let it not come into the number of the months.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ያ ሌሊት መካን ይሁን፤
text.en: Lo, let that night be solitary, let no joyful voice come therein.

text.am: ሌዋታንን ለማንቀሳቀስ የተዘጋጁ
text.en: Let them curse it that curse the day, who are ready to raise up their mourning.

text.am: አጥቢያ ኮከቦች ይጨልሙ፤
text.en: Let the stars of the twilight thereof be dark; let it look for light, but have none; neither let it see the dawning of the day:

text.am: የእናቴን ማኅፀን ደጅ አልዘጋምና፥
text.en: Because it shut not up the doors of my mother's womb, nor hid sorrow from mine eyes.

text.am: በማኅፀን ሳለሁ ስለ ምን አልሞትሁም?
text.en: Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?

text.am: ጕልበቶች ስለ ምን ተቀበሉኝ?
text.en: Why did the knees prevent me? or why the breasts that I should suck?

text.am: አሁን ተኝቼ ዝም ባልሁ ነበር፤
text.en: For now should I have lain still and been quiet, I should have slept: then had I been at rest,

text.am: የፈረሰውን ለራሳቸው ከሚሠሩት
text.en: With kings and counsellors of the earth, which built desolate places for themselves;

text.am: ወይም ቤታቸውን ብር ከሞሉ
text.en: Or with princes that had gold, who filled their houses with silver:

text.am: ወይም እንደ ተቀበረ ጭንጋፍ፥
text.en: Or as an hidden untimely birth I had not been; as infants which never saw light.

text.am: ክፉዎች በዚያ መናደዳቸውን ይተዋሉ፤
text.en: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest.

text.am: በዚያ ግዞተኞች በአንድነት ተዘልለው ተቀምጠዋል፤
text.en: There the prisoners rest together; they hear not the voice of the oppressor.

text.am: ታናሽና ታላቅ በዚያ አሉ፤
text.en: The small and great are there; and the servant is free from his master.

text.am: በመከራ ላሉት ብርሃን፥
text.en: Wherefore is light given to him that is in misery, and life unto the bitter in soul;

text.am: የተሰወረ ሀብትን ከሚቈፍሩ ይልቅ
text.en: Which long for death, but it cometh not; and dig for it more than for hid treasures;

text.am: መቃብርን ባገኙ ጊዜ
text.en: Which rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

text.am: መንገዱ ለተሰወረበት ሰው፥
text.en: Why is light given to a man whose way is hid, and whom God hath hedged in?

text.am: ከእንጀራዬ በፊት ልቅሶዬ መጥቶአልና፥
text.en: For my sighing cometh before I eat, and my roarings are poured out like the waters.

text.am: የፈራሁት ነገር መጥቶብኛልና፥
text.en: For the thing which I greatly feared is come upon me, and that which I was afraid of is come unto me.

text.am: ተዘልዬ አልተቀመጥሁም፥ አልተማመንሁም፥ አላረፍሁም፤
text.en: I was not in safety, neither had I rest, neither was I quiet; yet trouble came.

text.am: ቴማናዊውም ኤልፋዝ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

text.am: አንድ ሰው ከአንተ ጋር ይናገር ዘንድ ቢሞክር ትቀየማለህን?
text.en: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?

text.am: እነሆ፥ አንተ ብዙዎችን ታስተምር ነበር፥
text.en: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.

text.am: ቃልህ የሚሰናከለውን ያስነሣ ነበር፥
text.en: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.

text.am: አሁን ግን በአንተ ላይ መጥቶአል፥ አንተም ደከምህ፤
text.en: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.

text.am: አምላክህን መፍራትህ መጽናናትህ፥
text.en: Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?

text.am: እባክህ አስብ፥ ንጹሕ ሆኖ የጠፋ ማን ነው?
text.en: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?

text.am: እኔ እንዳየሁ፥ ኃጢአትን የሚያርሱ፥
text.en: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.

text.am: በእግዚአብሔር እስትንፋስ ይጠፋሉ፥
text.en: By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.

text.am: የአንበሳ ጩኸት፥ የጩዋኺ አንበሳ ድምፅ፥
text.en: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

text.am: አሮጌ አንበሳ አደን በማጣት ይሞታል፥
text.en: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the stout lion's whelps are scattered abroad.

text.am: ለእኔም በምሥጢር ቃል መጣልኝ፥
text.en: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof.

text.am: በሌሊት ሕልም አሳብ ሲነሣ፥
text.en: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,

text.am: አጥንቴን ሁሉ ያናወጡ
text.en: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.

text.am: መንፈስም በፊቴ አለፈ፤
text.en: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:

text.am: እርሱም ቆመ፥ መልኩን ግን ለመለየት አልቻልሁም፥
text.en: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before mine eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice, saying,

text.am: በውኑ ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጻድቅ ሊሆን፥
text.en: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?

text.am: እነሆ፥ በባሪያዎቹ አይታመንም፤
text.en: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:

text.am: ይልቁንስ በጭቃ ቤት የሚኖሩ፥
text.en: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?

text.am: በጥዋትና በማታ መካከል ይሰባበራሉ፤
text.en: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding it.

text.am: ገመዳቸው የተነቀለ አይደለምን?
text.en: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.

text.am: አሁንም ጥራ፤ የሚመልስልህ አለን?
text.en: Call now, if there be any that will answer thee; and to which of the saints wilt thou turn?

text.am: ሰነፉን ሰው ቍጣ ይገድለዋል፥
text.en: For wrath killeth the foolish man, and envy slayeth the silly one.

text.am: ሰነፍ ሰው ሥር ሰድዶ አየሁት፥
text.en: I have seen the foolish taking root: but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

text.am: ልጆቹም ከደኅንነት ርቀዋል፥
text.en: His children are far from safety, and they are crushed in the gate, neither is there any to deliver them.

text.am: የሰበሰበውንም ራብተኛ ይበላዋል፥
text.en: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up, and taketh it even out of the thorns, and the robber swalloweth up their substance.

text.am: ችግር ከትቢያ አይመጣም፥
text.en: Although affliction cometh not forth of the dust, neither doth trouble spring out of the ground;

text.am: የአሞራ ግልገሎች ግን ወደ ላይ እየበረሩ ከፍ እንዲሉ፥
text.en: Yet man is born unto trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

text.am: እኔ ግን እግዚአብሔርን እለምን ነበር፥
text.en: I would seek unto God, and unto God would I commit my cause:

text.am: የማይመረመረውን ታላቅ ነገርና
text.en: Which doeth great things and unsearchable; marvellous things without number:

text.am: በምድር ላይ ዝናብን ይሰጣል፥
text.en: Who giveth rain upon the earth, and sendeth waters upon the fields:

text.am: የተዋረዱትን ወደ ላይ ያወጣል፥
text.en: To set up on high those that be low; that those which mourn may be exalted to safety.

text.am: እጃቸውም ምክራቸውን እንዳይፈጽም
text.en: He disappointeth the devices of the crafty, so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise.

text.am: ጠቢባንን በተንኰላቸው ይይዛቸዋል፤
text.en: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong.

text.am: በቀን ጨለማን ያገኛሉ፥
text.en: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope in the noonday as in the night.

text.am: ድሀውንም ከአፋቸው ሰይፍ
text.en: But he saveth the poor from the sword, from their mouth, and from the hand of the mighty.

text.am: ለምስኪኑም ተስፋ አለው፤
text.en: So the poor hath hope, and iniquity stoppeth her mouth.

text.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር የሚገሥጸው ሰው ምስጉን ነው፤
text.en: Behold, happy is the man whom God correcteth: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty:

text.am: እርሱ ይሰብራል፥ ይጠግንማል፤
text.en: For he maketh sore, and bindeth up: he woundeth, and his hands make whole.

text.am: በስድስት ክፉ ነገር ውስጥ ያድንሃል፥
text.en: He shall deliver thee in six troubles: yea, in seven there shall no evil touch thee.

text.am: በራብ ጊዜ ከሞት፥
text.en: In famine he shall redeem thee from death: and in war from the power of the sword.

text.am: ከምላስ ጅራፍ ትሰወራለህ፤
text.en: Thou shalt be hid from the scourge of the tongue: neither shalt thou be afraid of destruction when it cometh.

text.am: በጥፋትና በራብ ላይ ትስቃለህ፤
text.en: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.

text.am: ቃል ኪዳንህ ከምድረ በዳ ድንጋይ ጋር ይሆናልና፤
text.en: For thou shalt be in league with the stones of the field: and the beasts of the field shall be at peace with thee.

text.am: ድንኳንህም በሰላም እንዲሆን ታውቃለህ፤
text.en: And thou shalt know that thy tabernacle shall be in peace; and thou shalt visit thy habitation, and shalt not sin.

text.am: ዘርህም ታላቅ እንዲሆን፥
text.en: Thou shalt know also that thy seed shall be great, and thine offspring as the grass of the earth.

text.am: በወራቱ የእህሉ ነዶ ወደ አውድማ እንዲገባ፥
text.en: Thou shalt come to thy grave in a full age, like as a shock of corn cometh in in his season.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ይህችን መረመርን፥ የሰማነውም ይህ ነው፤
text.en: Lo this, we have searched it, so it is; hear it, and know thou it for thy good.

text.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: But Job answered and said,

text.am: ትካዜዬ ምነው በተመዘነ ኖሮ!
text.en: Oh that my grief were throughly weighed, and my calamity laid in the balances together!

text.am: ከባሕር አሸዋ ይልቅ ይከብድ ነበርና፤
text.en: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the sea: therefore my words are swallowed up.

text.am: ሁሉን የሚችል የአምላክ ፍላጻ በሥጋዬ ውስጥ ነው፥
text.en: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of God do set themselves in array against me.

text.am: በውኑ የሜዳ አህያ ሣር ሳለው ይጮኻልን?
text.en: Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? or loweth the ox over his fodder?

text.am: የማይጣፍጥስ ነገር ያለ ጨው ይበላልን?
text.en: Can that which is unsavoury be eaten without salt? or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

text.am: ሰውነቴ ትነካው ዘንድ እንቢ አለችው፤
text.en: The things that my soul refused to touch are as my sorrowful meat.

text.am: ልመናዬ ምነው በደረሰልኝ!
text.en: Oh that I might have my request; and that God would grant me the thing that I long for!

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም ያደቀኝ ዘንድ
text.en: Even that it would please God to destroy me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

text.am: መጽናናት በሆነልኝ ነበር፤
text.en: Then should I yet have comfort; yea, I would harden myself in sorrow: let him not spare; for I have not concealed the words of the Holy One.

text.am: እጠብቅ ዘንድ ጕልበቴ ምንድር ነው?
text.en: What is my strength, that I should hope? and what is mine end, that I should prolong my life?

text.am: ጕልበቴ የድንጋይ ጕልበት ነውን?
text.en: Is my strength the strength of stones? or is my flesh of brass?

text.am: በውኑ ረድኤት በእኔ እንደሌለ
text.en: Is not my help in me? and is wisdom driven quite from me?

text.am: ሁሉን የሚችለውን የአምላክን መፍራት
text.en: To him that is afflicted pity should be shewed from his friend; but he forsaketh the fear of the Almighty.

text.am: ወንድሞቼ እንደ ፈፋ፥
text.en: My brethren have dealt deceitfully as a brook, and as the stream of brooks they pass away;

text.am: ከበረዶ የተነሣ ደፈረሱ፥
text.en: Which are blackish by reason of the ice, and wherein the snow is hid:

text.am: ፀሐይ በተኰሰች ጊዜ ይደርቃሉ፤
text.en: What time they wax warm, they vanish: when it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

text.am: በየዳርቻቸውም የሚሄዱ ነጋዴዎች ፈቀቅ ይላሉ፤
text.en: The paths of their way are turned aside; they go to nothing, and perish.

text.am: የቴማን ነጋዴዎች ተመለከቱ፥
text.en: The troops of Tema looked, the companies of Sheba waited for them.

text.am: ተስፋ አድርገዋቸው ነበርና አፈሩ፤
text.en: They were confounded because they had hoped; they came thither, and were ashamed.

text.am: አሁንም እናንተ እንደዚሁ ሆናችኋል፤
text.en: For now ye are nothing; ye see my casting down, and are afraid.

text.am: በውኑ። አንዳች ነገር አምጡልኝ፤
text.en: Did I say, Bring unto me? or, Give a reward for me of your substance?

text.am: ወይስ። ከጠላቴ እጅ አስጥሉኝ፤
text.en: Or, Deliver me from the enemy's hand? or, Redeem me from the hand of the mighty?

text.am: አስተምሩኝ፥ እኔም ዝም እላለሁ፤
text.en: Teach me, and I will hold my tongue: and cause me to understand wherein I have erred.

text.am: የቅንነት ቃል እንዴት ኃይለኛ ነው!
text.en: How forcible are right words! but what doth your arguing reprove?

text.am: ተስፋ የሌለው ሰው ንግግር እንደ ነፋስ ነውና
text.en: Do ye imagine to reprove words, and the speeches of one that is desperate, which are as wind?

text.am: በድሀ አደጉ ላይ ዕጣ ትጣጣላላችሁ፤
text.en: Yea, ye overwhelm the fatherless, and ye dig a pit for your friend.

text.am: አሁንም፥ እባካችሁ፥ ወደ እኔ ተመልከቱ፤
text.en: Now therefore be content, look upon me; for it is evident unto you if I lie.

text.am: እባካችሁ፥ ተመለሱ፤ በደል አይሁን፤
text.en: Return, I pray you, let it not be iniquity; yea, return again, my righteousness is in it.

text.am: በውኑ በአንደበቴ በደል ይገኛልን?
text.en: Is there iniquity in my tongue? cannot my taste discern perverse things?

text.am: በምድር ላይ የሰው ሕይወት ብርቱ ሰልፍ አይደለምን?
text.en: Is there not an appointed time to man upon earth? are not his days also like the days of an hireling?

text.am: አገልጋይ ጥላ እንደሚመኝ፥
text.en: As a servant earnestly desireth the shadow, and as an hireling looketh for the reward of his work:

text.am: እንዲሁ ዕጣዬ የከንቱ ወራት ሆነብኝ፥
text.en: So am I made to possess months of vanity, and wearisome nights are appointed to me.

text.am: በተኛሁ ጊዜ። መቼ እነሣለሁ? እላለሁ።
text.en: When I lie down, I say, When shall I arise, and the night be gone? and I am full of tossings to and fro unto the dawning of the day.

text.am: ሥጋዬ ትልና ጓል ለብሶአል፤
text.en: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust; my skin is broken, and become loathsome.

text.am: ዘመኔ ከሸማኔ መወርወርያ ይልቅ ይቸኵላል፥
text.en: My days are swifter than a weaver's shuttle, and are spent without hope.

text.am: ሕይወቴ እስትንፋስ እንደ ሆነ አስብ፤
text.en: O remember that my life is wind: mine eye shall no more see good.

text.am: የሚያየኝ ሰው ዓይን ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አያየኝም፤
text.en: The eye of him that hath seen me shall see me no more: thine eyes are upon me, and I am not.

text.am: ደመና ተበትኖ እንደሚጠፋ፥
text.en: As the cloud is consumed and vanisheth away: so he that goeth down to the grave shall come up no more.

text.am: ወደ ቤቱ ዳግመኛ አይመለስም፥
text.en: He shall return no more to his house, neither shall his place know him any more.

text.am: ስለዚህም አፌን አልከለክልም፤
text.en: Therefore I will not refrain my mouth; I will speak in the anguish of my spirit; I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

text.am: ጠባቂ ታስነሣብኝ ዘንድ፥
text.en: Am I a sea, or a whale, that thou settest a watch over me?

text.am: እኔም። አልጋዬ ያጽናናኛል፥
text.en: When I say, My bed shall comfort me, my couch shall ease my complaint;

text.am: አንተ በሕልም ታስፈራራኛለህ፥
text.en: Then thou scarest me with dreams, and terrifiest me through visions:

text.am: ነፍሴም ከአጥንቴ ይልቅ
text.en: So that my soul chooseth strangling, and death rather than my life.

text.am: ሕይወቴን ናቅኋት፤ ለዘላለም ልኖር አልወድድም።
text.en: I loathe it; I would not live alway: let me alone; for my days are vanity.

text.am: ሰው ምንድር ነው ታከብረው ዘንድ፥
text.en: What is man, that thou shouldest magnify him? and that thou shouldest set thine heart upon him?

text.am: ማለዳ ማለዳስ ትጐበኘው ዘንድ፥
text.en: And that thou shouldest visit him every morning, and try him every moment?

text.am: የማትተወኝ እስከ መቼ ነው?
text.en: How long wilt thou not depart from me, nor let me alone till I swallow down my spittle?

text.am: ሰውን የምትጠብቅ ሆይ፥ በድዬስ እንደ ሆነ ምን ላድርግልህ?
text.en: I have sinned; what shall I do unto thee, O thou preserver of men? why hast thou set me as a mark against thee, so that I am a burden to myself?

text.am: ስለ ምን መተላለፌን ይቅር አትልም?
text.en: And why dost thou not pardon my transgression, and take away mine iniquity? for now shall I sleep in the dust; and thou shalt seek me in the morning, but I shall not be.

text.am: ሹሐዊውም በልዳዶስ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

text.am: እስከ መቼ ይህን ትናገራለህ?
text.en: How long wilt thou speak these things? and how long shall the words of thy mouth be like a strong wind?

text.am: በውኑ እግዚአብሔር ፍርድን ያጣምማልን?
text.en: Doth God pervert judgment? or doth the Almighty pervert justice?

text.am: ልጆችህ በድለውት እንደ ሆነ፥
text.en: If thy children have sinned against him, and he have cast them away for their transgression;

text.am: እግዚአብሔርን ብትገሠግሥ፥
text.en: If thou wouldest seek unto God betimes, and make thy supplication to the Almighty;

text.am: ንጹሕና ቅን ብትሆን፥
text.en: If thou wert pure and upright; surely now he would awake for thee, and make the habitation of thy righteousness prosperous.

text.am: ጅማሬህ ታናሽ ቢሆንም እንኳ
text.en: Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase.

text.am: ዘመናችን በምድር ላይ እንደ ጥላ ነውና
text.en: For enquire, I pray thee, of the former age, and prepare thyself to the search of their fathers:

text.am: ዘመናችን በምድር ላይ እንደ ጥላ ነውና
text.en: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days upon earth are a shadow:)

text.am: እነርሱ የሚያስተምሩህና የሚነግሩህ፥
text.en: Shall not they teach thee, and tell thee, and utter words out of their heart?

text.am: በውኑ ደንገል ረግረግ በሌለበት መሬት ይበቅላልን?
text.en: Can the rush grow up without mire? can the flag grow without water?

text.am: ገና ሲለመልም ሳይቈረጥም፥
text.en: Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርን የሚረሱ ሁሉ ፍጻሜአቸው እንዲሁ ነው፤
text.en: So are the paths of all that forget God; and the hypocrite's hope shall perish:

text.am: ተስፋው ይቈረጣል፥
text.en: Whose hope shall be cut off, and whose trust shall be a spider's web.

text.am: ቤቱን ይደግፈዋል፥ አይቆምለትም፤
text.en: He shall lean upon his house, but it shall not stand: he shall hold it fast, but it shall not endure.

text.am: ፀሐይም ሳይተኵስ ይለመልማል፥
text.en: He is green before the sun, and his branch shooteth forth in his garden.

text.am: በድንጋይ ክምር ላይ ሥሩ ይጠመጠማል፤
text.en: His roots are wrapped about the heap, and seeth the place of stones.

text.am: ከቦታው ቢጠፋ።
text.en: If he destroy him from his place, then it shall deny him, saying, I have not seen thee.

text.am: እነሆ፥ የመንገዱ ደስታ እንዲህ ነው፤
text.en: Behold, this is the joy of his way, and out of the earth shall others grow.

text.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ፍጹሙን ሰው አይጥለውም፥
text.en: Behold, God will not cast away a perfect man, neither will he help the evil doers:

text.am: አፍህን እንደ ገና ሳቅ ይሞላል፥
text.en: Till he fill thy mouth with laughing, and thy lips with rejoicing.

text.am: የሚጠሉህ እፍረት ይለብሳሉ፤
text.en: They that hate thee shall be clothed with shame; and the dwelling place of the wicked shall come to nought.

text.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: Then Job answered and said,

text.am: በእውነት እንዲህ እንደ ሆነ አወቅሁ፤
text.en: I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?

text.am: ከእርሱ ጋር ይከራከር ዘንድ ቢወድድ፥
text.en: If he will contend with him, he cannot answer him one of a thousand.

text.am: ልቡ ጠቢብ፥ ኃይሉም ታላቅ ነው፤
text.en: He is wise in heart, and mighty in strength: who hath hardened himself against him, and hath prospered?

text.am: ተራሮችን ይነቅላል፤ አያውቁትም፤
text.en: Which removeth the mountains, and they know not: which overturneth them in his anger.

text.am: ምድርን ከስፍራው ያናውጣታል፥
text.en: Which shaketh the earth out of her place, and the pillars thereof tremble.

text.am: ፀሐይን ያዝዛታል፥ አትወጣምም፤
text.en: Which commandeth the sun, and it riseth not; and sealeth up the stars.

text.am: ሰማያትን ብቻውን ይዘረጋል፥
text.en: Which alone spreadeth out the heavens, and treadeth upon the waves of the sea.

text.am: ድብ የሚባለውን ኮከብና ኦሪዮን የሚባለውን ኮከብ፥ ሰባቱንም ከዋክብት፥
text.en: Which maketh Arcturus, Orion, and Pleiades, and the chambers of the south.

text.am: የማይመረመረውን ታላላቅ ነገር፥
text.en: Which doeth great things past finding out; yea, and wonders without number.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ቢመጣብኝ አላየውም፤
text.en: Lo, he goeth by me, and I see him not: he passeth on also, but I perceive him not.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ፈጥኖ ቢነጥቅ የሚከለክለው ማን ነው?
text.en: Behold, he taketh away, who can hinder him? who will say unto him, What doest thou?

text.am: እግዚአብሔር ቍጣውን አይመልስም፤
text.en: If God will not withdraw his anger, the proud helpers do stoop under him.

text.am: ይልቁንስ እመልስለት ዘንድ፥
text.en: How much less shall I answer him, and choose out my words to reason with him?

text.am: ጻድቅ ብሆን ኖሮ አልመልስለትም ነበር፤
text.en: Whom, though I were righteous, yet would I not answer, but I would make supplication to my judge.

text.am: ብጠራው እርሱም ቢመልስልኝ ኖሮ፥
text.en: If I had called, and he had answered me; yet would I not believe that he had hearkened unto my voice.

text.am: በዐውሎ ነፋስ ይሰብረኛል፥
text.en: For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.

text.am: እተነፍስ ዘንድ አይተወኝም፥
text.en: He will not suffer me to take my breath, but filleth me with bitterness.

text.am: የኃይል ነገር ቢሆን እርሱ ኃያል ነው፤
text.en: If I speak of strength, lo, he is strong: and if of judgment, who shall set me a time to plead?

text.am: ጻድቅ ብሆን አፌ ይወቅሰኛል፤
text.en: If I justify myself, mine own mouth shall condemn me: if I say, I am perfect, it shall also prove me perverse.

text.am: ፍጹም ነኝ ራሴንም አልመለከትም፤
text.en: Though I were perfect, yet would I not know my soul: I would despise my life.

text.am: ይህ ሁሉ አንድ ነው፤ ስለዚህ።
text.en: This is one thing, therefore I said it, He destroyeth the perfect and the wicked.

text.am: መቅሠፍቱ ፈጥኖ ቢገድል፥
text.en: If the scourge slay suddenly, he will laugh at the trial of the innocent.

text.am: ምድር በኃጥአን እጅ ተሰጥታለች፤
text.en: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?

text.am: ዘመኔ ከሚሮጥ ሰው ይልቅ ይፈጥናል፤
text.en: Now my days are swifter than a post: they flee away, they see no good.

text.am: የደንገል ታንኳ እንደሚፈጥን፥
text.en: They are passed away as the swift ships: as the eagle that hasteth to the prey.

text.am: እኔ። የኀዘን እንጕርጕሮዬን እረሳለሁ፤
text.en: If I say, I will forget my complaint, I will leave off my heaviness, and comfort myself:

text.am: ንጹሕ እንደማታደርገኝ እኔ አውቃለሁና
text.en: I am afraid of all my sorrows, I know that thou wilt not hold me innocent.

text.am: በደለኛ እንደሚሆን ሰው እሆናለሁ፤
text.en: If I be wicked, why then labour I in vain?

text.am: በአመዳይ ውስጥ ብታጠብ፥
text.en: If I wash myself with snow water, and make my hands never so clean;

text.am: በአዘቅት ውስጥ ታሰጥመኛለህ፥
text.en: Yet shalt thou plunge me in the ditch, and mine own clothes shall abhor me.

text.am: እንድመልስለት አብረን ወደ ፍርድ እንገባ ዘንድ፥
text.en: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, and we should come together in judgment.

text.am: እጁን በሁለታችን ላይ የሚያኖር ዳኛ
text.en: Neither is there any daysman betwixt us, that might lay his hand upon us both.

text.am: በትሩን ከእኔ ላይ ያርቅ፥
text.en: Let him take his rod away from me, and let not his fear terrify me:

text.am: እናገርም ነበር፥ አልፈራውምም ነበር፤
text.en: Then would I speak, and not fear him; but it is not so with me.

text.am: ነፍሴ ሕይወቴን ሰለቸቻት፤
text.en: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint upon myself; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርን እንዲህ እለዋለሁ።
text.en: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; shew me wherefore thou contendest with me.

text.am: ልታስጨንቅና የእጅህን ሥራ ልትንቅ
text.en: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, that thou shouldest despise the work of thine hands, and shine upon the counsel of the wicked?

text.am: በውኑ የሥጋ ዓይን አለህን?
text.en: Hast thou eyes of flesh? or seest thou as man seeth?

text.am: ወይስ ክፋቴን ትፈላለግ ዘንድ፥
text.en: Are thy days as the days of man? are thy years as man's days,

text.am: ወይስ ክፋቴን ትፈላለግ ዘንድ፥
text.en: That thou enquirest after mine iniquity, and searchest after my sin?

text.am: ከዚህም በላይ በደለኛ እንዳልሆንሁ፥
text.en: Thou knowest that I am not wicked; and there is none that can deliver out of thine hand.

text.am: እጅህ ለወሰችኝ ሠራችኝም፤
text.en: Thine hands have made me and fashioned me together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.

text.am: እንደ ጭቃ አድርገህ እንደ ለወስኸኝ አስብ፤
text.en: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast made me as the clay; and wilt thou bring me into dust again?

text.am: በውኑ እንደ ወተት አላፈሰስኸኝምን?
text.en: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, and curdled me like cheese?

text.am: ቁርበትና ሥጋ አለበስኸኝ፥
text.en: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, and hast fenced me with bones and sinews.

text.am: ሕይወትና ቸርነት አደረግህልኝ፤
text.en: Thou hast granted me life and favour, and thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.

text.am: እነዚህንም ነገሮች በልብህ ውስጥ ሰወርህ።
text.en: And these things hast thou hid in thine heart: I know that this is with thee.

text.am: ኃጢአት ብሠራ አንተ ትመለከተኛለህ፤
text.en: If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.

text.am: በደለኛ ብሆን ወዮልኝ፤
text.en: If I be wicked, woe unto me; and if I be righteous, yet will I not lift up my head. I am full of confusion; therefore see thou mine affliction;

text.am: ራሴም ከፍ ከፍ ቢል እንደ አንበሳ ታድነኛለህ፤
text.en: For it increaseth. Thou huntest me as a fierce lion: and again thou shewest thyself marvellous upon me.

text.am: ምስክሮችህን ታድስብኛለህ፤
text.en: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me; changes and war are against me.

text.am: ስለ ምን ከማኅፀን አወጣኸኝ?
text.en: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? Oh that I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me!

text.am: እንዳልነበረ በሆንሁ፤
text.en: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

text.am: የሕይወቴ ዘመን ጥቂት አይደለምን?
text.en: Are not my days few? cease then, and let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,

text.am: ወደማልመለስበት ስፍራ፥
text.en: Before I go whence I shall not return, even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;

text.am: እንደ ጨለማም ወደ ጨለመች፥
text.en: A land of darkness, as darkness itself; and of the shadow of death, without any order, and where the light is as darkness.

text.am: ነዕማታዊውም ሶፋር መለስ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

text.am: በውኑ ለቃል ብዛት መልስ መስጠት አይገባምን?
text.en: Should not the multitude of words be answered? and should a man full of talk be justified?

text.am: ትምክህትህስ ሰዎችን ዝም ያሰኛቸዋልን?
text.en: Should thy lies make men hold their peace? and when thou mockest, shall no man make thee ashamed?

text.am: አንተ። ትምህርቴ የተጣራ ነው፥
text.en: For thou hast said, My doctrine is pure, and I am clean in thine eyes.

text.am: ምነው እግዚአብሔር ቢናገርህ!
text.en: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against thee;

text.am: የጥበቡን ምሥጢር ቢገልጥልህ!
text.en: And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.

text.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ጥልቅ ነገር ልትመረምር ትችላለህን?
text.en: Canst thou by searching find out God? canst thou find out the Almighty unto perfection?

text.am: ከሰማይ ይልቅ ከፍ ይላል፤ ምን ልታደርግ ትችላለህ?
text.en: It is as high as heaven; what canst thou do? deeper than hell; what canst thou know?

text.am: ርዝመቱ ከምድር ይልቅ ይረዝማል፥
text.en: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

text.am: እርሱ ቢያልፍ፥ ቢዘጋም፥ ጉባኤንም ቢሰበስብ፥
text.en: If he cut off, and shut up, or gather together, then who can hinder him?

text.am: ምናምንቴዎችን ሰዎች ያውቃልና፥
text.en: For he knoweth vain men: he seeth wickedness also; will he not then consider it?

text.am: የሜዳ አህያ ግልገል ሰው ሆኖ ቢወለድ፥
text.en: For vain man would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass's colt.

text.am: በእጅህ በደል ቢኖር አርቀው፤
text.en: If thou prepare thine heart, and stretch out thine hands toward him;

text.am: በእጅህ በደል ቢኖር አርቀው፤
text.en: If iniquity be in thine hand, put it far away, and let not wickedness dwell in thy tabernacles.

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ በእውነት ፊትህን ያለ ነውር ታነሣለህ፤
text.en: For then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear:

text.am: መከራህንም ትረሳለህ፤
text.en: Because thou shalt forget thy misery, and remember it as waters that pass away:

text.am: ከቅትር ይልቅ ሕይወትህ ይበራል፤
text.en: And thine age shall be clearer than the noonday; thou shalt shine forth, thou shalt be as the morning.

text.am: ተስፋም ስላለህ ተዘልለህ ትቀመጣለህ፤
text.en: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; yea, thou shalt dig about thee, and thou shalt take thy rest in safety.

text.am: ትተኛለህ፥ የሚያስፈራህም የለም፤
text.en: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; yea, many shall make suit unto thee.

text.am: የክፉዎች ዓይን ግን ትጨልማለች፤
text.en: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, and they shall not escape, and their hope shall be as the giving up of the ghost.

text.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: And Job answered and said,

text.am: በእርግጥ እናንተ ዓይነተኞች ሰዎች ናቸሁ፤
text.en: No doubt but ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you.

text.am: ነገር ግን እኔ ደግሞ እንደ እናንተ ማስተዋል አለኝ፤
text.en: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you: yea, who knoweth not such things as these?

text.am: እግዚአብሔርን የጠራሁ እርሱም የመለሰልኝ እኔ
text.en: I am as one mocked of his neighbour, who calleth upon God, and he answereth him: the just upright man is laughed to scorn.

text.am: ተዘልሎ በሚቀመጥ ሰው አሳብ መከራ ይናቃል፤
text.en: He that is ready to slip with his feet is as a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.

text.am: የቀማኞች ድንኳን በደኅንነት ይኖራል፥
text.en: The tabernacles of robbers prosper, and they that provoke God are secure; into whose hand God bringeth abundantly.

text.am: አሁን ግን እንስሶችን ጠይቅ፥ ያስተምሩህማል፤
text.en: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowls of the air, and they shall tell thee:

text.am: ወይም ለምድር ተናገር፥ እርስዋም ታስተምርሃለች፤
text.en: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee: and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.

text.am: የእግዚአብሔር እጅ ይህን እንዳደረገ
text.en: Who knoweth not in all these that the hand of the LORD hath wrought this?

text.am: የሕያዋን ሁሉ ነፍስ
text.en: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind.

text.am: ምላስ መብልን እንደሚቀምስ፥
text.en: Doth not the ear try words? and the mouth taste his meat?

text.am: በሽምግልና ጊዜ ጥበብ፥
text.en: With the ancient is wisdom; and in length of days understanding.

text.am: በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ጥበብና ኃይል አለ፤
text.en: With him is wisdom and strength, he hath counsel and understanding.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ይፈርሳል፥ የፈረሰውም ተመልሶ አይሠራም፤
text.en: Behold, he breaketh down, and it cannot be built again: he shutteth up a man, and there can be no opening.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ውኆቹን ይከለክላል፥ እነርሱም ይደርቃሉ፤
text.en: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up: also he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.

text.am: ኃይልና ጥበብ በእርሱ ዘንድ ናቸው፤
text.en: With him is strength and wisdom: the deceived and the deceiver are his.

text.am: መካሮችንም እንደ ዘረፋ ይወስዳቸዋል፥
text.en: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and maketh the judges fools.

text.am: የነገሥታትንም እስራት ይፈታል፥
text.en: He looseth the bond of kings, and girdeth their loins with a girdle.

text.am: ካህናትን እንደ ዘረፋ ይወስዳቸዋል፥
text.en: He leadeth princes away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty.

text.am: ከታመኑ ሰዎችም ቋንቋን ያርቃል፥
text.en: He removeth away the speech of the trusty, and taketh away the understanding of the aged.

text.am: በአለቆች ላይ ንቀትን ያፈስሳል፥
text.en: He poureth contempt upon princes, and weakeneth the strength of the mighty.

text.am: ጥልቅ ነገር ከጨለማ ይገልጣል፥
text.en: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out to light the shadow of death.

text.am: አሕዛብን ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋል፥ እነርሱንም ያጠፋል፤
text.en: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them: he enlargeth the nations, and straiteneth them again.

text.am: ከምድር አሕዛብ አለቆች ዘንድ ማስተዋልን ይወስዳል፥
text.en: He taketh away the heart of the chief of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

text.am: ብርሃንም ሳይኖር በጨለማ ይርመሰመሳሉ፤
text.en: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunken man.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ይህን ሁሉ ዓይኔ አየች፤
text.en: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood it.

text.am: እናንተ የምታውቁትን እኔ ደግሞ አውቃለሁ፤
text.en: What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.

text.am: ነገር ግን ሁሉን ለሚችል አምላክ መናገር እፈልጋለሁ፥
text.en: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.

text.am: እናንተ ግን በሐሰት ለባጮች ናችሁ፤
text.en: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.

text.am: ምነው ዝም ብላችሁ ብትኖሩ!
text.en: O that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.

text.am: አሁንም ክርክሬን ስሙ፥
text.en: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.

text.am: በውኑ ስለ እግዚአብሔር ሐሰትን ትናገራላችሁን?
text.en: Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?

text.am: ለፊቱስ ታደላላችሁን?
text.en: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?

text.am: ቢመረምራችሁስ መልካም ይሆንልችኋልን?
text.en: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?

text.am: በስውር ለሰው ፊት ብታደሉ
text.en: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.

text.am: ክብሩስ አያስፈራችሁምን?
text.en: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?

text.am: ምስሌዎቻችሁ የአመድ ምሳሌዎች ናቸው፤
text.en: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.

text.am: ዝም በሉ፥ እናገርም ዘንድ ተዉኝ፤
text.en: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.

text.am: ሥጋዬን በጥርሴ እይዛለሁ፥
text.en: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?

text.am: እነሆ፥ ቢገድለኝ ስንኳ እርሱን በትዕግሥት እጠባበቃለሁ፤
text.en: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.

text.am: ዝንጉ ሰው በፊቱ አይገባምና
text.en: He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.

text.am: ነገሬን ተግታችሁ ስሙ፥
text.en: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ሙግቴን አዘጋጅቻለሁ።
text.en: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.

text.am: ከእኔስ ጋር የሚፋረድ ማን ነው?
text.en: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.

text.am: ነገር ግን ሁለት ነገር አታድርግብኝ፤
text.en: Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.

text.am: እጅህን ከእኔ አርቅ፤
text.en: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.

text.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ጥራኝ፥ እኔም እመልስልሃለሁ።
text.en: Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.

text.am: ያለብኝስ በደልና ኃጢአት ምን ያህል ነው?
text.en: How many are mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.

text.am: ፊትህን ከእኔ የሰወርህ፥
text.en: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?

text.am: የረገፈውን ቅጠል ታስጨንቃለህን?
text.en: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?

text.am: የመረረ ነገር ጽፈህብኛልና፤
text.en: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.

text.am: እግሬንም በእግር ግንድ አግብተሃል፥
text.en: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.

text.am: እኔ እንደሚጠፋ በስባሳ ነገር፥
text.en: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.

text.am: ከሴት የተወለደ ሰው
text.en: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.

text.am: እንደ አበባ ይወጣል፥ ይረግፋልም፤
text.en: He cometh forth like a flower, and is cut down: he fleeth also as a shadow, and continueth not.

text.am: እንደዚህስ ባለ ሰው ላይ ዓይኖችህን ትከፍታለህን?
text.en: And dost thou open thine eyes upon such an one, and bringest me into judgment with thee?

text.am: ከርኩስ ነገር ንጹሕን ሊያወጣ ማን ይችላል?
text.en: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? not one.

text.am: የሰው ዕድሜ የተወሰነ ነው፥
text.en: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months are with thee, thou hast appointed his bounds that he cannot pass;

text.am: እንደ ምንደኛ ዕድሜው እስኪፈጸም ድረስ
text.en: Turn from him, that he may rest, till he shall accomplish, as an hireling, his day.

text.am: ዛፍ ቢቈረጥ ደግሞ ያቈጠቍጥ ዘንድ፥
text.en: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.

text.am: ሥሩም በምድር ውስጥ ቢያረጅ፥
text.en: Though the root thereof wax old in the earth, and the stock thereof die in the ground;

text.am: ከውኃ ሽታ የተነሣ ያቈጠቍጣል፤
text.en: Yet through the scent of water it will bud, and bring forth boughs like a plant.

text.am: ሰው ግን ይሞትና ይጋደማል፤
text.en: But man dieth, and wasteth away: yea, man giveth up the ghost, and where is he?

text.am: ውኃ ከባሕር ውስጥ ያልቃል፤
text.en: As the waters fail from the sea, and the flood decayeth and drieth up:

text.am: ሰውም ተኝቶ አይነሣም፤
text.en: So man lieth down, and riseth not: till the heavens be no more, they shall not awake, nor be raised out of their sleep.

text.am: በሲኦል ውስጥ ምነው በሰወርኸኝ ኖሮ!
text.en: O that thou wouldest hide me in the grave, that thou wouldest keep me secret, until thy wrath be past, that thou wouldest appoint me a set time, and remember me!

text.am: በውኑ ሰው ከሞተ ተመልሶ ሕያው ይሆናልን?
text.en: If a man die, shall he live again? all the days of my appointed time will I wait, till my change come.

text.am: በጠራኸኝና በመለስሁልህ ነበር፤
text.en: Thou shalt call, and I will answer thee: thou wilt have a desire to the work of thine hands.

text.am: አሁን ግን እርምጃዬን ቈጥረኸዋል፤
text.en: For now thou numberest my steps: dost thou not watch over my sin?

text.am: መተላልፌ በከረጢት ውስጥ ታትሞአል፥
text.en: My transgression is sealed up in a bag, and thou sewest up mine iniquity.

text.am: ተራራ ሲወድቅ ይጠፋል፥
text.en: And surely the mountain falling cometh to nought, and the rock is removed out of his place.

text.am: ውኆች ድንጋዮቹን ይፍቃሉ፤
text.en: The waters wear the stones: thou washest away the things which grow out of the dust of the earth; and thou destroyest the hope of man.

text.am: ለዘላለም ታሸንፈዋለህ፥ እርሱም ያልፋል፤
text.en: Thou prevailest for ever against him, and he passeth: thou changest his countenance, and sendest him away.

text.am: ልጆቹ ቢከብሩ አያውቅም፤
text.en: His sons come to honour, and he knoweth it not; and they are brought low, but he perceiveth it not of them.

text.am: ነገር ግን የገዛ ሥጋው ሕመም ብቻ ይሰማዋል፥
text.en: But his flesh upon him shall have pain, and his soul within him shall mourn.

text.am: ቴማናዊውም ኤልፋዝ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: Then answered Eliphaz the Temanite, and said,

text.am: በውኑ ጠቢብ ሰው እንደ ንፋስ በሆነ እውቀት ይመልሳልን?
text.en: Should a wise man utter vain knowledge, and fill his belly with the east wind?

text.am: ከማይረባ ነገር፥
text.en: Should he reason with unprofitable talk? or with speeches wherewith he can do no good?

text.am: አንተም እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ታፈርሳለህ፤
text.en: Yea, thou castest off fear, and restrainest prayer before God.

text.am: በደልህ አፍህን ያስተምረዋል፥
text.en: For thy mouth uttereth thine iniquity, and thou choosest the tongue of the crafty.

text.am: የሚፈርድብህ አፍህ ነው እንጂ እኔ አይደለሁም።
text.en: Thine own mouth condemneth thee, and not I: yea, thine own lips testify against thee.

text.am: በውኑ መጀመሪያ የተወለድህ ሰው አንተ ነህን?
text.en: Art thou the first man that was born? or wast thou made before the hills?

text.am: የእግዚአብሔርንስ ምሥጢር ሰምተሃልን?
text.en: Hast thou heard the secret of God? and dost thou restrain wisdom to thyself?

text.am: እኛ የማናውቀውን አንተ የምታወቀው ምንድር ነው?
text.en: What knowest thou, that we know not? what understandest thou, which is not in us?

text.am: በዕድሜ ከአባትህ የሚበልጡ
text.en: With us are both the grayheaded and very aged men, much elder than thy father.

text.am: በውኑ የእግዚአብሔር ማጽናናት፥
text.en: Are the consolations of God small with thee? is there any secret thing with thee?

text.am: ልብህስ ለምን ይወስድሃል?
text.en: Why doth thine heart carry thee away? and what do thy eyes wink at,

text.am: በእግዚአብሔር ላይ መንፈስህን እስከ ማንሣት ደርሰህ፤
text.en: That thou turnest thy spirit against God, and lettest such words go out of thy mouth?

text.am: ንጹሕ ይሆን ዘንድ ሰው ምንድር ነው?
text.en: What is man, that he should be clean? and he which is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

text.am: እነሆ፥ በቅዱሳኑ ስንኳ አይታመንም፤
text.en: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.

text.am: ይልቁንስ አስጸያፊና የረከሰ፥
text.en: How much more abominable and filthy is man, which drinketh iniquity like water?

text.am: ምድሪቱ ለብቻቸው ተሰጥታ የነበረች፥
text.en: I will shew thee, hear me; and that which I have seen I will declare;

text.am: ምድሪቱ ለብቻቸው ተሰጥታ የነበረች፥
text.en: Which wise men have told from their fathers, and have not hid it:

text.am: በመካከላቸውም እንግዳ ያልገባባቸው ጠቢባን።
text.en: Unto whom alone the earth was given, and no stranger passed among them.

text.am: ክፉ ሰው ዕድሜውን ሙሉ፥
text.en: The wicked man travaileth with pain all his days, and the number of years is hidden to the oppressor.

text.am: የሚያስደነግጥ ድምፅ በጆሮው ነው፤
text.en: A dreadful sound is in his ears: in prosperity the destroyer shall come upon him.

text.am: ከጨለማ ተመልሶ እንዲወጣ አያምንም፥
text.en: He believeth not that he shall return out of darkness, and he is waited for of the sword.

text.am: ተቅበዝብዞም። ወዴት አለ? እያለ እንጀራ ይለምናል፤
text.en: He wandereth abroad for bread, saying, Where is it? he knoweth that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

text.am: መከራና ጭንቀት ያስፈራሩታል፤
text.en: Trouble and anguish shall make him afraid; they shall prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.
