text.am: እጁን በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ዘርግቶአልና፥
text.en: For he stretcheth out his hand against God, and strengtheneth himself against the Almighty.

text.am: በደንዳና አንገቱና በወፍራሙ በጋሻው
text.en: He runneth upon him, even on his neck, upon the thick bosses of his bucklers:

text.am: በስብም ፊቱን ከድኖአልና፥
text.en: Because he covereth his face with his fatness, and maketh collops of fat on his flanks.

text.am: በተፈቱም ከተሞች ውስጥ፥
text.en: And he dwelleth in desolate cities, and in houses which no man inhabiteth, which are ready to become heaps.

text.am: ባለጠጋ አይሆንም፥ ሀብቱም አይጸናም፤
text.en: He shall not be rich, neither shall his substance continue, neither shall he prolong the perfection thereof upon the earth.

text.am: ከጨለማ አይወጣም፤
text.en: He shall not depart out of darkness; the flame shall dry up his branches, and by the breath of his mouth shall he go away.

text.am: ዋጋው ከንቱ ነገር ይሆናልና
text.en: Let not him that is deceived trust in vanity: for vanity shall be his recompence.

text.am: ቀኑ ሳይደርስ ጊዜው ይፈጸማል፥
text.en: It shall be accomplished before his time, and his branch shall not be green.

text.am: እንደ ወይን ያልበሰለውን ዘለላ ያረግፋል፤
text.en: He shall shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and shall cast off his flower as the olive.

text.am: የዝንጉዎች ጉባኤ ሁሉ ለጥፋት ይሆናል፥
text.en: For the congregation of hypocrites shall be desolate, and fire shall consume the tabernacles of bribery.

text.am: ጉዳትን ይፀንሳሉ፥ በደልንም ይወልዳሉ፥
text.en: They conceive mischief, and bring forth vanity, and their belly prepareth deceit.

text.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: Then Job answered and said,

text.am: እንደዚህ ያለ ዓይነት ነገር እጅግ ሰማሁ፤
text.en: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all.

text.am: በውኑ ከንቱ ቃል ይፈጸማልን?
text.en: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?

text.am: እኔ ደግሞ እንደ እናንተ እናገር ዘንድ ይቻለኝ ነበር፤
text.en: I also could speak as ye do: if your soul were in my soul's stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.

text.am: በአፌም ነገር ባበረታኋችሁ ነበር፤
text.en: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.

text.am: እኔ ብናገር ሕማሜ አይቀነስም፤
text.en: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?

text.am: አሁን ግን አድክሞኛል፤
text.en: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.

text.am: መጨማተሬ ይመሰክርብኛል፤
text.en: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.

text.am: በቍጣው ቀደደኝ፥ እርሱም ጠላኝ፤
text.en: He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.

text.am: እነርሱም አፋቸውን ከፈቱብኝ፤
text.en: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.

text.am: እግዚአብሔር ለጠማማ ሰው አሳልፎ ሰጠኝ፥
text.en: God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.

text.am: ተዘልዬ ተቀምጬ ነበር፥ እርሱም ሰበረኝ፤
text.en: I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.

text.am: ቀስተኞቹ ከበቡኝ፤
text.en: His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.

text.am: በቍስል ላይ ቍስል ጨመረብኝ፤
text.en: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.

text.am: በቁርበቴ ላይ ማቅ ሰፋሁ፥
text.en: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.

text.am: ፊቴ ከልቅሶ የተነሣ ቀላ፤
text.en: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;

text.am: ነገር ግን በእጄ ዓመፅ የለም፤
text.en: Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.

text.am: ምድር ሆይ፥ ደሜን አትክደኚ፥
text.en: O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.

text.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ ምስክሬ በሰማይ አለ፥
text.en: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.

text.am: ጸሎቴ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይድረስ፥
text.en: My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.

text.am: የሰው ልጅ ከባልንጀራው ጋር እንደሚምዋገት፥
text.en: O that one might plead for a man with God, as a man pleadeth for his neighbour!

text.am: ጥቂቶች ዓመታት ካለፉ በኋላ
text.en: When a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.

text.am: መንፈሴ ደከመ፥ ዘመኔ አለቀ፥
text.en: My breath is corrupt, my days are extinct, the graves are ready for me.

text.am: አላጋጮች በእኔ ዘንድ አሉ፥
text.en: Are there not mockers with me? and doth not mine eye continue in their provocation?

text.am: አሁንም አንተ መያዣ ሆነህ ተዋሰኝ፤
text.en: Lay down now, put me in a surety with thee; who is he that will strike hands with me?

text.am: ልባቸውም እንዳያስተውል ከልክለኸዋል፤
text.en: For thou hast hid their heart from understanding: therefore shalt thou not exalt them.

text.am: ለብዝበዛ ባልንጀሮቹን አሳልፎ የሚሰጥ ሰው፥
text.en: He that speaketh flattery to his friends, even the eyes of his children shall fail.

text.am: ለሕዝብም ምሳሌ አደረገኝ፤
text.en: He hath made me also a byword of the people; and aforetime I was as a tabret.

text.am: ዓይኔም ከኀዘን የተነሣ ፈዘዘች፥
text.en: Mine eye also is dim by reason of sorrow, and all my members are as a shadow.

text.am: ቅኖች ሰዎች በዚህ ነገር ይደነቃሉ፥
text.en: Upright men shall be astonied at this, and the innocent shall stir up himself against the hypocrite.

text.am: ጻድቅ ግን መንገዱን ያጠነክራል፥
text.en: The righteous also shall hold on his way, and he that hath clean hands shall be stronger and stronger.

text.am: ነገር ግን እናንተ ሁሉ ተመልሳችሁ ወደ እኔ ኑ፤
text.en: But as for you all, do ye return, and come now: for I cannot find one wise man among you.

text.am: ዕድሜዬ አለፈች፤
text.en: My days are past, my purposes are broken off, even the thoughts of my heart.

text.am: ሌሊቱን ወደ ቀን ይለውጣሉ፤
text.en: They change the night into day: the light is short because of darkness.

text.am: ተስፋ ባደርግ ሲኦል ቤቴ ናት፤
text.en: If I wait, the grave is mine house: I have made my bed in the darkness.

text.am: መበስበስን። አንተ አባቴ ነህ፤
text.en: I have said to corruption, Thou art my father: to the worm, Thou art my mother, and my sister.

text.am: እንግዲህ ተስፋዬ ወዴት ነው?
text.en: And where is now my hope? as for my hope, who shall see it?

text.am: አብረን በመሬት ውስጥ ስናርፍ፥
text.en: They shall go down to the bars of the pit, when our rest together is in the dust.

text.am: ሹሐዊውም በልዳዶስ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

text.am: እስከ መቼ ቃልን ታጠምዳለህ?
text.en: How long will it be ere ye make an end of words? mark, and afterwards we will speak.

text.am: ስለ ምንስ እንደ እንስሶች ተቈጠርን?
text.en: Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?

text.am: ቍጣ ወርሶሃል፤ አንተስ የሞትህ እንደ ሆነ፥
text.en: He teareth himself in his anger: shall the earth be forsaken for thee? and shall the rock be removed out of his place?

text.am: የኃጢአተኛ መብራት ይጠፋል፥
text.en: Yea, the light of the wicked shall be put out, and the spark of his fire shall not shine.

text.am: ብርሃን በድንኳኑ ውስጥ ይጨልማል፥
text.en: The light shall be dark in his tabernacle, and his candle shall be put out with him.

text.am: የኃይሉም እርምጃ ትጠብባለች፥
text.en: The steps of his strength shall be straitened, and his own counsel shall cast him down.

text.am: እግሩ በወጥመድ ትያዛለች፥
text.en: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he walketh upon a snare.

text.am: አሽክላ ሰኰናውን ይይዛል፥
text.en: The gin shall take him by the heel, and the robber shall prevail against him.

text.am: በምድር ላይ የሸምቀቆ ገመድ፥
text.en: The snare is laid for him in the ground, and a trap for him in the way.

text.am: ድንጋጤ በዙሪያው ታስፈራዋለች፥
text.en: Terrors shall make him afraid on every side, and shall drive him to his feet.

text.am: ኃይሉ በራብ ትደክማለች፥
text.en: His strength shall be hungerbitten, and destruction shall be ready at his side.

text.am: የሰውነቱ ብልቶች ይጠፋሉ፤
text.en: It shall devour the strength of his skin: even the firstborn of death shall devour his strength.

text.am: ከሚታመንበት ድንኳን ይነቀላል፤
text.en: His confidence shall be rooted out of his tabernacle, and it shall bring him to the king of terrors.

text.am: በድንኳኑ ውስጥ ለእርሱ የማይሆነው ይኖራል፤
text.en: It shall dwell in his tabernacle, because it is none of his: brimstone shall be scattered upon his habitation.

text.am: ሥሩ ከበታቹ ይደርቃል፥
text.en: His roots shall be dried up beneath, and above shall his branch be cut off.

text.am: መታሰቢያው ከምድር ላይ ይጠፋል፥
text.en: His remembrance shall perish from the earth, and he shall have no name in the street.

text.am: ከብርሃን ወደ ጨለማ ያፈልሱታል፥
text.en: He shall be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

text.am: ዘርም ትውልድም በሕዝቡ መካከል አይሆንለትም፤
text.en: He shall neither have son nor nephew among his people, nor any remaining in his dwellings.

text.am: የፊተኞች ሰዎች እንደ ደነገጡ፥
text.en: They that come after him shall be astonied at his day, as they that went before were affrighted.

text.am: በእውነት የኃጢአተኞች ቤት እንዲሁ ናት፥
text.en: Surely such are the dwellings of the wicked, and this is the place of him that knoweth not God.

text.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: Then Job answered and said,

text.am: ነፍሴን የምትነዘንዙ፥
text.en: How long will ye vex my soul, and break me in pieces with words?

text.am: ይኸው ስትሰድቡኝ አሥር ጊዜ ነው፤
text.en: These ten times have ye reproached me: ye are not ashamed that ye make yourselves strange to me.

text.am: በእውነትም የሳትሁ እንደ ሆነ፥
text.en: And be it indeed that I have erred, mine error remaineth with myself.

text.am: በእውነትም ብትጓደዱብኝ፥
text.en: If indeed ye will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach:

text.am: እንግዲህ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ገለበጠኝ፥
text.en: Know now that God hath overthrown me, and hath compassed me with his net.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ስለ ተደረገብኝ ግፍ ብጮኽ ማንም አይመልስልኝም፤
text.en: Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard: I cry aloud, but there is no judgment.

text.am: እንዳላልፍ መንገዴን ዘግቶታል፥
text.en: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.

text.am: ክብሬን ገፈፈኝ፥
text.en: He hath stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

text.am: በዚህና በዚያም አፈረሰኝ፥ እኔም ሄድሁ፤
text.en: He hath destroyed me on every side, and I am gone: and mine hope hath he removed like a tree.

text.am: ቍጣውንም አነደደብኝ፥
text.en: He hath also kindled his wrath against me, and he counteth me unto him as one of his enemies.

text.am: ሠራዊቱ አብረው መጡ፥
text.en: His troops come together, and raise up their way against me, and encamp round about my tabernacle.

text.am: ወንድሞቼን ከእኔ ዘንድ አራቀ፥
text.en: He hath put my brethren far from me, and mine acquaintance are verily estranged from me.

text.am: ዘመዶቼ ተቋረጡ፥
text.en: My kinsfolk have failed, and my familiar friends have forgotten me.

text.am: ቤተ ሰቦቼና ሴቶች ባሪያዎቼ እንደ መጻተኛ ቈጠሩኝ፤
text.en: They that dwell in mine house, and my maids, count me for a stranger: I am an alien in their sight.

text.am: ባሪያዬን ብጠራ፥ በአፌም ባቈላምጥ አይመልስልኝም።
text.en: I called my servant, and he gave me no answer; I intreated him with my mouth.

text.am: ሚስቴ እስትንፋሴን ጠላች፥
text.en: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children's sake of mine own body.

text.am: ሕፃናቶች እንኳ አጠቁኝ፤
text.en: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake against me.

text.am: አማካሪዎቼ ሁሉ ተጸየፉኝ፤
text.en: All my inward friends abhorred me: and they whom I loved are turned against me.

text.am: አጥንቴ ከቁርበቴና ከሥጋዬ ጋር ተጣበቀ፤
text.en: My bone cleaveth to my skin and to my flesh, and I am escaped with the skin of my teeth.

text.am: እናንተ ወዳጆቼ ሆይ፥ ማሩኝ፤
text.en: Have pity upon me, have pity upon me, O ye my friends; for the hand of God hath touched me.

text.am: ስለ ምን እናንተ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ታሳድዱኛላችሁ?
text.en: Why do ye persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

text.am: ምነው አሁን ቃሌ ቢጻፍ!
text.en: Oh that my words were now written! oh that they were printed in a book!

text.am: ምነው በብረት ብርና በእርሳስ
text.en: That they were graven with an iron pen and lead in the rock for ever!

text.am: እኔን ግን የሚቤዠኝ ሕያው እንደ ሆነ፥
text.en: For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

text.am: ይህ ቁርበቴም ከጠፋ በኋላ፥
text.en: And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet in my flesh shall I see God:

text.am: እኔ ራሴ አየዋለሁ፥
text.en: Whom I shall see for myself, and mine eyes shall behold, and not another; though my reins be consumed within me.

text.am: በእውነት። እንዴት እናሳድደዋለን?
text.en: But ye should say, Why persecute we him, seeing the root of the matter is found in me?

text.am: ፍርድ እንዳለ ታውቁ ዘንድ
text.en: Be ye afraid of the sword: for wrath bringeth the punishments of the sword, that ye may know there is a judgment.

text.am: ናዕማታዊውም ሶፋር መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,

text.am: ስለዚህ በውስጤ ስላለው ችኰላ አሳቤ ትመልስልኛለች።
text.en: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for this I make haste.

text.am: የሚያሳፍረኝንም ተግሣጽ ሰምቻለሁ፥
text.en: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.

text.am: ሰው በምድር ላይ ከተቀመጠ፥ ከዱሮ ዘመን ጀምሮ፥
text.en: Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,

text.am: የኃጢአተኛ ፉከራ አጭር መሆኑን
text.en: That the triumphing of the wicked is short, and the joy of the hypocrite but for a moment?

text.am: ከፍታው ወደ ሰማይ ቢወጣ፥
text.en: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;

text.am: እንደ ፋንድያ ለዘላለም ይጠፋል፤
text.en: Yet he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where is he?

text.am: እንደ ሕልም ይበርራል፥ እርሱም አይገኝም፤
text.en: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.

text.am: ያየችውም ዓይን ዳግመኛ አታየውም፤
text.en: The eye also which saw him shall see him no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.

text.am: ልጆቹ ድሆቹን ያቈላምጣሉ፤
text.en: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.

text.am: አጥንቶቹ ብላቴንነቱን ሞልተዋል፤
text.en: His bones are full of the sin of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.

text.am: ክፋት በአፉ ውስጥ ቢጣፍጥ፥
text.en: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue;

text.am: ቢጠብቀውም ባይተወውም፥
text.en: Though he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:

text.am: መብሉ በአንጀቱ ውስጥ ይገላበጣል፤
text.en: Yet his meat in his bowels is turned, it is the gall of asps within him.

text.am: የዋጠውን ሀብት ይተፋዋል፤
text.en: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.

text.am: የእፉኝትን መርዝ ይጠባል፤
text.en: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper's tongue shall slay him.

text.am: የማሩንና የቅቤውን ፈሳሽ
text.en: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.

text.am: የድካሙን ፍሬ ሳይውጠው ይመልሰዋል፤
text.en: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow it down: according to his substance shall the restitution be, and he shall not rejoice therein.

text.am: ድሀውን አስጨንቆአል፥ ትቶታልም፤
text.en: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;

text.am: ሆዱ ዕረፍትን አላወቀምና
text.en: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.

text.am: እርሱ ከበላ በኋላ ምንም አልተረፈም፤
text.en: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.

text.am: በጠገበ ጊዜ ይጨነቃል፤
text.en: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.

text.am: ሆዱን ሳያጠግብ
text.en: When he is about to fill his belly, God shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain it upon him while he is eating.

text.am: ከብረት መሣርያም ይሸሻል፥
text.en: He shall flee from the iron weapon, and the bow of steel shall strike him through.

text.am: እርሱም ይመዝዘዋል፥ ከሥጋውም ይወጣል፤
text.en: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors are upon him.

text.am: ጨለማ ሁሉ ስለ ከበረው ዕቃ ተዘጋጅቶአል፤
text.en: All darkness shall be hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.

text.am: ሰማይ ኃጢአቱን ይገልጥበታል፥
text.en: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.

text.am: የቤቱም ባለጠግነት ይሄዳል፤
text.en: The increase of his house shall depart, and his goods shall flow away in the day of his wrath.

text.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የበደለኛ ሰው እድል ፈንታ፥
text.en: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.

text.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: But Job answered and said,

text.am: ስሙ፥ ቃሌን ስሙ፤
text.en: Hear diligently my speech, and let this be your consolations.

text.am: እናገር ዘንድ ተዉኝ፤
text.en: Suffer me that I may speak; and after that I have spoken, mock on.

text.am: በውኑ የኀዘን እንጉርጕሮዬ ለሰው እናገራለሁን?
text.en: As for me, is my complaint to man? and if it were so, why should not my spirit be troubled?

text.am: ወደ እኔ ተመልከቱ፥ ተደነቁም፤
text.en: Mark me, and be astonished, and lay your hand upon your mouth.

text.am: እኔ ባሰብሁ ቍጥር እጨነቃለሁ፥
text.en: Even when I remember I am afraid, and trembling taketh hold on my flesh.

text.am: ስለ ምን ኃጢአተኞች በሕይወት ይኖራሉ?
text.en: Wherefore do the wicked live, become old, yea, are mighty in power?

text.am: ዘራቸው ከእነርሱ ጋር ጸንቶ ይኖራል፥
text.en: Their seed is established in their sight with them, and their offspring before their eyes.

text.am: ቤታቸው ከፍርሃት ወጥቶ የታመነ ነው፥
text.en: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

text.am: ኮርማቸው ይወልዳል፥ ዘሩንም አይጥለውም፤
text.en: Their bull gendereth, and faileth not; their cow calveth, and casteth not her calf.

text.am: ሕፃናቶቻቸውን እንደ መንጋ ያወጣሉ፥
text.en: They send forth their little ones like a flock, and their children dance.

text.am: ከበሮና መሰንቆ ወስደው ይዘምራሉ፥
text.en: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.

text.am: ዕድሜያቸውንም በተድላ ይፈጽማሉ፤
text.en: They spend their days in wealth, and in a moment go down to the grave.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርንም። ከእኛ ዘንድ ራቅ፤
text.en: Therefore they say unto God, Depart from us; for we desire not the knowledge of thy ways.

text.am: እናመልከውስ ዘንድ ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክ ማን ነው?
text.en: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? and what profit should we have, if we pray unto him?

text.am: እነሆ፥ ሀብታቸው በእጃቸው ውስጥ አይደለምን?
text.en: Lo, their good is not in their hand: the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

text.am: የኃጥአን መብራት የጠፋው፥
text.en: How oft is the candle of the wicked put out! and how oft cometh their destruction upon them! God distributeth sorrows in his anger.

text.am: በነፋስ ፊት እንደ ገለባ፥
text.en: They are as stubble before the wind, and as chaff that the storm carrieth away.

text.am: እናንተ። እግዚአብሔር በደላቸውን ለልጆቻቸው ይጠብቃል ብላችኋል።
text.en: God layeth up his iniquity for his children: he rewardeth him, and he shall know it.

text.am: ዓይኖቻቸው ጥፋታቸውን ይዩ፥
text.en: His eyes shall see his destruction, and he shall drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

text.am: የወራታቸውስ ቍጥር ቢቈረጥ፥
text.en: For what pleasure hath he in his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off in the midst?

text.am: ከፍ ከፍ ባሉትስ ላይ ለሚፈርድ ለእግዚአብሔር
text.en: Shall any teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.

text.am: አንድ ሰው በሰላም ተዘልሎ ሲቀመጥ
text.en: One dieth in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

text.am: በአንጀቱ ውስጥ ስብ ሞልቶአል፥
text.en: His breasts are full of milk, and his bones are moistened with marrow.

text.am: ሌላውም ሰው መልካምን ነገር ከቶ ሳይቀምስ
text.en: And another dieth in the bitterness of his soul, and never eateth with pleasure.

text.am: በአፈር ውስጥ በአንድ ላይ ይተኛሉ፥
text.en: They shall lie down alike in the dust, and the worms shall cover them.

text.am: እነሆ፥ አሳባችሁን፥
text.en: Behold, I know your thoughts, and the devices which ye wrongfully imagine against me.

text.am: እናንተ። የከበርቴው ቤት የት ነው?
text.en: For ye say, Where is the house of the prince? and where are the dwelling places of the wicked?

text.am: መንገድ አላፊዎችን አልጠየቃችሁምን?
text.en: Have ye not asked them that go by the way? and do ye not know their tokens,

text.am: ኃጢአተኛው በመቅሠፍት ቀን እንደ ተጠበቀ፥
text.en: That the wicked is reserved to the day of destruction? they shall be brought forth to the day of wrath.

text.am: መንገዱን በፊቱ የሚናገር ማን ነው?
text.en: Who shall declare his way to his face? and who shall repay him what he hath done?

text.am: እርሱን ግን ወደ መቃብር ይሸከሙታል፥
text.en: Yet shall he be brought to the grave, and shall remain in the tomb.

text.am: የሸለቆው ጓል ይጣፍጥለታል፤
text.en: The clods of the valley shall be sweet unto him, and every man shall draw after him, as there are innumerable before him.

text.am: የምትመልሱልኝ ውስልትና ነውና
text.en: How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?

text.am: ቴማናዊውም ኤልፋዝ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,

text.am: በውኑ ሰው እግዚአብሔርን ይጠቅመዋልን?
text.en: Can a man be profitable unto God, as he that is wise may be profitable unto himself?

text.am: ጻድቅ መሆንህስ ሁሉን የሚችለውን አምላክ ደስ ያሰኘዋልን?
text.en: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty, that thou art righteous? or is it gain to him, that thou makest thy ways perfect?

text.am: እርሱንስ ስለ ፈራህ ይዘልፍሃልን?
text.en: Will he reprove thee for fear of thee? will he enter with thee into judgment?

text.am: ክፋትህስ የበዛ አይደለምን?
text.en: Is not thy wickedness great? and thine iniquities infinite?

text.am: የወንድሞችህን መያዣ በከንቱ ወስደሃል፥
text.en: For thou hast taken a pledge from thy brother for nought, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

text.am: ለደካማ ውኃ አላጠጣህም፥
text.en: Thou hast not given water to the weary to drink, and thou hast withholden bread from the hungry.

text.am: በክንድ የበረታ ምድርን ገዛ፤
text.en: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth; and the honourable man dwelt in it.

text.am: መበለቲቱን አንዳች አልባ ሰድደሃታል፤
text.en: Thou hast sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

text.am: ስለዚህ አሽክላ ከብቦሃል፥
text.en: Therefore snares are round about thee, and sudden fear troubleth thee;

text.am: እንዳታይ ብርሃን ጨለማ ሆነችብህ፥
text.en: Or darkness, that thou canst not see; and abundance of waters cover thee.

text.am: እግዚአብሔር በሰማያት ከፍ ከፍ አይልምን?
text.en: Is not God in the height of heaven? and behold the height of the stars, how high they are!

text.am: አንተም። እግዚአብሔር ምን ያውቃል?
text.en: And thou sayest, How doth God know? can he judge through the dark cloud?

text.am: እንዳያይ የጠቈረ ደመና ጋርዶታል፤
text.en: Thick clouds are a covering to him, that he seeth not; and he walketh in the circuit of heaven.

text.am: በውኑ ኃጢአተኞች ሰዎች የረገጡአትን
text.en: Hast thou marked the old way which wicked men have trodden?

text.am: ጊዜያቸው ሳይደርስ ተነጠቁ፤
text.en: Which were cut down out of time, whose foundation was overflown with a flood:

text.am: እግዚአብሔርንም። ከእኛ ዘንድ ራቅ፤
text.en: Which said unto God, Depart from us: and what can the Almighty do for them?

text.am: ነገር ግን ቤታቸውን በመልካም ነገር ሞላ፤
text.en: Yet he filled their houses with good things: but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

text.am: ጻድቃን ያዩታል፥ ደስም ይላቸዋል፤
text.en: The righteous see it, and are glad: and the innocent laugh them to scorn.

text.am: በእውነት ሀብታቸው ጠፋ፥
text.en: Whereas our substance is not cut down, but the remnant of them the fire consumeth.

text.am: አሁንም ከእርሱ ጋር ተስማማ፥ ሰላምም ይኑርህ፤
text.en: Acquaint now thyself with him, and be at peace: thereby good shall come unto thee.

text.am: ከአፉም ሕጉን ተቀበል፥
text.en: Receive, I pray thee, the law from his mouth, and lay up his words in thine heart.

text.am: ሁሉን ወደሚችል አምላክ ብትመለስ፥ ብትዋረድም፥
text.en: If thou return to the Almighty, thou shalt be built up, thou shalt put away iniquity far from thy tabernacles.

text.am: የወርቅን ዕቃ በአፈር ውስጥ፥
text.en: Then shalt thou lay up gold as dust, and the gold of Ophir as the stones of the brooks.

text.am: ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክ ወርቅና የሚብለጨለጭ ብር ይሆንልሃል።
text.en: Yea, the Almighty shall be thy defence, and thou shalt have plenty of silver.

text.am: የዚያን ጊዜ ሁሉን በሚችል አምላክ ደስ ይልሃል፥
text.en: For then shalt thou have thy delight in the Almighty, and shalt lift up thy face unto God.

text.am: ወደ እርሱም ትጸልያለህ፥ እርሱም ይሰማሃል፤
text.en: Thou shalt make thy prayer unto him, and he shall hear thee, and thou shalt pay thy vows.

text.am: ነገርንም ትመክራለህ፥ እርሱም ይሳካልሃል፤
text.en: Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee: and the light shall shine upon thy ways.

text.am: ቢያዋርዱህ አንተ ከፍ ከፍ ትላለህ፤
text.en: When men are cast down, then thou shalt say, There is lifting up; and he shall save the humble person.

text.am: ንጹሑን ሰው ያድነዋል፤
text.en: He shall deliver the island of the innocent: and it is delivered by the pureness of thine hands.

text.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: Then Job answered and said,

text.am: ዛሬም ደግሞ የኅዘን እንጕርጕሮዬ ገና መራራ ነው፤
text.en: Even to day is my complaint bitter: my stroke is heavier than my groaning.

text.am: እርሱን ወዴት እንዳገኘው ምነው ባወቅሁ!
text.en: Oh that I knew where I might find him! that I might come even to his seat!

text.am: በፊቱ ሙግቴን አዘጋጅ ነበር፥
text.en: I would order my cause before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

text.am: የሚመልስልኝም ቃል ምን እንደ ሆነ አውቅ ነበር፥
text.en: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say unto me.

text.am: በኃይሉ ብዛት ከእኔ ጋር ይምዋገት ነበርን?
text.en: Will he plead against me with his great power? No; but he would put strength in me.

text.am: ቅን ሰው ከእርሱ ጋር በዚያ ይከራከር ነበር፤
text.en: There the righteous might dispute with him; so should I be delivered for ever from my judge.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ወደ ፊት እሄዳለሁ፥ እርሱም የለም፤
text.en: Behold, I go forward, but he is not there; and backward, but I cannot perceive him:

text.am: ወደሚሠራበት ወደ ግራ ብሄድ አልመለከተውም፤
text.en: On the left hand, where he doth work, but I cannot behold him: he hideth himself on the right hand, that I cannot see him:

text.am: የምሄድበትን መንገድ ያውቃል፤
text.en: But he knoweth the way that I take: when he hath tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

text.am: እግሬ ወደ እርምጃው ተጣብቆአል፤
text.en: My foot hath held his steps, his way have I kept, and not declined.

text.am: ከከንፈሩ ትእዛዝ አልተመለስሁም፤
text.en: Neither have I gone back from the commandment of his lips; I have esteemed the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

text.am: እርሱ ግን ብቻውን ነው፤ እርሱንስ የሚመስለው ማን ነው?
text.en: But he is in one mind, and who can turn him? and what his soul desireth, even that he doeth.

text.am: በእኔ ላይ የተወሰነውን ይፈጽማል፤
text.en: For he performeth the thing that is appointed for me: and many such things are with him.

text.am: ስለዚህ በፊቱ ደነገጥሁ፤
text.en: Therefore am I troubled at his presence: when I consider, I am afraid of him.

text.am: እግዚአብሔር ልቤን አባብቶታልና፥
text.en: For God maketh my heart soft, and the Almighty troubleth me:

text.am: ከጨለማው የተነሣ፥
text.en: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither hath he covered the darkness from my face.

text.am: ሁሉን ከሚችል አምላክ ዘንድ ዘመናት አልተሰወረምና
text.en: Why, seeing times are not hidden from the Almighty, do they that know him not see his days?

text.am: የድንበሩን ምልክት የሚያፈርሱ አሉ፤
text.en: Some remove the landmarks; they violently take away flocks, and feed thereof.

text.am: የድሀ አድጎቹን አህያ ይነዳሉ፤
text.en: They drive away the ass of the fatherless, they take the widow's ox for a pledge.

text.am: ድሆቹን ከመንገዱ ያወጣሉ፤
text.en: They turn the needy out of the way: the poor of the earth hide themselves together.

text.am: እነሆ፥ በምድረ በዳ እንዳሉ እንደ ሜዳ አህዮች፥
text.en: Behold, as wild asses in the desert, go they forth to their work; rising betimes for a prey: the wilderness yieldeth food for them and for their children.

text.am: እነዚያ በእርሻ ውስጥ እህላቸውን ያጭዳሉ፤
text.en: They reap every one his corn in the field: and they gather the vintage of the wicked.

text.am: ራቁታቸውን ያለ ልብስ ያድራሉ፥
text.en: They cause the naked to lodge without clothing, that they have no covering in the cold.

text.am: ከተራሮች በሚወርድ ዝናብ ይረጥባሉ፤
text.en: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for want of a shelter.

text.am: ድሀ አደጉን ልጅ ከጡቱ የሚነጥሉ አሉ
text.en: They pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor.

text.am: ያለ ልብስ ራቁታቸውን ይሄዳሉ፤
text.en: They cause him to go naked without clothing, and they take away the sheaf from the hungry;

text.am: በእነዚህ ሰዎች አጥር ውስጥ ዘይት ያደርጋሉ፤
text.en: Which make oil within their walls, and tread their winepresses, and suffer thirst.

text.am: ከከተማውና ከገዛ ቤቶቻቸው ይባረራሉ፤
text.en: Men groan from out of the city, and the soul of the wounded crieth out: yet God layeth not folly to them.

text.am: እነዚህ በብርሃን ላይ የሚያምፁ ናቸው፤
text.en: They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths thereof.

text.am: ነፍሰ ገዳዩም ሳይነጋ ማልዶ ይነሣል፤
text.en: The murderer rising with the light killeth the poor and needy, and in the night is as a thief.

text.am: የአመንዝራም ዓይን ድግዝግዝታን ይጠብቃል።
text.en: The eye also of the adulterer waiteth for the twilight, saying, No eye shall see me: and disguiseth his face.

text.am: ቤቶቹን በጨለማ ይነድላሉ፤
text.en: In the dark they dig through houses, which they had marked for themselves in the daytime: they know not the light.

text.am: የጥዋት ብርሃን ለእነርሱ ሁሉ እንደ ሞት ጥላ ነው፤
text.en: For the morning is to them even as the shadow of death: if one know them, they are in the terrors of the shadow of death.

text.am: እነርሱ በውኃ ፊት ላይ በርረው ያልፋሉ፤
text.en: He is swift as the waters; their portion is cursed in the earth: he beholdeth not the way of the vineyards.

text.am: ድርቅና ሙቀት የአመዳዩን ውኃ ያጠፋሉ፤
text.en: Drought and heat consume the snow waters: so doth the grave those which have sinned.

text.am: ማኅፀን ትረሳዋለች፤
text.en: The womb shall forget him; the worm shall feed sweetly on him; he shall be no more remembered; and wickedness shall be broken as a tree.

text.am: የማትወልደውን መካኒቱን ይበድላታል፤
text.en: He evil entreateth the barren that beareth not: and doeth not good to the widow.

text.am: ነገር ግን በኃይሉ ኃያላንን ይስባል፤
text.en: He draweth also the mighty with his power: he riseth up, and no man is sure of life.

text.am: እግዚአብሔር በደኅና አኑሮአቸዋል፥
text.en: Though it be given him to be in safety, whereon he resteth; yet his eyes are upon their ways.

text.am: ጥቂት ጊዜ ከፍ ከፍ ይላሉ፤
text.en: They are exalted for a little while, but are gone and brought low; they are taken out of the way as all other, and cut off as the tops of the ears of corn.

text.am: እንዲህስ ባይሆን ሐሰተኛ የሚያደርገኝ፥
text.en: And if it be not so now, who will make me a liar, and make my speech nothing worth?

text.am: ሹሐዊውም በልዳዶስ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

text.am: ገዢነትና መፈራት በእርሱ ዘንድ ናቸው፤
text.en: Dominion and fear are with him, he maketh peace in his high places.

text.am: በውኑ ለሠራዊቶቹ ቍጥር አላቸውን?
text.en: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?

text.am: ሰውስ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጻድቅ ይሆን ዘንድ፥
text.en: How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean that is born of a woman?

text.am: እነሆ፥ ጨረቃ እንኳ ብሩህ አይደለም፥
text.en: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.

text.am: ይልቁንስ ብስብስ የሆነ ሰው፥
text.en: How much less man, that is a worm? and the son of man, which is a worm?

text.am: ኢዮብም መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: But Job answered and said,

text.am: ኃይል የሌለውን ምንኛ ረዳኸው!
text.en: How hast thou helped him that is without power? how savest thou the arm that hath no strength?

text.am: ጥበብስ የሌለውን ምንኛ መከርኸው!
text.en: How hast thou counselled him that hath no wisdom? and how hast thou plentifully declared the thing as it is?

text.am: ይህንስ ቃል በማን እርዳታ ተናገርህ?
text.en: To whom hast thou uttered words? and whose spirit came from thee?

text.am: ሙታን ሰዎች ከውኆች በታች፥
text.en: Dead things are formed from under the waters, and the inhabitants thereof.

text.am: ሲኦል በፊቱ ራቁትዋን ናት፥
text.en: Hell is naked before him, and destruction hath no covering.

text.am: ሰሜንን በባዶ ስፍራ ላይ ይዘረጋል፥
text.en: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.

text.am: ውኆችን በደመናዎቹ ውስጥ ያስራል፥
text.en: He bindeth up the waters in his thick clouds; and the cloud is not rent under them.

text.am: የዙፋኑን ፊት ይከድናል፥
text.en: He holdeth back the face of his throne, and spreadeth his cloud upon it.

text.am: ብርሃንና ጨለማ እስከሚለያዩበት ዳርቻ ድረስ፥
text.en: He hath compassed the waters with bounds, until the day and night come to an end.

text.am: የሰማይ አዕማድ ይንቀጠቀጣሉ፥
text.en: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.

text.am: በኃይሉ ባሕርን ጸጥ ያደርጋል፥
text.en: He divideth the sea with his power, and by his understanding he smiteth through the proud.

text.am: በመንፈሱ ሰማያት ውበትን አገኙ፥
text.en: By his spirit he hath garnished the heavens; his hand hath formed the crooked serpent.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ይህ የመንገዱ ዳርቻ ብቻ ነው፤
text.en: Lo, these are parts of his ways: but how little a portion is heard of him? but the thunder of his power who can understand?

text.am: ኢዮብም ምሳሌውን ይመስል ዘንድ ደገመ፥ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,

text.am: ፍርዴን ያስወገደ ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን!
text.en: As God liveth, who hath taken away my judgment; and the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul;

text.am: እስትንፋሴ በእኔ ውስጥ፥
text.en: All the while my breath is in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils;

text.am: ከንፈሬ ኃጢአትን አትናገርም፥
text.en: My lips shall not speak wickedness, nor my tongue utter deceit.

text.am: እናንተን ማጽደቅ ከእኔ ዘንድ ይራቅ፤
text.en: God forbid that I should justify you: till I die I will not remove mine integrity from me.

text.am: ጽድቄን እይዛለሁ እርሱንም አልተውም፤
text.en: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: my heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.

text.am: ጠላቴ እንደ በደለኛ፥
text.en: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, and he that riseth up against me as the unrighteous.

text.am: እግዚአብሔር ባጠፋውና ነፍሱን በለየ ጊዜ፥
text.en: For what is the hope of the hypocrite, though he hath gained, when God taketh away his soul?

text.am: በውኑ መከራ በመጣበት ጊዜ፥
text.en: Will God hear his cry when trouble cometh upon him?

text.am: ሁሉንስ በሚችል አምላክ ደስ ይለዋልን?
text.en: Will he delight himself in the Almighty? will he always call upon God?

text.am: እኔ ስለ እግዚአብሔር እጅ አስተምራችኋለሁ፤
text.en: I will teach you by the hand of God: that which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ሁላችሁ አይታችኋል፤
text.en: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; why then are ye thus altogether vain?

text.am: ይህች ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ የበደለኛ እድል ፈንታ፥
text.en: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, and the heritage of oppressors, which they shall receive of the Almighty.

text.am: ልጆቹ ቢበዙ ለሰይፍ ይሆናሉ፤
text.en: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword: and his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

text.am: ለእርሱም የቀሩት በቸነፈር ይቀበራሉ፤
text.en: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death: and his widows shall not weep.

text.am: እርሱ ብርን እንደ አፈር ቢከምር፥
text.en: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare raiment as the clay;

text.am: እርሱ ያዘጋጀው ይሆናል፥ ነገር ግን ጻድቅ ይለብሰዋል፤
text.en: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.

text.am: የሚሠራው ቤት እንደ ሸረሪት ድር ይሠራል፥
text.en: He buildeth his house as a moth, and as a booth that the keeper maketh.

text.am: ባለጠጋ ሆኖ ይተኛል፥ ዳግመኛም አይተኛም፤
text.en: The rich man shall lie down, but he shall not be gathered: he openeth his eyes, and he is not.

text.am: ድንጋጤ እንደ ጐርፍ ታገኘዋለች፤
text.en: Terrors take hold on him as waters, a tempest stealeth him away in the night.

text.am: የምሥራቅ ነፋስ ያነሣዋል፥ እርሱም ይሄዳል፤
text.en: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.

text.am: እርሱ ይጥልበታል፥ አይራራለትም፤
text.en: For God shall cast upon him, and not spare: he would fain flee out of his hand.

text.am: ሰው በእጁ ያጨበጭብበታል፤
text.en: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.

text.am: በእውነት ብር የሚወጣበት፥
text.en: Surely there is a vein for the silver, and a place for gold where they fine it.

text.am: ብረት ከመሬት ውስጥ ይወሰዳል፤
text.en: Iron is taken out of the earth, and brass is molten out of the stone.

text.am: ሰው ለጨለማ ፍጻሜን ያደርጋል፤
text.en: He setteth an end to darkness, and searcheth out all perfection: the stones of darkness, and the shadow of death.

text.am: ሰው ከሚኖርበት ርቀው መውረጃ ይቈፍራሉ፤
text.en: The flood breaketh out from the inhabitant; even the waters forgotten of the foot: they are dried up, they are gone away from men.

text.am: እንጀራ ከምድር ውስጥ ይወጣል፤
text.en: As for the earth, out of it cometh bread: and under it is turned up as it were fire.

text.am: ድንጋይዋ የሰንፔር ስፍራ ነው፥
text.en: The stones of it are the place of sapphires: and it hath dust of gold.

text.am: መንገድዋን ጭልፊት አያውቀውም፥
text.en: There is a path which no fowl knoweth, and which the vulture's eye hath not seen:

text.am: የትዕቢት ልጆች አልረገጡአትም፥
text.en: The lion's whelps have not trodden it, nor the fierce lion passed by it.

text.am: ሰው ወደ ቡላድ ድንጋይ እጁን ይዘረጋል፥
text.en: He putteth forth his hand upon the rock; he overturneth the mountains by the roots.

text.am: ከድንጋይ ውስጥ መንዶልዶያ ይወቅራል፤
text.en: He cutteth out rivers among the rocks; and his eye seeth every precious thing.

text.am: ፈሳሹም እንዳይንጠባጠብ ይገድባል፤
text.en: He bindeth the floods from overflowing; and the thing that is hid bringeth he forth to light.

text.am: ነገር ግን ጥበብ የምትገኘው ወዴት ነው?
text.en: But where shall wisdom be found? and where is the place of understanding?

text.am: ሰው መንገድዋን አያውቅም፤
text.en: Man knoweth not the price thereof; neither is it found in the land of the living.

text.am: ቀላይ። በእኔ ውስጥ የለችም ይላል፤
text.en: The depth saith, It is not in me: and the sea saith, It is not with me.

text.am: በምዝምዝ ወርቅ አትገኝም፥
text.en: It cannot be gotten for gold, neither shall silver be weighed for the price thereof.

text.am: በኦፊር ወርቅ፥
text.en: It cannot be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

text.am: ወርቅና ብርጭቆ አይወዳደሩአትም፥
text.en: The gold and the crystal cannot equal it: and the exchange of it shall not be for jewels of fine gold.

text.am: ስለ ዛጐልና ስለ አልማዝ አይነገርም።
text.en: No mention shall be made of coral, or of pearls: for the price of wisdom is above rubies.

text.am: የኢትዮጵያ ቶጳዝዮን አይተካከላትም፥
text.en: The topaz of Ethiopia shall not equal it, neither shall it be valued with pure gold.

text.am: እንግዲያሳ ጥበብ ከወዴት ትመጣለች?
text.en: Whence then cometh wisdom? and where is the place of understanding?

text.am: ከሕያዋን ሁሉ ዓይን ተሰውራለች፥
text.en: Seeing it is hid from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the fowls of the air.

text.am: ጥፋትና ሞት። ወሬዋን በጆሮቻችን ሰማን ብለዋል።
text.en: Destruction and death say, We have heard the fame thereof with our ears.

text.am: እግዚአብሔር መንገድዋን ያስተውላል፥
text.en: God understandeth the way thereof, and he knoweth the place thereof.

text.am: እርሱም የምድርን ዳርቻ ይመለከታል፥
text.en: For he looketh to the ends of the earth, and seeth under the whole heaven;

text.am: ለነፋስ ሚዛንን ባደረገለት ጊዜ፥
text.en: To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.

text.am: ለዝናብም ሥርዓትን፥
text.en: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder:

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ አያት፥ ገለጣትም፤
text.en: Then did he see it, and declare it; he prepared it, yea, and searched it out.

text.am: ሰውንም። እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት ጥበብ ነው፤
text.en: And unto man he said, Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom; and to depart from evil is understanding.

text.am: ኢዮብም ምሳሌውን ይመስል ዘንድ ደገመ፥ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: Moreover Job continued his parable, and said,

text.am: እግዚአብሔር ይጠብቀኝ እንደ ነበረው ጊዜ፥
text.en: Oh that I were as in months past, as in the days when God preserved me;

text.am: በራሴ ላይ መብራቱ በበራ ጊዜ፥
text.en: When his candle shined upon my head, and when by his light I walked through darkness;

text.am: በሙሉ ሰውነቴ እንደ ነበርሁ ጊዜ፥
text.en: As I was in the days of my youth, when the secret of God was upon my tabernacle;

text.am: ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክ ከእኔ ጋር ገና ሳለ፥
text.en: When the Almighty was yet with me, when my children were about me;

text.am: መንገዴ በቅቤ ይታጠብ በነበረ ጊዜ፥
text.en: When I washed my steps with butter, and the rock poured me out rivers of oil;

text.am: ወደ ከተማይቱ በር በወጣሁ ጊዜ፥
text.en: When I went out to the gate through the city, when I prepared my seat in the street!

text.am: ጐበዛዝት እኔን አይተው ተሸሸጉ፥
text.en: The young men saw me, and hid themselves: and the aged arose, and stood up.

text.am: አለቆቹ ከመናገር ዝም አሉ፥
text.en: The princes refrained talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

text.am: የታላላቆቹም ድምፅ አረመመ፤
text.en: The nobles held their peace, and their tongue cleaved to the roof of their mouth.

text.am: የሰማችኝ ጆሮ አሞገሰችኝ፥
text.en: When the ear heard me, then it blessed me; and when the eye saw me, it gave witness to me:

text.am: የሚጮኸውን ችግረኛ፥
text.en: Because I delivered the poor that cried, and the fatherless, and him that had none to help him.

text.am: ለጥፋት የቀረበው በረከት በላዬ መጣ፤
text.en: The blessing of him that was ready to perish came upon me: and I caused the widow's heart to sing for joy.

text.am: ጽድቅን ለበስሁ እርስዋም ለበሰችኝ፤
text.en: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me: my judgment was as a robe and a diadem.

text.am: ለዕውር ዓይን፥
text.en: I was eyes to the blind, and feet was I to the lame.

text.am: ለድሀው አባት ነበርሁ፤
text.en: I was a father to the poor: and the cause which I knew not I searched out.

text.am: የኃጢአተኛውን መንጋጋ ሰበርሁ፥
text.en: And I brake the jaws of the wicked, and plucked the spoil out of his teeth.

text.am: እኔም አልሁ። በልጆቼ መካከል እሞታለሁ፥
text.en: Then I said, I shall die in my nest, and I shall multiply my days as the sand.

text.am: ሥሬ በውኃ ላይ ተዘርግቶአል፥
text.en: My root was spread out by the waters, and the dew lay all night upon my branch.

text.am: ክብሬ በእኔ ዘንድ ታድሶአል፥
text.en: My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.

text.am: ሰዎች እኔን ሰምተው በትዕግሥት ተጠባበቁ፥
text.en: Unto me men gave ear, and waited, and kept silence at my counsel.

text.am: ከቃሌ በኋላ አንዳች አልመለሱም፤
text.en: After my words they spake not again; and my speech dropped upon them.

text.am: ዝናብን እንደሚጠብቁ በትዕግሥት ጠበቁኝ፤
text.en: And they waited for me as for the rain; and they opened their mouth wide as for the latter rain.

text.am: እነርሱ ባልታመኑ ጊዜ ሳቅሁላቸው፤
text.en: If I laughed on them, they believed it not; and the light of my countenance they cast not down.

text.am: መንገዳቸውን መረጥሁ፤
text.en: I chose out their way, and sat chief, and dwelt as a king in the army, as one that comforteth the mourners.

text.am: አሁን ግን በዕድሜ ከእኔ የሚያንሱ፥
text.en: But now they that are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I would have disdained to have set with the dogs of my flock.

text.am: ሙሉ ሰው መሆናቸው ጠፍቶባቸው ነበርና
text.en: Yea, whereto might the strength of their hands profit me, in whom old age was perished?

text.am: በራብና በቀጠና የመነመኑ ናቸው፤
text.en: For want and famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.

text.am: በቍጥቋጦ አጠገብ ያለውን
text.en: Who cut up mallows by the bushes, and juniper roots for their meat.

text.am: ከሰዎች ተለይተው ተሰደዱ፤
text.en: They were driven forth from among men, (they cried after them as after a thief;)

text.am: በሸለቆ ፈረፈርና በምድር ጕድጓድ
text.en: To dwell in the clifts of the valleys, in caves of the earth, and in the rocks.

text.am: በቍጥቋጦ መካከል ይጮኻሉ፤
text.en: Among the bushes they brayed; under the nettles they were gathered together.

text.am: የሰነፎችና የነውረኞች ልጆች ናቸው፤
text.en: They were children of fools, yea, children of base men: they were viler than the earth.

text.am: አሁንም እኔ መዝፈኛና መተረቻ ሆንኋቸው።
text.en: And now am I their song, yea, I am their byword.

text.am: ተጸየፉኝ፥ ከእኔም ራቁ፤
text.en: They abhor me, they flee far from me, and spare not to spit in my face.

text.am: የቀስቴን አውታር አላልቶብኛል፥ አዋርዶኝማል፤
text.en: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before me.

text.am: በቀኜ በኩል ዱርዬዎች ተነሥተዋል፥
text.en: Upon my right hand rise the youth; they push away my feet, and they raise up against me the ways of their destruction.

text.am: ጐዳናዬን ያበላሻሉ፤
text.en: They mar my path, they set forward my calamity, they have no helper.

text.am: በሰፊ ፍራሽ እንደሚመጡ ይመጡብኛል፤
text.en: They came upon me as a wide breaking in of waters: in the desolation they rolled themselves upon me.

text.am: ድንጋጤ በላዬ ተመለሰችብኝ፥
text.en: Terrors are turned upon me: they pursue my soul as the wind: and my welfare passeth away as a cloud.

text.am: አሁንም ነፍሴ በውስጤ ፈሰሰች፤
text.en: And now my soul is poured out upon me; the days of affliction have taken hold upon me.

text.am: በሌሊት አጥንቴ በደዌ ተነደለች፥
text.en: My bones are pierced in me in the night season: and my sinews take no rest.

text.am: ከታላቁ ደዌ ኃይል የተነሣ ልብሴ ተበላሸች፤
text.en: By the great force of my disease is my garment changed: it bindeth me about as the collar of my coat.

text.am: እርሱ በጭቃ ውስጥ ጣለኝ፥
text.en: He hath cast me into the mire, and I am become like dust and ashes.

text.am: ወደ አንተ ጮኽሁ፥ አልመለስህልኝም፤
text.en: I cry unto thee, and thou dost not hear me: I stand up, and thou regardest me not.

text.am: ተመልሰህ ጨካኝ ሆንህብኝ፤
text.en: Thou art become cruel to me: with thy strong hand thou opposest thyself against me.

text.am: በነፋስ አነሣኸኝ፥ በላዩም አስቀመጥኸኝ፤
text.en: Thou liftest me up to the wind; thou causest me to ride upon it, and dissolvest my substance.

text.am: ለሞት ሕያዋንም ሁሉ ለሚሰበሰቡበት ቤት አሳልፈህ እንደምትሰጠኝ አውቄአለሁና።
text.en: For I know that thou wilt bring me to death, and to the house appointed for all living.

text.am: ነገር ግን ሰው በወደቀ ጊዜ እጁን አይዘረጋምን?
text.en: Howbeit he will not stretch out his hand to the grave, though they cry in his destruction.

text.am: ጭንቅ ቀን ላገኘው ሰው አላለቀስሁምን?
text.en: Did not I weep for him that was in trouble? was not my soul grieved for the poor?

text.am: ነገር ግን በጎነትን በተጠባበቅሁ ጊዜ ክፉ ነገር መጣችብኝ፤
text.en: When I looked for good, then evil came unto me: and when I waited for light, there came darkness.

text.am: አንጀቴ ፈላች፥ አላረፈችም፤
text.en: My bowels boiled, and rested not: the days of affliction prevented me.

text.am: ያለ ፀሐይ በትካዜ ሄድሁ፤
text.en: I went mourning without the sun: I stood up, and I cried in the congregation.

text.am: ለቀበሮ ወንድም፥
text.en: I am a brother to dragons, and a companion to owls.

text.am: ቁርበቴ ጠቈረ፥ ከእኔም ተለይቶ እርግፍግፍ አለ፤
text.en: My skin is black upon me, and my bones are burned with heat.

text.am: ስለዚህ መሰንቆዬ ለኀዘን፥
text.en: My harp also is turned to mourning, and my organ into the voice of them that weep.

text.am: ከዓይኔ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ገባሁ፤
text.en: I made a covenant with mine eyes; why then should I think upon a maid?

text.am: የእግዚአብሔር እድል ፈንታ ከላይ፥
text.en: For what portion of God is there from above? and what inheritance of the Almighty from on high?

text.am: መዓትስ ለኃጢአተኛ፥
text.en: Is not destruction to the wicked? and a strange punishment to the workers of iniquity?

text.am: መንገዴን አያይምን?
text.en: Doth not he see my ways, and count all my steps?

text.am: በእውነተኛ ሚዛን ልመዘን፥
text.en: If I have walked with vanity, or if my foot hath hasted to deceit;

text.am: በእውነተኛ ሚዛን ልመዘን፥
text.en: Let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know mine integrity.

text.am: እርምጃዬ ከመንገድ ፈቀቅ ብሎ፥
text.en: If my step hath turned out of the way, and mine heart walked after mine eyes, and if any blot hath cleaved to mine hands;

text.am: እኔ ልዝራ፥ ሌላ ሰውም ይብላው፤
text.en: Then let me sow, and let another eat; yea, let my offspring be rooted out.

text.am: ልቤ ወደ ሌላይቱ ሴት ጐምጅቶ እንደ ሆነ፥
text.en: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour's door;

text.am: ሚስቴ ለሌላ ሰው ትፍጭ፥
text.en: Then let my wife grind unto another, and let others bow down upon her.

text.am: ይህ ክፉ አበሳ፥
text.en: For this is an heinous crime; yea, it is an iniquity to be punished by the judges.

text.am: ይህ እስከ ጥፋት ድረስ የሚበላ እሳት፥
text.en: For it is a fire that consumeth to destruction, and would root out all mine increase.

text.am: ወንድ ባሪያዬ ወይም ሴት ባሪያዬ ከእኔ ጋር በተምዋገቱ ጊዜ፥
text.en: If I did despise the cause of my manservant or of my maidservant, when they contended with me;

text.am: እግዚአብሔር በተነሣ ጊዜ ምን አደርጋለሁ?
text.en: What then shall I do when God riseth up? and when he visiteth, what shall I answer him?

text.am: እኔን በማኅፀን የፈጠረ እርሱንስ የፈጠረው አይደለምን?
text.en: Did not he that made me in the womb make him? and did not one fashion us in the womb?

text.am: ድሀውን ከልመናው ከልክዬ፥
text.en: If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail;

text.am: እንጀራዬን ለብቻዬ በልቼ እንደ ሆነ፥
text.en: Or have eaten my morsel myself alone, and the fatherless hath not eaten thereof;

text.am: እርሱን ግን ከታናሽነቴ ጀምሬ እንደ አባቱ ከእኔ ጋር አሳድጌው ነበር፥
text.en: (For from my youth he was brought up with me, as with a father, and I have guided her from my mother's womb;)

text.am: ራቁቱን የሆነው ሰው ሲጠፋ፥
text.en: If I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or any poor without covering;

text.am: ጐንና ጐኑ ያልባረከችኝ፥
text.en: If his loins have not blessed me, and if he were not warmed with the fleece of my sheep;

text.am: በበሩ ረዳት ስላየሁ፥
text.en: If I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, when I saw my help in the gate:

text.am: ትከሻዬ ከመሠረትዋ ትውደቅ፥
text.en: Then let mine arm fall from my shoulder blade, and mine arm be broken from the bone.

text.am: የእግዚአብሔር መዓት አስደንግጦኛልና፤
text.en: For destruction from God was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.

text.am: ወርቅን ተስፋ አድርጌ፥
text.en: If I have made gold my hope, or have said to the fine gold, Thou art my confidence;

text.am: ሀብቴ ስለ በዛ፥
text.en: If I rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because mine hand had gotten much;

text.am: ፀሐይ ሲበራ
text.en: If I beheld the sun when it shined, or the moon walking in brightness;

text.am: ልቤ በስውር ተታልሎ፥
text.en: And my heart hath been secretly enticed, or my mouth hath kissed my hand:

text.am: ልዑል እግዚአብሔርን በካድሁ ነበርና
text.en: This also were an iniquity to be punished by the judge: for I should have denied the God that is above.

text.am: በሚጠላኝ መጥፋት ደስ ብሎኝ
text.en: If I rejoiced at the destruction of him that hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him:

text.am: ነገር ግን በመርገም ነፍሱን በመሻት
text.en: Neither have I suffered my mouth to sin by wishing a curse to his soul.

text.am: በድንኳኔ የሚኖሩ ሰዎች።
text.en: If the men of my tabernacle said not, Oh that we had of his flesh! we cannot be satisfied.

text.am: መጻተኛው ግን በሜዳ አያድርም ነበር፥
text.en: The stranger did not lodge in the street: but I opened my doors to the traveller.

text.am: በደሌንም በብብቴ በመሸሸግ
text.en: If I covered my transgressions as Adam, by hiding mine iniquity in my bosom:

text.am: ከሕዝብ ብዛት ፈርቼ፥
text.en: Did I fear a great multitude, or did the contempt of families terrify me, that I kept silence, and went not out of the door?

text.am: የሚያዳምጠኝ ምነው በኖረልኝ!
text.en: Oh that one would hear me! behold, my desire is, that the Almighty would answer me, and that mine adversary had written a book.

text.am: በትከሻዬ ላይ እሸከመው፥
text.en: Surely I would take it upon my shoulder, and bind it as a crown to me.

text.am: የእርምጃዬን ቍጥር አስታውቀው፥
text.en: I would declare unto him the number of my steps; as a prince would I go near unto him.

text.am: እርሻዬ በእኔ ላይ ጮኻ እንደ ሆነ፥
text.en: If my land cry against me, or that the furrows likewise thereof complain;

text.am: ፍሬዋን ያለ ዋጋ በልቼ፥
text.en: If I have eaten the fruits thereof without money, or have caused the owners thereof to lose their life:

text.am: በስንዴ ፋንታ አሜከላ፥
text.en: Let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley. The words of Job are ended.

text.am: ኢዮብም ራሱን ጻድቅ አድርጎ ነበርና እነዚያ ሦስቱ ሰዎች መመለስን ተዉ።
text.en: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

text.am: ከራም ወገን የሆነ የቡዛዊው የባርክኤል ልጅ የኤሊሁ ቍጣ ነደደ፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ይልቅ ራሱን ጻድቅ አድርጎ ነበርና ኢዮብን ተቈጣው።
text.en: Then was kindled the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite, of the kindred of Ram: against Job was his wrath kindled, because he justified himself rather than God.

text.am: ደግሞም በኢዮብ ፈረዱበት እንጂ የሚገባ መልስ ስላላገኙ በሦስቱ ባልንጀሮቹ ላይ ተቈጣ።
text.en: Also against his three friends was his wrath kindled, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

text.am: ኤሊሁ ግን ከእርሱ ይልቅ ሽማግሌዎች ነበሩና ከኢዮብ ጋር መናገርን ጠብቆ ነበር።
text.en: Now Elihu had waited till Job had spoken, because they were elder than he.

text.am: ኤሊሁም በነዚህ በሦስቱ ሰዎች አፍ መልስ እንደሌለ ባየ ጊዜ ቍጣው ነደደ።
text.en: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, then his wrath was kindled.

text.am: የቡዛዊውም የባርክኤል ልጅ ኤሊሁ ተናገረ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: And Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered and said, I am young, and ye are very old; wherefore I was afraid, and durst not shew you mine opinion.

text.am: እንደዚህም አልሁ። ዓመታት በተናገሩ ነበር፥
text.en: I said, Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.

text.am: ነገር ግን በሰው ውስጥ መንፈስ አለ፥
text.en: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.

text.am: በዕድሜ ያረጁ ጠቢባን አይደሉም፥
text.en: Great men are not always wise: neither do the aged understand judgment.

text.am: ስለዚህም። ስሙኝ፤
text.en: Therefore I said, Hearken to me; I also will shew mine opinion.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ቃላችሁን በትዕግሥት ጠበቅሁ፤
text.en: Behold, I waited for your words; I gave ear to your reasons, whilst ye searched out what to say.

text.am: እንዲሁም ልብ አደረግሁ፤
text.en: Yea, I attended unto you, and, behold, there was none of you that convinced Job, or that answered his words:

text.am: እናንተም። ጥበብን አግኝተናል፤
text.en: Lest ye should say, We have found out wisdom: God thrusteth him down, not man.

text.am: እርሱ ግን ቃሉን በእኔ ላይ አልተናገረም፤
text.en: Now he hath not directed his words against me: neither will I answer him with your speeches.

text.am: እነርሱ ደነገጡ፥ ዳግመኛም አልመለሱም፤
text.en: They were amazed, they answered no more: they left off speaking.

text.am: እነርሱ አልተናገሩምና፥
text.en: When I had waited, (for they spake not, but stood still, and answered no more;)

text.am: እኔ ደግሞ ፈንታዬን እመልሳለሁ፥
text.en: I said, I will answer also my part, I also will shew mine opinion.

text.am: እኔ ቃል ተሞልቻለሁና፥
text.en: For I am full of matter, the spirit within me constraineth me.

text.am: በተሐ ጠጅ እንደ ተሞላና ሊቀደድ እንደ ቀረበ አቁማዳ፥
text.en: Behold, my belly is as wine which hath no vent; it is ready to burst like new bottles.

text.am: ጥቂት እንድተነፍስ እናገራለሁ፤
text.en: I will speak, that I may be refreshed: I will open my lips and answer.

text.am: ለሰው ፊት ግን አላደላም፤
text.en: Let me not, I pray you, accept any man's person, neither let me give flattering titles unto man.

text.am: በማቈላመጥ እናገር ዘንድ አላውቅምና፤
text.en: For I know not to give flattering titles; in so doing my maker would soon take me away.

text.am: ነገር ግን፥ ኢዮብ ሆይ፥ ንግግሬን እንድትሰማ፥
text.en: Wherefore, Job, I pray thee, hear my speeches, and hearken to all my words.

text.am: እነሆ፥ አፌን ከፍቻለሁ፥
text.en: Behold, now I have opened my mouth, my tongue hath spoken in my mouth.

text.am: ቃሌ የልቤን ቅንነት ያወጣል፤
text.en: My words shall be of the uprightness of my heart: and my lips shall utter knowledge clearly.

text.am: የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ፈጠረኝ፥
text.en: The Spirit of God hath made me, and the breath of the Almighty hath given me life.

text.am: ይቻልህ እንደ ሆነ መልስልኝ፤
text.en: If thou canst answer me, set thy words in order before me, stand up.

text.am: እነሆ፥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እኔ እንደ አንተ ነኝ፤
text.en: Behold, I am according to thy wish in God's stead: I also am formed out of the clay.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ግርማዬ አታስፈራህም
text.en: Behold, my terror shall not make thee afraid, neither shall my hand be heavy upon thee.

text.am: በጆሮዬ ተናግረሃል፥
text.en: Surely thou hast spoken in mine hearing, and I have heard the voice of thy words, saying,

text.am: እኔ ያለ መተላለፍ ንጹሕ ነኝ፤
text.en: I am clean without transgression, I am innocent; neither is there iniquity in me.

text.am: እነሆ፥ ምክንያት አግኝቶብኛል፥
text.en: Behold, he findeth occasions against me, he counteth me for his enemy,

text.am: እግሬን በግንድ አጣበቀ፥
text.en: He putteth my feet in the stocks, he marketh all my paths.

text.am: እነሆ፥ አንተ በዚህ ጻድቅ አይደለህም፤
text.en: Behold, in this thou art not just: I will answer thee, that God is greater than man.

text.am: አንተ። ለቃሌ ሁሉ አይመልስልኝም ብለህ፥
text.en: Why dost thou strive against him? for he giveth not account of any of his matters.

text.am: እግዚአብሔር በአንድ መንገድ በሌላም ይናገራል፤
text.en: For God speaketh once, yea twice, yet man perceiveth it not.

text.am: በሕልም፥ በሌሊት ራእይ፥
text.en: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falleth upon men, in slumberings upon the bed;

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ የሰዎችን ጆሮ ይከፍታል፥
text.en: Then he openeth the ears of men, and sealeth their instruction,

text.am: ሰውን ከክፉ ሥራው ይመልሰው ዘንድ
text.en: That he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

text.am: ነፍሱን ከጕድጓድ፥
text.en: He keepeth back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

text.am: ደግሞ በአልጋ ላይ በደዌ ይገሥጸዋል፥
text.en: He is chastened also with pain upon his bed, and the multitude of his bones with strong pain:

text.am: ሕይወቱም እንጀራን፥
text.en: So that his life abhorreth bread, and his soul dainty meat.

text.am: ሥጋው እስከማይታይ ድረስ ይሰለስላል፤
text.en: His flesh is consumed away, that it cannot be seen; and his bones that were not seen stick out.

text.am: ነፍሱ ወደ ጕድጓዱ፥
text.en: Yea, his soul draweth near unto the grave, and his life to the destroyers.

text.am: የቀናውን መንገድ ለሰው ያስታውቀው ዘንድ፥
text.en: If there be a messenger with him, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to shew unto man his uprightness:

text.am: እየራራለት።
text.en: Then he is gracious unto him, and saith, Deliver him from going down to the pit: I have found a ransom.

text.am: ሥጋው እንደ ሕፃን ሥጋ ይለመልማል፤
text.en: His flesh shall be fresher than a child's: he shall return to the days of his youth:

text.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔር ይጸልያል፥
text.en: He shall pray unto God, and he will be favourable unto him: and he shall see his face with joy: for he will render unto man his righteousness.

text.am: እርሱም በሰው ፊት እየዘመረ።
text.en: He looketh upon men, and if any say, I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it profited me not;

text.am: ነፍሴ ወደ ጕድጓድ እንዳትወርድ አድኖአታል፥
text.en: He will deliver his soul from going into the pit, and his life shall see the light.

text.am: እግዚአብሔር ይህን ሁሉ
text.en: Lo, all these things worketh God oftentimes with man,

text.am: ይህም ነፍሱን ከጕድጓድ ይመልስ ዘንድ፥
text.en: To bring back his soul from the pit, to be enlightened with the light of the living.

text.am: ኢዮብ ሆይ፥ አድምጥ፥ እኔንም ስማ፤
text.en: Mark well, O Job, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I will speak.

text.am: ነገር ቢኖርህ መልስልኝ፤
text.en: If thou hast any thing to say, answer me: speak, for I desire to justify thee.

text.am: ያለዚያም እኔን ስማ፤
text.en: If not, hearken unto me: hold thy peace, and I shall teach thee wisdom.

text.am: ኤሊሁም ደግሞ መለሰ፥ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: Furthermore Elihu answered and said,

text.am: እናንተ ጥበበኞች፥ ቃሌን ስሙ፤
text.en: Hear my words, O ye wise men; and give ear unto me, ye that have knowledge.

text.am: ትናጋ መብልን እንደሚቀምስ፥
text.en: For the ear trieth words, as the mouth tasteth meat.

text.am: ቅን የሆነውን ነገር እንምረጥ፤
text.en: Let us choose to us judgment: let us know among ourselves what is good.

text.am: ኢዮብ። እኔ ጻድቅ ነኝ፥
text.en: For Job hath said, I am righteous: and God hath taken away my judgment.

text.am: ምንም እውነተኛ ብሆን እንደ ውሸተኛ ተቈጠርሁ፤
text.en: Should I lie against my right? my wound is incurable without transgression.

text.am: ኢዮብም። በእግዚአብሔር መደሰት
text.en: What man is like Job, who drinketh up scorning like water?

text.am: ኢዮብም። በእግዚአብሔር መደሰት
text.en: Which goeth in company with the workers of iniquity, and walketh with wicked men.

text.am: ኢዮብም። በእግዚአብሔር መደሰት
text.en: For he hath said, It profiteth a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.

text.am: ስለዚህ እናንተ አእምሮ ያላችሁ ሰዎች፥ ስሙኝ፤
text.en: Therefore hearken unto me, ye men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness; and from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

text.am: ለሰው ሥራውን ይመልስለታል፥
text.en: For the work of a man shall he render unto him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

text.am: በእውነት እግዚአብሔር ክፉ አይሠራም፥
text.en: Yea, surely God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert judgment.

text.am: ምድርን አደራ የሰጠው ማን ነው?
text.en: Who hath given him a charge over the earth? or who hath disposed the whole world?

text.am: እርሱ ልቡን ወደ ራሱ ቢመልስ፥
text.en: If he set his heart upon man, if he gather unto himself his spirit and his breath;

text.am: ሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ በአንድነት ይጠፋል፥
text.en: All flesh shall perish together, and man shall turn again unto dust.

text.am: አስተዋይ ብትሆን ይህን ስማ፤
text.en: If now thou hast understanding, hear this: hearken to the voice of my words.

text.am: በውኑ ጽድቅን የሚጠላ ይሠለጥናልን?
text.en: Shall even he that hateth right govern? and wilt thou condemn him that is most just?

text.am: ማንም ሰው ንጉሡን። በደለኛ ነህ፥
text.en: Is it fit to say to a king, Thou art wicked? and to princes, Ye are ungodly?

text.am: እነርሱ ሁሉ የእጁ ሥራ ናቸውና
text.en: How much less to him that accepteth not the persons of princes, nor regardeth the rich more than the poor? for they all are the work of his hands.

text.am: እነርሱ በመንፈቀ ሌሊት በድንገት ይሞታሉ፤
text.en: In a moment shall they die, and the people shall be troubled at midnight, and pass away: and the mighty shall be taken away without hand.

text.am: ዓይኖቹ በሰው መንገድ ላይ ናቸው፥
text.en: For his eyes are upon the ways of man, and he seeth all his goings.

text.am: ኃጢአትን የሚሠሩ ይሰወሩበት ዘንድ
text.en: There is no darkness, nor shadow of death, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

text.am: ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመፈራረድ እንዲመጣ
text.en: For he will not lay upon man more than right; that he should enter into judgment with God.

text.am: ታላላቆችን ያለ ምርመራ ይሰባብራል፥
text.en: He shall break in pieces mighty men without number, and set others in their stead.

text.am: ሥራቸውን ያውቃል፤
text.en: Therefore he knoweth their works, and he overturneth them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

text.am: ሰዎች እያዩ እንደ ክፉዎች ይመታቸዋል፤
text.en: He striketh them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

text.am: የድሀውን ልቅሶ ወደ እርሱ ያደርሱ ዘንድ፥
text.en: Because they turned back from him, and would not consider any of his ways:

text.am: የድሀውን ልቅሶ ወደ እርሱ ያደርሱ ዘንድ፥
text.en: So that they cause the cry of the poor to come unto him, and he heareth the cry of the afflicted.

text.am: በሕዝብ ወይም በሰው ዘንድ ቢሆን፥
text.en: When he giveth quietness, who then can make trouble? and when he hideth his face, who then can behold him? whether it be done against a nation, or against a man only:

text.am: ይህም ዝንጉ ሰው እንዳይነግሥ፥
text.en: That the hypocrite reign not, lest the people be ensnared.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርን። እኔ ሳልበድል ቅጣት ተቀበልሁ፤
text.en: Surely it is meet to be said unto God, I have borne chastisement, I will not offend any more:

text.am: የማላየውን ነገር አንተ አስተምረኝ፤
text.en: That which I see not teach thou me: if I have done iniquity, I will do no more.

text.am: በውኑ አንተ ጥለኸዋልና
text.en: Should it be according to thy mind? he will recompense it, whether thou refuse, or whether thou choose; and not I: therefore speak what thou knowest.

text.am: የሚሰሙኝ ጥበበኞች ሁሉ፥
text.en: Let men of understanding tell me, and let a wise man hearken unto me.

text.am: ኢዮብ ያለ እውቀት ተናግሮአል፥
text.en: Job hath spoken without knowledge, and his words were without wisdom.

text.am: ኢዮብ እስከ ፍጻሜ ድረስ ምነው በተፈተነ ኖሮ!
text.en: My desire is that Job may be tried unto the end because of his answers for wicked men.

text.am: በኃጢአቱም ላይ ዓመፅን ጨምሮአልና፥
text.en: For he addeth rebellion unto his sin, he clappeth his hands among us, and multiplieth his words against God.

text.am: ኤሊሁም ደግሞ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: Elihu spake moreover, and said,

text.am: ይህ ጽድቅ እንደ ሆነ ታስባለህን?
text.en: Thinkest thou this to be right, that thou saidst, My righteousness is more than God's?

text.am: አንተ። ምን ጥቅም አለህ?
text.en: For thou saidst, What advantage will it be unto thee? and, What profit shall I have, if I be cleansed from my sin?

text.am: እኔ ለአንተና ከአንተ ጋር ላሉ ለባልንጀሮችህ እመልሳለሁ።
text.en: I will answer thee, and thy companions with thee.

text.am: ዓይኖችህን ወደ ሰማይ አቅንተህ እይ፤
text.en: Look unto the heavens, and see; and behold the clouds which are higher than thou.

text.am: ኃጢአት ብትሠራ ምን ትጐዳዋለህ?
text.en: If thou sinnest, what doest thou against him? or if thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?

text.am: ጻድቅስ ብትሆን ምን ትሰጠዋለህ?
text.en: If thou be righteous, what givest thou him? or what receiveth he of thine hand?

text.am: እንደ አንተ ያለውን ሰው ክፋትህ ይጐዳዋል፤
text.en: Thy wickedness may hurt a man as thou art; and thy righteousness may profit the son of man.

text.am: ከግፍ ብዛት የተነሣ ሰዎች ይጮኻሉ፤
text.en: By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.

text.am: ነገር ግን። በሌሊት መዝሙርን የሚሰጥ፥
text.en: But none saith, Where is God my maker, who giveth songs in the night;

text.am: ነገር ግን። በሌሊት መዝሙርን የሚሰጥ፥
text.en: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, and maketh us wiser than the fowls of heaven?

text.am: በዚያ ስለ ክፉ ሰዎች ትዕቢት ይጮኻሉ፥
text.en: There they cry, but none giveth answer, because of the pride of evil men.

text.am: በእውነት እግዚአብሔር ከንቱ ነገርን አይሰማም፥
text.en: Surely God will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.

text.am: ይልቁንም። አላየውም፤
text.en: Although thou sayest thou shalt not see him, yet judgment is before him; therefore trust thou in him.

text.am: አሁን ግን በቍጣው አልጐበኘምና።
text.en: But now, because it is not so, he hath visited in his anger; yet he knoweth it not in great extremity:

text.am: ስለዚህ ኢዮብ አፉን በከንቱ ይከፍታል፥
text.en: Therefore doth Job open his mouth in vain; he multiplieth words without knowledge.

text.am: ኤሊሁም ደግሞ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: Elihu also proceeded, and said,

text.am: ገና ስለ እግዚአብሔር የሚነገር አለኝና
text.en: Suffer me a little, and I will shew thee that I have yet to speak on God's behalf.

text.am: እውቀቴን ከሩቅ አመጣለሁ፥
text.en: I will fetch my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

text.am: ቃሌ በእውነት ያለ ሐሰት ነው፤
text.en: For truly my words shall not be false: he that is perfect in knowledge is with thee.

text.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ኃያል ነው፥ ማንንም አይንቅም፤
text.en: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.

text.am: እርሱ የበደለኞችን ሕይወት አያድንም፤
text.en: He preserveth not the life of the wicked: but giveth right to the poor.

text.am: ዓይኑን ከጻድቃን ላይ አያርቅም፤
text.en: He withdraweth not his eyes from the righteous: but with kings are they on the throne; yea, he doth establish them for ever, and they are exalted.

text.am: በሰንሰለት ቢታሰሩ፥
text.en: And if they be bound in fetters, and be holden in cords of affliction;

text.am: ሥራቸውንና መተላለፋቸውን
text.en: Then he sheweth them their work, and their transgressions that they have exceeded.

text.am: ጆሮአቸውን ለተግሣጽ ይከፍተዋል፥
text.en: He openeth also their ear to discipline, and commandeth that they return from iniquity.

text.am: ቢሰሙ ቢያገለግሉትም፥
text.en: If they obey and serve him, they shall spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

text.am: ባይሰሙ ግን በሰይፍ ይጠፋሉ፥
text.en: But if they obey not, they shall perish by the sword, and they shall die without knowledge.

text.am: ዝንጉዎች ግን ቍጣን ያዘጋጃሉ፤
text.en: But the hypocrites in heart heap up wrath: they cry not when he bindeth them.

text.am: በሕፃንነታቸው ሳሉ ይሞታሉ፥
text.en: They die in youth, and their life is among the unclean.

text.am: የተቸገረውን በችግሩ ያድነዋል፤
text.en: He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.

text.am: እንዲሁም አንተን ከመከራ
text.en: Even so would he have removed thee out of the strait into a broad place, where there is no straitness; and that which should be set on thy table should be full of fatness.

text.am: አንተ ግን በበደለኞች ፍርድ የተሞላህ ነህ፤
text.en: But thou hast fulfilled the judgment of the wicked: judgment and justice take hold on thee.

text.am: ቍጣ ለስድብ አያታልልህ፤
text.en: Because there is wrath, beware lest he take thee away with his stroke: then a great ransom cannot deliver thee.

text.am: ባለጠግነትህ የኃይልህም ብርታት ሁሉ
text.en: Will he esteem thy riches? no, not gold, nor all the forces of strength.

text.am: ወገኖች ከስፍራቸው የሚወጡበትን ሌሊት አትመኝ።
text.en: Desire not the night, when people are cut off in their place.

text.am: ከመከራ ይልቅ ይህን መርጠሃልና
text.en: Take heed, regard not iniquity: for this hast thou chosen rather than affliction.

text.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር በኃይሉ ከፍ ያለውን ነገር ያደርጋል፤
text.en: Behold, God exalteth by his power: who teacheth like him?

text.am: መንገዱን ማን አዘዘለት?
text.en: Who hath enjoined him his way? or who can say, Thou hast wrought iniquity?

text.am: ሰዎች የዘመሩትን ሥራውን ታከብር ዘንድ አስብ።
text.en: Remember that thou magnify his work, which men behold.

text.am: ሰዎች ሁሉ ተመልክተውታል፤
text.en: Every man may see it; man may behold it afar off.

text.am: እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነው፥ እኛም አናውቀውም።
text.en: Behold, God is great, and we know him not, neither can the number of his years be searched out.

text.am: የውኃውን ነጠብጣብ ወደ ላይ ይስባል፥
text.en: For he maketh small the drops of water: they pour down rain according to the vapour thereof:

text.am: ደመናት ያዘንባሉ፥
text.en: Which the clouds do drop and distil upon man abundantly.

text.am: የደመናውንም መዘርጋት፥
text.en: Also can any understand the spreadings of the clouds, or the noise of his tabernacle?

text.am: እነሆ፥ በዙሪያው ብርሃኑን ይዘረጋል፤
text.en: Behold, he spreadeth his light upon it, and covereth the bottom of the sea.

text.am: በእነዚህ በአሕዛብ ላይ ይፈርዳል፤
text.en: For by them judgeth he the people; he giveth meat in abundance.

text.am: እጆቹን በብርሃን ይሰውራል፥
text.en: With clouds he covereth the light; and commandeth it not to shine by the cloud that cometh betwixt.

text.am: የነጐድጓድ ድምፅ ስለ እርሱ ይናገራል፤
text.en: The noise thereof sheweth concerning it, the cattle also concerning the vapour.

text.am: ስለዚህም ልቤ ተንቀጠቀጠ፥
text.en: At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of his place.

text.am: የድምፁን መትመም ስሙ፥
text.en: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound that goeth out of his mouth.

text.am: እርሱን ወደ ሰማያት ሁሉ ታች፥
text.en: He directeth it under the whole heaven, and his lightning unto the ends of the earth.

text.am: በስተ ኋላው ድምፅ ይጮኻል፤
text.en: After it a voice roareth: he thundereth with the voice of his excellency; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard.

text.am: እግዚአብሔር በድምፁ ድንቅኛ ያንጐደጕዳል፤
text.en: God thundereth marvellously with his voice; great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.

text.am: በረዶውንና ውሽንፍሩን ብርቱንም ዝናብ።
text.en: For he saith to the snow, Be thou on the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength.

text.am: ሰው ሁሉ ሥራውን ያውቅ ዘንድ
text.en: He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.

text.am: አውሬዎቹም ወደ ጫካው ይገባሉ፥
text.en: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.

text.am: ከተሰወረ ማደሪያውም ዐውሎ ነፋስ፥
text.en: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.

text.am: ከእግዚአብሔር እስትንፋስ ውርጭ ተሰጥቶአል፤
text.en: By the breath of God frost is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.

text.am: የውኃውንም ሙላት በደመና ላይ ይጭናል፤
text.en: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scattereth his bright cloud:

text.am: ለተግሣጽ ወይም ለምድሩ ወይም ለምሕረት ቢሆን፥
text.en: And it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth.

text.am: ለተግሣጽ ወይም ለምድሩ ወይም ለምሕረት ቢሆን፥
text.en: He causeth it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy.

text.am: ኢዮብ ሆይ፥ ይህን ስማ፤
text.en: Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

text.am: በውኑ እግዚአብሔር እንዴት እንደሚያዝዛቸው፥
text.en: Dost thou know when God disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?

text.am: ወይስ የደመናውን ሚዛን፥
text.en: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?

text.am: በደቡብ ነፋስ ምድር ጸጥ ባለች ጊዜ፥
text.en: How thy garments are warm, when he quieteth the earth by the south wind?

text.am: እንደ ቀለጠ መስተዋት
text.en: Hast thou with him spread out the sky, which is strong, and as a molten looking glass?

text.am: እኛ ከጨለማ የተነሣ በሥርዓት መናገር አንችልምና
text.en: Teach us what we shall say unto him; for we cannot order our speech by reason of darkness.

text.am: ማንም በእርሱ ላይ ቢናገር ፈጽሞ ይዋጣልና
text.en: Shall it be told him that I speak? if a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.

text.am: አሁንም ነፋስ አልፎ ካጠራቸው በኋላ፥
text.en: And now men see not the bright light which is in the clouds: but the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.

text.am: ከሰሜን ወርቅ የሚመስል ጌጠኛ ብርሃን ይወጣል፤
text.en: Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God is terrible majesty.

text.am: ሁሉን የሚችል አምላክን እናገኝ ዘንድ አንችልም፤
text.en: Touching the Almighty, we cannot find him out: he is excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.

text.am: ስለዚህ ሰዎች ይፈሩታል፤
text.en: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any that are wise of heart.

text.am: እግዚአብሔርም በዐውሎ ነፋስ ውስጥ ሆኖ ለኢዮብ መለሰ እንዲህም አለ።
text.en: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind, and said,

text.am: ያለ እውቀት በሚነገር ቃል
text.en: Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge?

text.am: እንግዲህ እንደ ሰው ወገብህን ታጠቅ፤
text.en: Gird up now thy loins like a man; for I will demand of thee, and answer thou me.

text.am: ምድርን በመሠረትሁ ጊዜ አንተ ወዴት ነበርህ?
text.en: Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.

text.am: ብታውቅስ መሠፈሪያዋን የወሰነ፥
text.en: Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?

text.am: አጥቢያ ኮከቦች በአንድነት ሲዘምሩ፥
text.en: Whereupon are the foundations thereof fastened? or who laid the corner stone thereof;

text.am: አጥቢያ ኮከቦች በአንድነት ሲዘምሩ፥
text.en: When the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

text.am: ከማኅፀን እንደሚወጣ በወጣ ጊዜ
text.en: Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it brake forth, as if it had issued out of the womb?

text.am: ደመናውን ለልብሱ፥
text.en: When I made the cloud the garment thereof, and thick darkness a swaddlingband for it,

text.am: ድንበሩን በዙሪያው አድርጌ፥
text.en: And brake up for it my decreed place, and set bars and doors,

text.am: እስከዚህ ድረስ ድረሺ፥ አትለፊ፤
text.en: And said, Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed?

text.am: የምድርን ዳርቻ ይይዝ ዘንድ፥
text.en: Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days; and caused the dayspring to know his place;

text.am: የምድርን ዳርቻ ይይዝ ዘንድ፥
text.en: That it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it?

text.am: ጭቃ ከማኅተም በታች እንደሚለወጥ እንዲሁ እርስዋ ትለወጣለች፤
text.en: It is turned as clay to the seal; and they stand as a garment.

text.am: ከበደለኞች ብርሃናቸው ተከልክሎአል፥
text.en: And from the wicked their light is withholden, and the high arm shall be broken.

text.am: ወደ ባሕር ምንጭስ ውስጥ ገብተሃልን?
text.en: Hast thou entered into the springs of the sea? or hast thou walked in the search of the depth?

text.am: የሞት በሮች ተገልጠውልሃልን?
text.en: Have the gates of death been opened unto thee? or hast thou seen the doors of the shadow of death?

text.am: ምድርንስ በስፋትዋ አስተውለሃታልን?
text.en: Hast thou perceived the breadth of the earth? declare if thou knowest it all.

text.am: ወደ ዳርቻው ትነዳው ዘንድ፥
text.en: Where is the way where light dwelleth? and as for darkness, where is the place thereof,

text.am: ወደ ዳርቻው ትነዳው ዘንድ፥
text.en: That thou shouldest take it to the bound thereof, and that thou shouldest know the paths to the house thereof?

text.am: በዚያን ጊዜ ተወልደህ ነበርና፥
text.en: Knowest thou it, because thou wast then born? or because the number of thy days is great?

text.am: በውኑ ወደ በረዶው ቤተ መዛግብት ገብተሃልን?
text.en: Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,

text.am: ይኸውም ለመከራ ጊዜ ለሰልፍና ለጦርነት ቀን የጠበቅሁት ነው።
text.en: Which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

text.am: ብርሃንስ በምን መንገድ ይከፈላል?
text.en: By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?

text.am: ባድማውንና ውድማውን እንዲያጠግብ፥
text.en: Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;

text.am: ባድማውንና ውድማውን እንዲያጠግብ፥
text.en: To cause it to rain on the earth, where no man is; on the wilderness, wherein there is no man;

text.am: ሣሩንም እንዲያበቅል፥
text.en: To satisfy the desolate and waste ground; and to cause the bud of the tender herb to spring forth?

text.am: በውኑ ለዝናብ አባት አለውን?
text.en: Hath the rain a father? or who hath begotten the drops of dew?

text.am: በረዶስ ከማን ማኅፀን ወጣ?
text.en: Out of whose womb came the ice? and the hoary frost of heaven, who hath gendered it?

text.am: ውኆች እንደ ድንጋይ ጠነከሩ፥
text.en: The waters are hid as with a stone, and the face of the deep is frozen.

text.am: በውኑ የሰባቱን ከዋክብት ዘለላ ታስር ዘንድ፥
text.en: Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?

text.am: ወይስ ማዛሮት የሚባሉትን ከዋክብት በጊዜያቸው ታወጣ ዘንድ፥
text.en: Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?

text.am: የሰማይን ሥርዓት ታውቃለህን?
text.en: Knowest thou the ordinances of heaven? canst thou set the dominion thereof in the earth?

text.am: የውኆች ብዛት ይሸፍንህ ዘንድ
text.en: Canst thou lift up thy voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover thee?

text.am: መብረቆች ሄደው። እነሆ፥ እዚህ አለን ይሉህ ዘንድ
text.en: Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are?

text.am: በውስጡስ ጥበብን ያኖረ፥
text.en: Who hath put wisdom in the inward parts? or who hath given understanding to the heart?

text.am: የሰማይን ደመና በጥበቡ ሊቈጥር የሚችል ማን ነው?
text.en: Who can number the clouds in wisdom? or who can stay the bottles of heaven,

text.am: የሰማይን ደመና በጥበቡ ሊቈጥር የሚችል ማን ነው?
text.en: When the dust groweth into hardness, and the clods cleave fast together?

text.am: በዋሾቻቸው ውስጥ ተጋድመው፥
text.en: Wilt thou hunt the prey for the lion? or fill the appetite of the young lions,

text.am: በዋሾቻቸው ውስጥ ተጋድመው፥
text.en: When they couch in their dens, and abide in the covert to lie in wait?

text.am: ልጆቹ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሲጮኹ፥
text.en: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.

text.am: የበረሃ ፍየል የምትወልድበትን ጊዜ ታውቃለህን?
text.en: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? or canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?

text.am: እርስዋ የምትፈጽመውንስ ወራት ትቈጥራለህን?
text.en: Canst thou number the months that they fulfil? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?

text.am: ይንበረከካሉ፥ ልጆቻቸውንም ይወልዳሉ፥
text.en: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.

text.am: ልጆቻቸው ይጠነክራሉ፥
text.en: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not unto them.

text.am: የሜዳውስ አህያ አርነት ማን አወጣው?
text.en: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?

text.am: በረሃውን ለእርሱ ቤት አድርጌ ሰጠሁት፤
text.en: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.

text.am: በከተማ ውካታ ይዘብታል፤
text.en: He scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regardeth he the crying of the driver.

text.am: ተራራውን እንደ መሰምርያው ይመለከተዋል፥
text.en: The range of the mountains is his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.

text.am: ጐሽ ያገለግልህ ዘንድ ይታዘዛልን?
text.en: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib?

text.am: ጐሽ ይተልምልህ ዘንድ ትጠምደዋለህን?
text.en: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?

text.am: ጕልበቱስ ብርቱ ስለ ሆነ ትታመነዋለህን?
text.en: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength is great? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?

text.am: ዘርህንስ ይመልስልህ ዘንድ፥
text.en: Wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, and gather it into thy barn?

text.am: የሰጐን ክንፍ በደስታ ይንቀሳቀሳል፤
text.en: Gavest thou the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?

text.am: እንቍላልዋን በመሬት ላይ ትተዋለች፥
text.en: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,

text.am: እግር ይሰብረው ዘንድ፥
text.en: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.

text.am: የእርስዋ እንዳልሆኑ በልጆችዋ ትጨክናለች።
text.en: She is hardened against her young ones, as though they were not hers: her labour is in vain without fear;

text.am: እግዚአብሔር ጥበብን ከእርስዋ ከልክሎአልና፥
text.en: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.

text.am: ወደ ላይ ከፍ ከፍ ስትል
text.en: What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.

text.am: ለፈረስ ጕልበቱን ሰጥተኸዋልን?
text.en: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?

text.am: እንደ አንበጣስ አፈናጠርኸውን?
text.en: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils is terrible.

text.am: በኮቴው በሸለቆው ውስጥ ይጐደፍራል፥
text.en: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in his strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men.

text.am: በፍርሃት ላይ ይስቃል፥
text.en: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.

text.am: በእርሱ ላይ የፍላጻ ኮረጆና ብልጭልጭ የሚል ጦር
text.en: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.

text.am: በጭካኔና በቍጣ መሬትን ይውጣል፤
